Conduct thorough research on various aspects of biodiversity in Ladakh.
Develop and implement effective conservation strategies to protect and preserve the region's natural resources.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve research goals and objectives.
Analyze data and prepare reports on research findings and recommendations.
Participate in fieldwork and collect samples as required.
Maintain accurate records and databases of research activities.
Job Requirements
Master's degree in a relevant field such as biology, ecology, or environmental science.
At least 2 years of experience in research or conservation, preferably in a similar role.
Strong knowledge of biodiversity monitoring and conservation principles.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
About Company
The Bombay Natural History Society is a leading organization dedicated to the study and conservation of India's natural heritage. We are committed to promoting scientific research and education, and we are seeking talented individuals to join our team.
Additional Info
Please note that this position requires working on a "war footing" basis, which may involve frequent travel and living arrangements.

Description:
Position CSM

SCOPE OF WORK
The DTC ( Direct-to-Customer) business aims to leverage 50 million homes opportunity in India by providing simplified services and great and consistent customer experience. Catchment Sales Manager in DTC is a frontline sales role responsible for managing a retail outlet as well as driving broadband business in a dedicated catchment with a team size of 7-12 executives through customer service, market activations, network expansion and stakeholder management.


Manage store operations SOPs, handle customer queries and escalations
Drive postpaid business for catchment through walk-in and walkout models
¢ Online Lead Management from Integrated Lead management system
¢ Ensure network expansion and timely installations by coordinating with market planning, marketing and Home Delivery Org
¢ Performance Tracking and governance large off roll team (7 -12)
¢ Understand market demographics and increase market visibility through BTL activities as per customer segments
¢ Drive broadband business, maintain good relationships with residential and market association to drive rollout and generate business
¢ Increase upselling and cross-selling to new and existing customers in catchment


¢ Build a culture of serve to grow in stores
¢ Ensure robust planning to start strong
¢ Drive discipline in store and cash compliance
¢ Simplify communication for the field executives to understand
¢ Keep team motivated through team connects, rituals and R&R
¢ Building strong relationships with internal as well as external stakeholders and resourcefulness
¢ Partner Management (in LCO towns)


¢ Broadband and network knowledge
¢ Inventory management
¢ Analytical Mindset & basic MS office
¢ Drive for results and Execution Excellence
¢ Ownership
¢ Influencing
¢ Build and maintain relationships

Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. The institute is promoted by the renowned leaders in entrepreneurial education in India and attracts talent and grants from leading corporates and Government bodies in India.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.

Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Description:
Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Job Summary:
About the Role

The Abduz Group is looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Finance Associate to support the day-to-day accounting and financial operations of the organization

Record and maintain financial transactions accurately in Tally

Process invoices, receipts, payments, and journal entries

Assist in accounts payable and accounts receivable management

Reconcile bank statements, cash accounts, and vendor ledgers

Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation

Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities

Verify bills, expense claims, and supporting documents for accuracy

Prepare basic financial reports and summaries as required

Coordinate with various departments to collect and verify financial information

Support statutory compliance and audit requirements by maintaining accurate records

Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information

Identify discrepancies and report them promptly to the Finance Manager

Minimum 1 3 years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related role

Sound knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping practices

Proficiency in Tally ERP/Tally Prime is mandatory

Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy

Good analytical and numerical skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications

Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

Strong organizational and record-keeping skills

Honest, reliable, and capable of handling confidential information

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Experience in the hospitality industry will be an added advantage

Familiarity with GST, TDS, and basic statutory compliance requirements is preferred

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Description:
Experience Level: Senior (5+ years in relevant field)

Role Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Architect who is not only a practitioner of sustainable and context-responsive architecture but also an inspiring educator. The candidate will teach, mentor, and lead hands-on learning experiences that embody HIAL's philosophy of learning by doing. The role involves working closely with fellows, interns, and students to design and build passive solar-heated structures, lead community-based projects and organize flagship events such as the Sun and Earth Festival.

Key Responsibilities:

Academic & Teaching:
Design and deliver academic courses on sustainable architecture, passive solar design, earth architecture and responsible construction practices.
Facilitate experiential, hands-on and site-based learning that connect theory with real-world application.
Guide students, fellows, and interns in their individual projects, research and thesis work.
Evaluate learning outcomes and contribute to curriculum development.

Lead the design and construction of buildings at HIAL using eco-responsive methods (e.g., mud, stone, rammed earth, straw clay, solar).

The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:

Manage event registration and attendee communication.

Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.

Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.

Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Sales and Customer Engagement:
Warmly welcome and assist customers, understanding their preferences.
Showcase jewellery collections and guide customers in their purchase decisions.
Learn and apply sales techniques, product knowledge, and customer engagement strategies.
Maintain punctuality, professional conduct, and adherence to company policies.
Observe and support senior sales representatives in customer interactions and sales management.
Assist in sales returns, exchanges, and repair services.
Provide accurate estimates for jewellery selections for billing.
Achieve section-wise sales targets and suggest improvements for store profitability.
Learn and execute the billing process efficiently.
Stay updated on competitor products, market trends, and customer preferences.

Assist in daily stock counting, reconciliation, and inventory record-keeping.
Ensure proper handling and storage of jewellery in the assigned section.
Work Area & Product Display:

Ensure jewellery pieces are regularly refreshed and well-maintained.

Learn and support in-store marketing campaigns.
Assist in event management, in-store promotions, and exhibitions.
Participate in Below-the-Line (BTL) marketing activities for customer engagement.
Functional Responsibilities:
Receive training in multiple store functions such as packing, billing, purchasing, customer service, and jewellery handling.
Maintain a high level of integrity, professionalism, and customer trust.
Address customer queries and escalate unresolved concerns to senior staff.
Educational Qualification Graduation (Any Stream) or Plus 2 / PUC
Age Requirement 21-27 years
Experience Freshers are welcome; prior experience in retail or jewellery sales is a plus.
Salary Range As per Industry Standards (INR)

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
Job Summary
The Front Office Executive is responsible for managing patient registration, appointments, billing, queries, and report dispatch while ensuring a seamless patient experience and efficient front office operations. The role acts as the first point of contact for patients, doctors, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities
Manage front office operations, patient registration, appointments, and billing activities.
Welcome patients and visitors, address enquiries, and provide prompt support for patient-related concerns.
Coordinate with doctors, technicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to ensure smooth patient flow and service delivery.
Handle incoming calls, emails, messages, and appointment requests professionally while maintaining confidentiality.
Maintain accurate records of patient registrations, appointments, billing information, and report dispatch in the designated systems.
Ensure timely collection of payments, documentation of corporate cases, and daily cash reconciliation.
Assist patients with test appointments, doctor consultations, report collection, and emergency requirements.
Ensure compliance with company policies, operational SOPs, and patient data confidentiality standards.
Maintain a professional, customer-centric environment at the reception and waiting area.

Desired Candidate Profile
Graduate in any discipline.
2-4 years of experience in front office, patient relations, customer service, or healthcare operations.
Strong understanding of healthcare processes, medical terminology, and patient handling practices.
Good knowledge of billing, appointment management, and hospital/diagnostic centre operations.
Proficient in MS Office and hospital/diagnostic management systems.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
Ability to multitask, resolve patient concerns, and work effectively under pressure with attention to detail.

Key Competencies
Customer Service Excellence
Communication & Interpersonal Skills
Patient Relationship Management
Attention to Detail
Multitasking & Time Management
Problem Solving
Professionalism & Confidentiality
Team Collaboration

Within 3 years we could confidently open a second Center at Siliguri, in North Bengal, which remains the largest such facility in the region, and today serves not only to patients from North Bengal, but also neighbouring States and countries. Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.

Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.

Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.

Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.

Description:
Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.
Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation plans, and deployment strategies to ensure timely project completion.
Supervise site execution activities, including civil, structural, electrical, module mounting, inverter installation, cabling, and earthing works.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, vendors, contractors, and site teams to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Manage project costs, control expenses, and ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, quality procedures, and project specifications.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government authorities, DISCOMs, and other stakeholders for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and project-related clearances.
Monitor installation, testing, commissioning, and performance verification of solar PV systems.
Identify project risks, resolve site-level technical and operational issues, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and cost overruns.
Conduct regular site visits and review contractor performance, work progress, safety practices, and quality of execution.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, MIS, budget updates, and management review reports.
Ensure proper documentation of drawings, material records, inspection reports, commissioning certificates, and project handover documents.
Coordinate with the operations and maintenance team for smooth project handover and resolution of pending issues.
Lead and manage project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors to achieve project delivery targets.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of solar PV systems, solar EPC execution, and project management.
Experience in project planning, site execution, commissioning, and contractor management.
Knowledge of electrical systems, solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, and grid connectivity.
Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling, cost estimation, and project reporting.
Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.
AboutCompany:
Company Profile:
Surya International Enterprise Pvt Ltd, the CRISIL BBB rated flagship company of Surya Group, is a multifaceted conglomerate operating in diverse fields such as Solar Energy, Manufacturing, Water Industry, Plastic Recycling, and Fintech. Our core mission is to provide sustainable and affordable green energy and water solutions through cutting-edge technology.
Surya Group has been on an exceptional growth trajectory for over a decade, achieving remarkable operational and financial milestones. With a net worth exceeding 125 Crores and an annual turnover of 325 Crores in the last financial year, our growth story is a testament to our unwavering commitment to excellence.
Over the past 10 years, we have successfully installed more than 100MW of on-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar power plants, solidifying our position as a leader in the renewable energy sector. Additionally, we have made significant strides in improving access to clean water by installing over 40,000 solar streetlights, 5,000 solar-powered water pumping systems, and 300 MLD of iron, fluoride, and arsenic water treatment plants, benefiting more than 10 lakh rural households.
Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Gurgaon, Coimbatore, Katihar, and Gaya produce high-quality products such as Lithium-Ion batteries, HDPE Tanks, HDPE & PVC Pipes, FRP vessels, Recycled Plastic Granules, and LLDP powder, among others. Furthermore, we have established a Mega Factory in the heart of Infovalley-2 EMC Park in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to the production of high-quality solar modules. Additionally, we have another mega factory in the Ghiloth Industrial Area, Rajasthan, further expanding our manufacturing capabilities.
At Surya Group, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment that encourages innovation and growth. As an equal opportunity employer, we value the diverse perspectives and experiences of our skilled workforce, which spans around 500 employees across India, with 170 employees based at our Head Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Our geographical presence extends to various states, including Odisha, Delhi, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam, Tripura, Mizoram, Kolkata, and Kerala, among others.
We invite talented individuals to join our dynamic and purpose-driven team, where they can contribute to our mission of creating a sustainable future while advancing their careers in a supportive and inclusive environment.
For more information, please visit www.groupsurya.co.in and www.solar2roof.com.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research,design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iteratethe design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM, Agartala, to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) & Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based at the concerned blocks of Tripura, work closely with block officials of TRLM and will report to the Program Lead.

What will you do
Understand and practice the values and spirit of The/Nudge Institute and the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
Identify and select vulnerable women in the designated project geographies across the state.
Mobilize vulnerable women into hamlet-level groups and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Support the selection, placement, and capacity building of community cadres from local villages/Gram Panchayats to provide intensive handholding and facilitation support to targeted vulnerable women and their households.
Facilitate vulnerable households access to eligible government entitlements and social security schemes by leveraging convergence platforms, including community cadres, community institutions, social capital, block-level line departments, and internal convergence mechanisms within the SRLM.
Facilitate livelihood planning for targeted households and support them in accessing formal credit and loans through community institutions to establish and strengthen livelihood activities.
Strengthen the capacities of community institutions and community cadres to ensure the long-term well-being of vulnerable women by fostering community ownership through the communitization process.
Ensure that all project activities are implemented on time and with the highest quality, in accordance with the approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Package of Practices (PoPs), and Community Operational Manual (COM).
Ensure the timely collection, entry, processing, analysis, and reporting of program data.
Develop case studies and contribute contextualized content to strengthen the programs knowledge management initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with grassroots stakeholders to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration.
What s in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Problem-Solving Government experience field operations business development Communication Skills Data Analysis Documentation Skills better, together

Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based in Tripura and will report to the Program Lead.


Responsibilities
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the Block professionals.
Manage Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and cont. feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge's financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the SRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support TRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the extremely vulnerable families through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the DAY-NRLM
Support TRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in extreme poverty.
Support TRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Tripura such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the extremely vulnerable


What's in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Description:
About the role
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead strategic engagements with government and ecosystem stakeholders across education, skilling, vocational education and others. The role will involve working closely with senior government officials to understand priorities, identify system-level opportunities, design and drive high-impact interventions, and translate evidence into actionable policy and program decisions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of government systems, excellent stakeholder management skills, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and a strong bias for execution. They should be comfortable operating at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and be able to move seamlessly between strategic discussions with senior bureaucrats and ground-level implementation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Government engagement & strategic partnerships
Build and manage trusted relationships with senior government officials across education, skilling, and other adjacent domains.
Engage with senior bureaucrats and department leadership to understand priorities, decision cycles, institutional constraints and emerging opportunities.
Represent the organisation in strategic discussions with state and central government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industry bodies, employers and other ecosystem stakeholders.
Act as a strategic thought partner to government stakeholders, bringing evidence, insights and practical recommendations to support policy and program decisions.
Identify opportunities to align organisational interventions with government priorities, schemes, budgets and existing institutional structures.
2. Strategy, policy & program design
Lead the design and execution of large-scale education and skilling programs in partnership with government, private sector and philanthropy.
Analyse government policies, schemes, budgets and implementation frameworks to identify opportunities for convergence, optimisation and system-level innovation.
Develop strategies and program models that address challenges across education, skilling, employability, placement and workforce outcomes.
Drive evidence-backed policy advocacy and support government stakeholders in translating insights into actionable reforms.
Work with leadership to develop proposals, partnership models and new program opportunities across states, central government and thematic areas.
3. Data, research & evidence
Translate large and complex datasets into actionable insights for government decision-makers and organisational leadership.
Develop analytical frameworks, policy briefs, dashboards, visual reports and presentations that enable real-time decision-making.
Lead research and ecosystem assessments to understand implementation bottlenecks, user needs and opportunities for reform.
Build evidence bases around outcomes such as learning, skilling, employability, placement, wages and workforce participation.
Use data and field evidence to identify course corrections and strengthen program design and implementation.
4. Program execution & impact
Own delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programs from strategy and design through implementation and scale-up.
Work closely with internal teams across product, technology, analytics, training and program delivery to ensure timely and integrated execution.
Monitor program milestones, risks, dependencies and impact indicators, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
Lead impact articulation through clear measurement, reporting and documentation frameworks.
Ensure that learnings from implementation are systematically captured and translated into improvements in program strategy and delivery.
5. Field engagement & implementation intelligence
Conduct regular field visits to understand implementation realities, frontline needs and stakeholder experiences.
Engage with teachers, trainers, students, administrators, employers and other actors to gather ground-level intelligence.
Bring field insights into policy discussions, program design and strategic decision-making.
Identify gaps between policy intent and implementation and develop practical recommendations to address them.
6. Communication & thought leadership
Develop compelling narratives, presentations and communication materials that connect field evidence, policy priorities and program outcomes.
Communicate complex insights clearly to senior government and internal leadership.
Publish articles, reports and thought pieces that showcase organisational learning and insights from the education and skilling ecosystem.
Represent the organisation in relevant forums, conferences and ecosystem discussions.
7. Growth & ecosystem development
Identify and shape new opportunities across state government departments and relevant thematic areas.
Build relationships with ecosystem organisations to broaden policy recommendations and enable adoption.
Work with leadership to identify potential partnerships, funding opportunities and pathways for scaling successful models.
Qualifications & Experience
8+ years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, public policy, government advisory, program management, education, skilling or other relevant domains.
MBA, Master s in Public Policy, Development Studies, Education or a related field preferred.
Demonstrated experience working with government stakeholders, with government engagement experience being essential.
Prior experience managing relationships with senior bureaucrats, ideally at the level of Principal Secretary/Secretary/Director and above in State Government.
Experience in designing or implementing large-scale, multi-stakeholder programs in partnership with government.
Strong understanding of government schemes, policies, institutional structures, decision-making processes and budgetary mechanisms.
Experience leveraging technology, digital platforms, data products or Digital Public Infrastructure for social impact is highly desirable.
Demonstrated experience in using data and evidence to influence policy or program decisions.
Experience leading teams and managing complex programs with multiple stakeholders.
What we are looking for
Strategic thinker with a strong execution bias - able to move from a high-level problem statement to concrete action.
High ownership and initiative - comfortable taking responsibility for ambiguous problems and charting a path forward.
Strong government orientation - able to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior public-sector stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills - able to synthesise diverse information into clear recommendations.
Strong communication skills - able to communicate effectively with senior bureaucrats, frontline stakeholders and internal teams.
Collaborative leader who can work across multidisciplinary teams and bring diverse stakeholders together.
Data-driven and impact-oriented, with a demonstrated commitment to improving education, skilling and employment outcomes.
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous and evolving environments, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Why this role
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of government, technology, data and social impact, and to contribute to reforms that can influence education and skilling outcomes at scale. The role offers significant ownership in shaping government partnerships, translating evidence into policy and program decisions, and taking high-impact interventions from strategy to implementation to scale.

3–6 Months

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .
Assist students in identifying appropriate undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, certificate, professional, and other academic programmes.
Research colleges, universities, courses, entrance examinations, admission requirements, scholarships, and other educational opportunities from reliable sources.
Assist applicants in completing admission applications and organizing required documents within the scope of the company s admission consultancy services.
Review applications and supporting documents for completeness before submission where such assistance forms part of the assigned service.
Keep applicants informed about application requirements, important dates, pending documents, and other relevant admission-related updates.
Conduct counselling sessions with students and parents through face-to-face meetings, telephone, email, WhatsApp, and online communication platforms.
Respond professionally to admission-related enquiries received through the company s website, telephone, email, social media, and walk-in visits.
Explain the company s admission guidance and consultancy services clearly to prospective students and parents.
Follow up with prospective applicants regarding counselling sessions, applications, documentation, and other pending requirements.
Maintain accurate records of enquiries, counselling sessions, prospective applicants, applications, admissions, and follow-ups.
Update CRM systems, spreadsheets, online forms, and other internal record-management systems.
Communicate with colleges, universities, and other educational institutions when required and appropriately authorized.
Verify important admission information through official or reliable sources before communicating it to applicants.
Maintain current knowledge of courses, admission procedures, eligibility requirements, entrance examinations, and developments in higher education.
Participate in admission campaigns, educational events, student counselling programmes, seminars, workshops, and other company activities when required.
Maintain the confidentiality of students personal, academic, and application-related information.
Prepare periodic reports on enquiries, counselling sessions, applications, admissions, and follow-up activities.
Perform other reasonable admission-guidance and student-support duties assigned by the company.


Educational Qualification
Bachelor s Degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
Candidates should also possess:
Good understanding of the Indian education and higher-education system.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and counselling abilities.
Ability to communicate professionally with students and parents.
Basic computer proficiency.
Working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, email, online forms, and internet research.
Ability to independently search for and verify admission-related information.
Good organizational and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualification
Preference may be given to candidates possessing one or more of the following:
Master s Degree in any discipline.
Degree or postgraduate qualification in Education, Psychology, Management, Social Sciences, Humanities, Commerce, or a related discipline.
Certification or training in Academic Counselling, Admission Counselling, Career Counselling, Guidance Counselling, or Student Counselling.
Previous experience in admission consultancy or academic counselling.
Previous experience working with a college, university, educational institution, coaching centre, or education consultancy.
Familiarity with university admission processes, entrance examinations, and higher-education programmes.
Freshers with excellent communication, counselling, and interpersonal skills are also encouraged to apply.

Language Skills
Good communication skills in English are required.
Ability to communicate effectively in Bengali and/or Hindi will be an advantage for counselling students and parents.


Experience
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates with previous experience in admission counselling, academic counselling, educational consultancy, student services, or a related field may be given preference.


Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate should:
Be genuinely interested in higher education and student counselling.
Enjoy interacting with students and parents.
Have patience and good listening skills.
Be able to understand individual student requirements.
Be able to explain admission procedures clearly and accurately.
Be comfortable conducting one-to-one counselling sessions.
Have good internet research and information-verification skills.
Be organized and capable of managing multiple applicants and follow-ups.
Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality.
Be willing to continuously learn about courses, universities, admission requirements, and changes in the higher-education sector.


Professional Ethical Requirements
The Academic Consultant must provide admission information accurately, responsibly, and transparently .
The consultant must not make false or misleading representations regarding any college, university, educational institution, regulatory authority, accreditation, affiliation, or the company s relationship with an institution.
The consultant must not guarantee admission, scholarships, examination results, placements, employment, visas, or any other outcome unless such an outcome is expressly guaranteed in writing by the relevant authorized institution or organization.
Students should be supported in making their own informed educational decisions based on accurate information about available options.

Description:
URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
Contact 639865 2832
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3 Lakhs - 3.5 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Description:
The selcted candidate will be responsible for conducting student assessments, supporting counselling activities, documenting findings, and coordinating with educational institutions and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Student Assessment
Conduct student assessments using approved assessment tools and methodologies.
Administer questionnaires, aptitude assessments, interest inventories, and other prescribed instruments.
Ensure assessments are conducted fairly, accurately, and confidentially.
Maintain individual student assessment records.
Student Counselling and Guidance
Provide age-appropriate educational and career guidance based on assessment findings.
Help students understand their strengths, interests, learning needs, and educational opportunities.
Conduct individual and group guidance sessions as required.
Refer students requiring specialised psychological or mental health support to appropriately qualified professionals through the approved referral process.
Field Coordination
Coordinate with schools, teachers, school authorities, and designated project officials.
Organise assessment schedules and student counselling sessions.
Support awareness and orientation programmes.
Travel to assigned schools and field locations within the designated block.
Documentation and Reporting
Maintain accurate student assessment and counselling records.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
Enter assessment data into prescribed digital platforms or reporting formats.
Ensure confidentiality and responsible handling of student information.
Submit reports to the Project Coordinator or designated authority.
Essential Qualification
Graduate degree in any of the following:
Education
Human Resources
Psychology
A related field

Preferred Skills and Experience
Experience in student assessment, counselling, education, career guidance, or school-based projects.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work with school students sensitively and professionally.
Basic computer proficiency, including MS Excel, online forms, and digital reporting.
Ability to organise field activities independently.
Knowledge of Bengali is compulsory.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned block.

We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).

Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.

Description:
Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.
Required Qualifications
Educational Qualification: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Professional Experience: Preferably 1-5 years of relevant web-development experience, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Portfolio: Candidates should be able to demonstrate their technical abilities through a portfolio, live websites, GitHub projects, previous professional work, or practical technical assessment.
Required Technical Skills
JavaScript / TypeScript, PHP and/or Node.js, WordPress, Elementor, MySQL / PostgreSQL, Responsive Web Design, UI/UX Fundamentals, Website Deployment, Domain and DNS Management, cPanel / WHM, VPS and Cloud Hosting, SSL Configuration, Website Migration and Backups, Website Security, Website Speed and Performance Optimization, Git / Version-Control Fundamentals.
Knowledge of React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, AWS, Vercel, Cloudflare, headless CMS platforms, APIs, e-commerce platforms, payment-gateway integrations, and related modern web technologies will be an advantage.
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate professionally with clients.
Good networking and interpersonal skills.
Ability to independently manage assigned projects.
Strong time-management and organizational abilities.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
Ability to work effectively as part of a professional team.
Ability to train and mentor others.
Professional discipline, punctuality, and accountability.
Candidates with strong networking, communication, and client-acquisition skills will be preferred.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary: Negotiable based on the candidate s qualifications, relevant experience, portfolio, technical expertise, interview performance, and technical assessment.
Performance Incentives: Additional incentives may be provided for successfully procured and eligible client projects in accordance with organizational policy.
Work Environment: Professional, collaborative, and technology-focused environment with exposure to website development, hosting, digital operations, client projects, research-related platforms, and modern web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Application screening.
CV and portfolio evaluation.
Shortlisting.
Interview.
Technical assessment and/or practical web-development task.
Final selection.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for the interview/selection process.
Candidates demonstrating strong technical expertise, professional communication skills, independent project-handling ability, and good networking skills will be preferred.
Important
This vacancy is for a FULL-TIME, DESK-BASED POSITION IN AGARTALA, TRIPURA.
Candidates should apply only if they are available to work full-time in Agartala, Tripura and can maintain regular attendance, professional discipline, and availability during assigned working hours.

Oversee installation of accessibility features such as ramps, accessible toilets, railings, and
