Description:
Job Summary
The Senior People Officer is the experienced HR generalist within NagaEd, responsible for managing the applicant tracking system (ATS) pipeline, maintaining HR documentation and policies, administering compliance filings, and supporting the full employee lifecycle with growing independence. This role bridges the gap between administrative HR execution and strategic people operations handling complex HR processes that require judgement, accuracy, and a working knowledge of Indian employment practice. Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Senior People Officer takes ownership of HR processes rather than simply executing them. Where the People Officer handles coordination and data entry, this role manages the ATS pipeline end-to-end, drafts and maintains HR policy documents, prepares compliance filings, conducts initial screening of candidates, supports performance review administration, and serves as a knowledgeable resource on HR processes for the wider team. The Senior People Officer also provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate on shared workflows. Success in this role is measured by the quality and currency of HR documentation, the integrity of recruitment and employee data, the timeliness of compliance filings, and the ability to manage HR processes independently while knowing when to escalate.


Job Details
Department: Operations
Direct Reports: None (provides task-level guidance to People Officer / People Associate)
Manager: Operations Manager
Mentor/support: Operations Manager
Location: Kohima


Organisational Unit Function
ATS Pipeline Recruitment Management: Manage the applicant tracking system maintaining pipeline stages, updating candidate statuses, and ensuring data integrity throughout the recruitment cycle. Conduct initial CV screening and shortlisting against position description criteria, preparing shortlist recommendations for the hiring manager and Operations Manager. Coordinate and support interview processes scheduling panels, preparing assessment materials, collecting interviewer scorecards, and compiling evaluation summaries. Draft offer letters, employment contracts, and pre-employment correspondence for the Operations Manager s review and approval. Maintain recruitment analytics time-to-fill, pipeline conversion rates, and source effectiveness and surface insights to the Operations Manager. Ensure a professional, timely, and consistent candidate experience across all touchpoints.
HR Documentation Policy Administration: Maintain, update, and version-control NagaEd s HR policy documents, SOPs, the Employee Handbook, and associated templates. Draft new HR policies and SOP updates as directed by the Operations Manager researching best practice and ensuring alignment with Indian employment law requirements. Ensure all employees have signed and acknowledged current versions of key HR documents employment contracts, NDAs, handbook acknowledgements, and code-of-conduct agreements. Manage the HR documentation lifecycle drafting, review routing, approval tracking, distribution, and archiving maintaining a clear audit trail. Prepare HR correspondence confirmation letters, role change notifications, warning letters, and other employee communications for the Operations Manager s review.
Compliance Filing Statutory Administration: Prepare and coordinate statutory compliance filings POSH annual returns, Shops and Establishments Act returns, Professional Tax, and other applicable filings in coordination with the Operations Manager and external advisors. Maintain compliance calendars and trackers, ensuring all filing deadlines are surfaced to the Operations Manager at least two weeks in advance. Support POSH compliance administration maintaining the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) register, scheduling mandatory awareness training, and tracking completion. Coordinate with the Senior Finance Officer on employee-related statutory matters EPF, ESIC, and TDS records ensuring consistency between HR and finance records. Prepare documentation for labour inspections, audits, and regulatory queries as required.
Employee Lifecycle Records Management: Manage the HRIS (Zoho People or equivalent) employee master data, employment history, contract records, probation dates, and lifecycle milestones. Administer the probation review cycle tracking probation end dates, sending reminders to reviewing managers, compiling review documentation, and preparing confirmation or extension letters. Process employee changes promotions, transfers, reporting line updates, and salary revisions ensuring all changes are documented, filed, and reflected in HR systems. Maintain accurate and complete personnel files for all employees, ensuring audit readiness at all times. Administer the offboarding process exit checklists, knowledge transfer coordination, access revocation, final settlement documentation, and exit interview scheduling.
Performance Management Engagement Support: Support performance review cycles distributing review templates, tracking submission deadlines, compiling completed reviews, and maintaining performance records. Administer the goal-setting and OKR/KPI tracking process, ensuring all employees have current documented goals and that review cadences are maintained. Support the Operations Manager in running engagement initiatives pulse surveys, recognition programmes, team events, and feedback mechanisms. Compile and analyse HR data for engagement reporting participation rates, survey results, and trend tracking presenting summaries to the Operations Manager.
Leave, Attendance Payroll Coordination: Oversee leave and attendance management reviewing leave records for accuracy, resolving discrepancies, and maintaining up-to-date leave balances. Prepare monthly payroll inputs attendance summaries, leave adjustments, new joiner and leaver details, and variable components for handoff to the finance function. Respond to employee queries on leave policy, entitlements, and attendance with accuracy and in a timely manner.
Team Coordination Task Guidance: Provide day-to-day task-level guidance and quality checks to the People Officer and People Associate on recruitment coordination, data entry, filing, and onboarding logistics. Serve as the first escalation point for HR process queries from NagaEd staff before matters reach the Operations Manager. Ensure continuity of people operations during the Operations Manager s absence by maintaining standing HR processes and escalation protocols.


Reporting Relationships
This role reports directly to the Operations Manager. The Senior People Officer works with all NagaEd staff and managers on HR processes, coordinates with external advisors on compliance matters, and collaborates with the finance function on payroll and statutory employee contributions. The role does not hold formal line-management authority but provides task-level guidance to the People Officer and People Associate.


Selection Criteria
This role requires an experienced HR generalist who can manage multiple HR processes with accuracy and growing independence. The Senior People Officer must have a working knowledge of Indian employment practice, be comfortable drafting HR documents, and be able to exercise judgement on routine HR matters while knowing when to escalate.


Essential
Minimum 2 3 years of experience in HR generalist, HR administration, or people operations roles.
Working knowledge of Indian employment law fundamentals leave entitlements, POSH obligations, statutory filings, employment contract requirements.
Experience managing an ATS or structured recruitment pipeline.
Strong documentation and writing skills able to draft policies, SOPs, employment letters.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Summary
Lead UPSC Faculty (General Studies)
Location: Chandigarh (Offline Centre)
Employment Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
Join one of Chandigarhs top IAS academies as full-time UPSC Faculty and help make quality civil-services preparation affordable for every aspirant.


Subjects
GS
Polity
History
Economy
Geography
Environment
Science and Technology
Ethics
CSAT
Current Affairs
Essay
International Relations


Join One of Indias Fastest Growing UPSC Institutes
At Naman Sharma IAS Academy , we are building a team of exceptional educators who are passionate about shaping the next generation of IAS, IPS, IFS, and other Civil Services officers.
If you have strong subject expertise, excellent teaching skills, and a genuine passion for mentoring UPSC aspirants, wed love to hear from you.


Your Role
As a Lead UPSC Faculty , you will play a key academic leadership role by:
Teaching General Studies subjects for UPSC CSE (Prelims Mains)
Building and leading our GS academic program
Developing and teaching Optional Subject batches (based on expertise)
Building and driving NCERT Foundation batches for beginners
Delivering engaging offline and online classes
Creating high-quality notes, tests, assignments, and answer-writing programs
Mentoring students through every stage of their UPSC preparation
Keeping content updated with the latest UPSC trends, PYQs, and current affairs


Requirements
Mandatory
Must have written the UPSC Civil Services Mains Examination
Strong command over UPSC subjects such as: Polity, History, Geography, Economy, Environment, Science Technology, Ethics, International Relations, Society, Governance
Excellent classroom communication skills in both English and Hindi
Strong conceptual clarity with the ability to simplify complex topics


Preferred
Appeared for the UPSC Personality Test (Interview)
Previous UPSC teaching experience
Experience mentoring aspirants for Prelims, Mains, or Interview
Ability to create high-quality academic content and test series

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
The incumbent shall be responsible for the end to end business HR delivery for the zone assigned to him/her. Leave and Attendance management for new joinees
HRIS: Required to maintain various HR MIS related to Hiring/Sourcing/Funnel/Employee engagement/attrition etc.
Publishing HR dashboards and attrition analysis data to business stakeholders.
Query and Grievance Management: As HR SPOC

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

About the Role: We are looking for detail-oriented and highly attentive candidates to assist in the Dispute Resolution and Usage confirmation by fleet vendors.

This is a critical role that ensures accuracy in vendor payments and helps maintain financial integrity in our fleet operations.
This position offers a unique opportunity to understand the cost control, and compliance in running large-scale logistics operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Verify & validate grievances raised by fleet vendors for accuracy and authenticity.
Cross-check billing claims with supporting documents to identify discrepancies and prevent duplicate payments.
Ensure all required receipts and supporting documents are available before approving payments.
Maintain detailed records of all validated grievances and highlight any missing or incorrect submissions.
Work closely with the Fleet and Finance teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely processing of payments.
Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure compliance and prevent financial risks.

Who Should Apply?
Have strong attention to detail and can spot errors or inconsistencies in documents.
Are highly responsible and diligent in handling financial records.
Have basic knowledge of finance, accounting, or logistics (preferred but not mandatory).
Are proficient in MS Excel/Google Sheets for data validation and record-keeping.
Are eager to learn about financial compliance in logistics operations.
Can work with minimal supervision and ensure accuracy in high-volume data processing.
Having strong communication skills to deal with fleet vendors and the operation team.


What You Will Learn?

Importance of documentation in logistics billing and vendor payments.
How cost validation impacts fleet operations and financial efficiency.
Hands-on experience in financial audits and compliance in logistics.
Problem-solving and analytical skills in identifying billing discrepancies.

Position Title: Area HR Partner- Upper North (Third Party Contractual)

Reports to: Lead HR Retail (North and East)

Note: This role is on one year contract. Based on performance we can convert this role on-rolls, but if not then after one year the contract will terminate after one year

Location: Chandigarh (First two months in Gurgaon office)

Position Summary:
The Retail HR role partners closely with retail operations to support people-related initiatives across stores. The role focuses on driving hiring, employee engagement, capability development, and compliance while building a strong connect with store teams and supporting the overall employee experience in the region

Key Objectives:
Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle for retail employees including recruitment, onboarding, engagement initiatives, training and development, and exit interviews.
Drive hiring across retail stores by identifying and leveraging both internal and external recruitment sources to ensure timely closure of open positions.
Partner with retail operations stakeholders and store managers to understand manpower requirements and support people-related decisions across stores.
Assess behavioral and capability development needs of store employees and coordinate relevant training programs with internal or external trainers.
Plan and manage the monthly employee engagement calendar across stores to strengthen employee connect and morale.
Coordinate and ensure timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs for retail employees.
Conduct regular store visits to interact with employees, gather feedback, understand on-ground challenges, and support resolution of employee concerns.
Track attrition trends and employee feedback across stores and work with business leaders to drive retention and employee experience initiatives.
Ensure effective implementation of company policies across stores and monitor compliance with statutory requirements, including maintenance of statutory registers and documentation.
Actively participate in various company forums and people initiatives within the organization.

Eligibility Criteria and Functional Competencies Required:
MBA / PGDM students specializing in HR or related fields.
2-4 years of HR experience, preferably in retail, hospitality, or other customer-facing industries.
Prior experience in managing store hiring, employee engagement, and HR operations will be an advantage.
Good communication and coordination skills.
Working knowledge of MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work with multiple stakeholders.

Delhivery is Indias leading fulfillment platform for digital commerce. With its nationwide network extending beyond 18,000 pin codes and 2,500 cities, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 550 million transactions since inception and today works with over 10,000 direct customers, which includes large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and over 350 leading enterprises & brands.

Vision- Since its inception in 2011, Delhivery has become Indias leading supply chain services company. Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.

Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 40,000+ people strong.

Role Details: Designation : Associate
Mode:Work from Office (6 Days working)
Location - Chandigarh and Gurgaon

Job Description: The Client Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Key Responsibilities:

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring
Analyzeandsupport with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business Required Skills and competencies
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand

Review documents, emails, and datasets as part of data breach review projects.

Conduct quality control and quality assurance checks to ensure review accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
Validate review decisions against established project protocols and client guidelines.
Escalate exceptions, inconsistencies, and complex findings to project leads.
Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable data security requirements.
Meet defined productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.

LL.B. degree from a recognized university.
6-12 months of experience in data breach review, document review, eDiscovery, or a similar legal review role.
Strong attention to detail and analytical ability.
Ability to review large volumes of information accurately and efficiently.
Good written communication and documentation skills.
Ability to work effectively in a deadline-driven environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Preferred Experience
Exposure to data breach review matters.
Understanding of PII, PHI, financial information, and other sensitive data categories.
Experience performing quality checks or second-level reviews.
Familiarity with document review platforms or legal technology tools.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Description:
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career
.Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking ForExperience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development.
Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process
- Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.
- Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.
- Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.
- Networks with local organizations (eg, Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.
- Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.
- Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.
Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits
- Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.
- Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.
- Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.
Assisting in Managing Employee Development
- Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Ensures employees are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
- Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.
- Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs
- Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations
- Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (eg, develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property-wide meetings).
- Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.
- Utilizes an open door policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner
- Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi-Property Director of Human Resources.
- Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices
- Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.
- Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.
- Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.
- Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).
- Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.
- Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (eg, property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc
- Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.
- Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Admin Support
Position Title: Admin Support
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Minimum Qualification: Graduate (mandatory)
Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.

Description:
Accountable for overall success of the daily kitchen operations.
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the ficial performance in all areas of responsibility.
Supervises all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (eg, banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (eg, dish room and purchasing).
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Leads kitchen management team.
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.
- Ensures disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to executive teams, managers and supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders across levels.

About the Role
We are seeking a skilled and proactive MEP Engineer with 4- 5 years of experience in executing and coordinating Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works for industrial food factory projects across India. Key Responsibilities
Mechanical
Supervise installation and execution of HVAC, ventilation, firefighting, boiler, ETP, gas distribution systems, utility piping, and other mechanical services.

Experience in industrial project site execution and coordination.

Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple site activities and work under project deadlines.
Qualifications

4-5 years of relevant experience in MEP execution.
Experience in industrial or commercial construction projects is preferred.
Willingness to travel and work at project sites across PAN India.

AutoCAD
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
MS Project
MEP drafting and coordination software (preferred)
ERP/project management software (added advantage)
Why Join Us?
Opportunity to work on large-scale industrial food factory projects across India.
Exposure to end-to-end MEP execution and multidisciplinary coordination.
Dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Operational & Surgical Management
Schedule & Flow: Coordinate daily surgical lists, elective/emergency cases, and room turnaround times to minimize delays and cancellations. 
Patient Safety: Enforce the WHO/NABH surgical safety checklist (Sign-In, Time-Out, Sign-Out), correct patient identification, consent verifications, and safe handover protocols. 
Emergency Preparedness: Maintain readiness for trauma or clinical emergencies inside and outside the OT. 
2. NABH Compliance & Infection Control
Sterilization & Asepsis: Monitor air-handling units (AHU / laminar flow), positive pressure, temperature/humidity logs, and CSSD (Central Sterile Supply Department) sterilization indicators. 
Biomedical Waste (BMW): Ensure strict compliance with national biomedical waste management rules (segregation, color-coding, and safe disposal). 
Audits & Documentation: Maintain accurate OT registers, anaesthesia records, implant tracking logs, incident reporting, and audit trails required for NABH accreditations. 
3. Equipment & Inventory Management
Equipment Upkeep: Oversee preventive maintenance, calibration, and quick repair coordination for high-end surgical and anesthesia equipment.
Stock & Expiry Control: Monitor consumable inventory, emergency drugs, surgical instruments, and implant availability; prevent stock-outs or expired items.
4. Human Resource & Staff Management
Duty Rosters: Prepare shift schedules, leave plans, and on-call rosters for OT nurses, OT technicians, and housekeeping staff.
Training & Competency: Conduct regular drills, biomedical safety trainings, and mandatory continuing education for OT personnel. 
5. Interdepartmental Coordination
Liaise closely with surgeons, anesthesiologists, ICU, Wards, CSSD, Blood Bank, and Pharmacy to ensure seamless patient transit and care. 
Qualifications & Experience
Education: B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) or a relevant healthcare administration degree; specialized postgraduate credentials or diplomas in hospital/OT management are an added advantage.
Experience: 6 to 10+ years of hands-on experience in operation theatre operations, with at least 2–3 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity. Prior experience working in a NABH or JCI-accredited hospital is typically mandatory or strongly preferred.

Description:
Hiring: Field Officer / Centre Manager Microfinance
Position: Field Officer / Centre Manager
Industry: Microfinance / Financial Services
Location: Bihar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 0–3 years (Freshers can also apply for Field Officer roles)
Job Description
We are looking for Field Officers / Centre Managers to join our microfinance operations in Bihar. The candidate will be responsible for managing customers/groups, conducting field visits, ensuring timely loan repayments, and supporting business growth while maintaining high service and compliance standards.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct regular field visits and customer meetings.
Identify and onboard new customers and form JLG/SHG groups.
Explain loan products, repayment schedules and company policies to customers.
Conduct customer verification and ensure proper KYC/documentation.
Manage centre meetings and maintain customer relationships.
Ensure timely collection of loan instalments.
Follow up on overdue accounts and maintain portfolio quality.
Monitor customer repayment behaviour and identify potential risks.
Resolve customer queries and complaints professionally.
Maintain accurate records and submit daily/weekly reports.
Achieve assigned business and collection targets.
Follow company policies, ethical collection practices and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Candidate Profile
Minimum 12th pass / Graduate preferred.
Experience in microfinance, banking, NBFC, sales or field collection will be an advantage.
Freshers with good communication skills may apply for Field Officer positions.
Good communication and customer-handling skills.
Basic knowledge of smartphones and mobile applications.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned area.
Knowledge of Hindi and local language/dialect preferred.
Candidates should be target-oriented, responsible and comfortable working in rural/semi-urban areas.

Description:
Job Summary
The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities

Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.


Data Interpretation Business Performance Management
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.


Interaction with Stakeholders
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.)


Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS, PowerBi, Compass, Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
