Description:
Job Summary
The AVP – Medical Coding Quality will provide strategic and operational leadership to the organization's medical coding Quality function, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality, compliant, and efficient coding services across multiple specialties and client engagements.
The role will be responsible for establishing robust quality governance frameworks, driving coding accuracy and audit effectiveness, optimizing quality assurance resources, and leading continuous improvement initiatives.
The incumbent will work closely with Operations, Training, Technology, and Client Services leadership to strengthen coding quality, improve operational efficiency, enhance client satisfaction, and support organizational growth.
The role will also drive quality transformation through AI-assisted auditing, automation, and data-driven performance management while developing a strong quality leadership pipeline.
The AVP will have direct accountability for the effectiveness of the Quality Assurance function and joint accountability with Coding Operations for overall coding quality performance and achievement of client quality SLAs.
 Key Goals
       Develop and execute a comprehensive medical coding quality strategy across offshore operations, ensuring consistent achievement of client quality standards and contractual SLAs.
       Establish a robust, scalable, and standardized Quality Assurance Program across multiple specialties, business units, and client engagements.
       Drive continuous improvement in coding accuracy, audit effectiveness, compliance, and operational efficiency through structured quality governance and risk management.
       Partner with Coding Operations leadership to jointly own overall coding quality outcomes, with clearly defined responsibilities for audit effectiveness, coder performance, corrective actions, and SLA achievement.
       Optimize QA capacity, audit coverage, resource utilization, and cost efficiency while maintaining service delivery commitments.
       Strengthen collaboration with Operations and Training teams to identify recurring coding errors, implement corrective and preventive actions, and achieve sustainable quality improvements.
       Lead quality-side adoption, validation, and governance of AI-assisted auditing and automation solutions in collaboration with Technology teams.
       Enhance client satisfaction through proactive quality management, transparent reporting, timely resolution of escalations, and continuous improvement.
       Build a high-performing quality leadership team through talent development, succession planning, and performance management.
       Ensure effective management of the QA operating budget and drive measurable improvements in cost efficiency without compromising quality standards.
 Job Profile
Quality Function
       Provide strategic and operational leadership to a QA organization of 350+ auditors through a structured management hierarchy, ensuring capability, productivity, accountability, and scalable delivery.
       Develop and implement organization-wide quality strategies, governance frameworks, policies, and standardized audit methodologies aligned with business objectives and client requirements.
       Oversee quality management for OP (ED/SDS/ANC/OBV), ProFee Surgery & EM, HCC, Home Health and IP DRG projects.
       Ensure consistent achievement of coding quality standards, client-specific requirements, and contractual SLAs across all assigned engagements.
       Exercise direct ownership of audit quality, audit accuracy, audit coverage, and QA process effectiveness, while sharing accountability for overall coding quality outcomes with Coding Operations.
       Own QA workforce planning, audit coverage strategy, resource utilization, productivity management, and cost optimization aligned with business growth and client requirements.
       Drive effective implementation, monitoring, and adherence to the organization's Quality Management System (QMS).
       Establish enterprise quality dashboards and governance mechanisms to monitor coding accuracy, audit effectiveness, defect trends, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
       Establish second-level audit, inter-auditor calibration, and audit dispute resolution frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and defensibility of audit findings.
       Lead structured Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) programs, with defined accountability, closure timelines, and verification of sustained improvements.
       Identify systemic quality risks, coding error patterns, and process gaps, and implement proactive measures to prevent recurrence.
       Ensure adherence to applicable ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, official coding guidelines, client-specific coding requirements, and relevant compliance standards.
       Collaborate with Operations and Training leadership to identify competency gaps, develop targeted training interventions, and monitor improvements in coding performance.
       Develop risk-based audit methodologies to prioritize high-risk specialties, complex accounts, new coders, and recurring error categories.
       Lead quality readiness assessments for new client implementations, specialty expansions, process transitions, and operational scale-up.
       Establish performance management frameworks for Quality Managers, Leads, and Auditors, promoting accountability, professional development, and leadership succession.
       Drive QA productivity improvements and reduce the cost of poor quality through optimized audit processes, improved resource utilization, and reduction of avoidable rework.
       Foster a high-performance quality culture through leadership development, employee engagement, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration.
 AI, Automation & Quality Transformation
Lead the identification and prioritization of opportunities for AI-assisted auditing, quality automation, predictive analytics, and workflow optimization.
Define functional requirements, audit validation criteria, and quality acceptance standards for AI-enabled auditing solutions in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
Own the quality-side evaluation and validation of AI-generated audit findings, including accuracy, consistency, reliability, and identification of false-positive and false-negative results.
Establish appropriate human review, exception management, and quality governance controls for automated auditing processes.
Partner with Technology teams responsible for solution development, technical implementation, system integration, and ongoing technical support.
Drive adoption of approved automation solutions across QA teams through training, process alignment, change management, and performance monitoring.
Measure the effectiveness of AI-assisted auditing through improvements in audit coverage, auditor productivity, turnaround time, and cost efficiency without compromising accuracy or compliance.
Ensure appropriate safeguards for patient data confidentiality, information security, and applicable client and regulatory requirements.
 Client Communication & Stakeholder Management
       Lead client-facing quality governance, executive business reviews, escalation management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
       Serve as a senior escalation point for critical coding quality concerns, audit disputes, and client-specific quality performance issues.
       Partner with Operations, Training, Technology, and Client Services leadership to align quality initiatives with client expectations and organizational objectives.
       Establish transparent client quality reporting mechanisms, including quality scorecards, error trend analysis, RCA findings, and corrective action updates.
       Drive timely closure of client escalations and monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures to prevent repeat occurrences.
       Collaborate with business leadership to support client retention, account expansion, and new business opportunities through strong quality performance and operational credibility.
       Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant documentation relating to medical coding, billing, quality assurance, and client audit requirements.
       Identify opportunities to strengthen client satisfaction, improve delivery consistency, and enhance the organization's value proposition through quality-led initiatives.
 Quality Performance & Business Excellence
       Define and monitor key quality performance indicators covering coding accuracy, audit effectiveness, SLA compliance, quality trends, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
       Drive measurable improvements in quality outcomes while balancing audit coverage, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness.
       Partner with operational leadership to identify and minimize quality-related revenue leakage, avoidable rework, and compliance risks.
       Lead business excellence initiatives focused on process standardization, workflow optimization, scalability, and quality transformation.
       Provide periodic quality performance, risk, resource utilization, and improvement updates to senior leadership.
       Establish a culture of continuous improvement through benchmarking, performance analytics, and adoption of industry best practices.
   Financial & Resource Management
       Own planning, monitoring, and optimization of the Medical Coding Quality function's operating budget within approved financial parameters.
       Establish efficient resource deployment models to balance audit coverage, quality risk, workload complexity, and client contractual requirements.
       Monitor QA productivity, auditor utilization, cost per audit, and other agreed efficiency measures.
       Identify cost-saving opportunities through workflow standardization, automation, improved staffing models, and reduction of non-value-added activities.
       Evaluate the business case and expected return on investment for quality improvement and automation initiatives.
       Partner with Finance and Operations to monitor quality-related costs and implement sustainable efficiency improvements.
       Maintain accountability for QA functional cost performance without assuming ownership of overall coding business profitability, which remains with the designated business leadership.
 People Leadership & Talent Development
       Lead and develop Quality Managers and other quality leadership personnel to ensure consistent operational execution and management effectiveness.
       Build a performance-driven culture focused on accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional excellence.
       Strengthening employee engagement and retention through career development, recognition, and structured performance management.
       Develop future-ready QA capabilities through upskilling in advanced coding specialties, audit methodologies, analytics, and AI-assisted quality processes.
 Educational Qualifications and Professional Certifications
       Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline.
       Strong understanding of US healthcare medical coding operations, quality assurance practices, and coding compliance requirements.
       AAPC or AHIMA certifications are mandatory
       Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt certification – highly preferred, with demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level quality improvement, process optimization, operational efficiency, and business transformation initiatives.
 Experience Requirements
Preferably 15+ years of overall experience in US healthcare medical coding, including substantial exposure to medical coding quality management.
Minimum 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in Coding Quality, Coding Operations, Audit Management, or related functions.
Strong experience in handling multi-specialty coding like inpatient DRG/outpatient facility/Risk adjustment/professional fee coding services.
Exposure to quality automation, AI-assisted auditing, analytics, and process transformation initiatives will be highly desirable.

The role is mainly in the field: visiting our corporate and government tie-up clients, keeping their beneficiaries informed, and resolving issues at the hospital end throughout all the Districts of Bihar.
Corporate and government client relations
Make regular, scheduled field visits to tie-up clients across Bihar, including CGHS, ECHS, FCI, SSB, CAPF, PSUs, banks, insurers/TPAs and other empanelled organizations.

Business development and marketing

Plan and run health camps, CMEs, community outreach and corporate wellness programmes.
Manage the hospital's brand, print and digital material, local media relations, and social media in coordination with the management.
Build referral relationships with doctors, clinics and nursing homes in the districts.
Public relations and patient experience
Represent the hospital at official meetings, events, and press interactions.
Handle complaints and escalations from tie-up clients and patients quickly and courteously.
Collect patient and client feedback, and report service gaps to management

Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.

Operating as a senior individual contributor, this role partners with Director and VP-level stakeholders across North America, Europe, and APAC to shape demand, influence sourcing strategies, and drive optimal commercial outcomes. The role is accountable for sourcing excellence, procurement governance, contract compliance, and continuous improvement across the source-to-pay lifecycle. Own complex sourcing initiatives aligned with business priorities, procurement KPIs, and committed outcomes. 2. Align sourcing activity with broader category, regional, and enterprise objectives. Operate effectively across time zones, particularly with North American and European stakeholders. 7. Job Description Factory / Plant Manager:
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Manager to lead the overall operations of our manufacturing plant. The role will be responsible for ensuring efficient production, quality, safety, regulatory compliance, cost control, and effective people management.
The incumbent will work closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Supply Chain, HR and other functions to ensure smooth and efficient plant operations while maintaining statutory and company standards.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Plant & Production Management
Lead end-to-end plant operations and ensure achievement of production targets.
Plan and monitor production schedules, capacity utilization and operational efficiency.
Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources.
Monitor production losses, downtime, wastage and overall plant productivity.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.
2. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance
Ensure adherence to applicable quality, food safety, statutory and regulatory requirements.
Ensure compliance with company SOPs, quality systems, safety standards and audit requirements.
Coordinate with Quality teams to maintain product quality and hygiene standards.
Ensure timely closure of observations arising from internal, external and regulatory audits.
Maintain necessary plant documentation, records and compliance requirements.
3. Maintenance & Engineering Coordination
Coordinate with Engineering/Maintenance teams to ensure maximum machine availability.
Monitor preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
Identify recurring equipment issues and drive corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure proper planning of maintenance activities without impacting production.
4. People Management
Lead, develop and manage plant employees across functions and shifts.
Ensure adequate manpower availability and effective manpower deployment.
Set clear performance expectations and monitor team performance.
Develop a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
Identify training and capability-building requirements for plant employees.
Handle employee-related operational issues in coordination with HR.
5. Stakeholder Management
Act as the key point of coordination between the plant and corporate functions.
Work closely with Quality, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Sales and other stakeholders.
Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, contractors and relevant authorities as required.
Ensure effective communication and timely resolution of operational issues.
6. Safety & Hygiene
Ensure strict adherence to plant safety, hygiene and housekeeping standards.
Drive awareness and compliance with safety procedures across the plant.
Identify potential safety risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions.
Promote a strong safety culture among employees and contractors.
7. Cost & Resource Management
Monitor plant operating costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Ensure efficient utilization of raw materials, packaging materials, utilities and manpower.
Monitor wastage, energy consumption and other key operating expenses.
Support budgeting and operational planning for the plant.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way youd like, where youll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where youll be able to reimagine whats possible. Join us and help the worlds leading organizations


Your Role

We are hiring Workdaycertified Functional Consultants with strong handson experience in Workday HCM to support implementations, enhancements, and production support for global clients and business units.
You will be responsible for one or more of the following modules: Core HCM, Absence Management, Compensation, Talent Performance, Recruiting, and Benefits.
Configure and support Workday Core HCM and assigned functional modules
Work on Business Process Framework (BPF), Security, Job Architecture, and Calculated Fields
Gather business requirements and translate them into effective functional solutions
Support EIBs, Workday reporting, testing, UAT, and deployments
Perform Workday release impact analysis and provide postgolive support
Partner closely with HR, IT, and other key stakeholders to ensure successful delivery



Your Profile

HCM Core + one Advanced Workday certification is mandatory.
Overall 6+ years of IT experience in the HCM domain, with 5+ years of handson Workday experience across implementations, rollouts,andAMS engagements.
Experience in at least two full lifecycle Workday implementations.
Strong expertise in Workday HCM Core along with one advanced module: Recruiting or Absence or Time Tracking or a relevant HCM submodule.
Deep understanding of HCM business processes and endtoend HiretoRetire lifecycle.
Good understanding and practical application of Workday implementation methodologies.
Handson experience with testing, data migration, and validation activities.
Ability to conduct client workshops and requirementgathering sessions.



What you''ll love about working with us

Opportunities to work on largescale global Workday HCM implementations.
Exposure to diverse clients and complex HR transformation programs
Structured learning paths, certifications, and continuous upskilling in Workday and cloud technologies
A collaborative, inclusive culture that values flexibility and worklife balance
We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise andstrong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of 22.5 billion.
Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.

Experience in representing the practice/organization in industry events/forums
Ability and willingness to travel extensively for client workshops and deal shaping

Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Job description of this profile as follows:
Credit Manager will be responsible for evaluating, underwriting, and managing the credit risk associated with vehicle loans (including new/used CV loans, two-wheelers, 3-Wheelers, Electric vehicles). This role focuses on assessing creditworthiness, ensuring zero fraud, streamlining loan turn-around-time (TAT), maintaining a healthy portfolio quality, and achieving a sustainable balance between business growth and risk mitigation.

Core Responsibilities:
1. Credit Underwriting & Risk Assessment:
Evaluate loan applications for wheels products based on internal credit policies, financial statements, bank statements, Bureau records (e.g., CIBIL), and field verification reports.
Identify potential red flags, financial stress, or fraudulent documentation early in the underwriting lifecycle.
Assess the buyer's repayment capacity, cash flows (especially for self-employed individuals and commercial operators), and the valuation/LTV (Loan-to-Value) ratio of the vehicle being financed.

2. Portfolio Quality & Monitoring:
Track early mortality accounts and manage the non-performing asset (NPA) percentages within the assigned geography or product category.
Monitor monthly bounce rates, overdue accounts, and collection trends to proactively alter credit guidelines if specific segments show high risk.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and sample audits of disbursed cases to ensure absolute policy compliance.

3. TAT Management:
Ensuring quick Turn-Around-Time (TAT) from application login to final credit sanction without compromising risk standards.

Key Candidate Requirements:
Candidates should have 4-5 years' experience in credit underwriting of Wheels product.
Relevant experience in credit underwriting within an NBFC or bank.
Good understanding of bureau reports, income assessment, banking analysis, credit policies, and lending processes.
Ability to independently evaluate credit proposals and recommend appropriate credit decisions within delegated authority.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and sound credit judgment.

Description:
Job Title: Business Development Executive / Business Development Manager (Field Sales)
Location: Multiple Locations
Industry: Hospitality | Travel | Hotel Expansion
Job Summary
We are looking for a Business Development professional to expand OYO’s hotel network by identifying and onboarding new hotel partners. This is a field-based role involving market visits, meetings with hotel owners, commercial negotiations, and end-to-end property onboarding.
Key Responsibilities
* Identify and acquire hotels for partnership with OYO.
* Generate leads through market visits, referrals, and real estate brokers.
* Meet hotel owners and present OYO’s business model and value proposition.
* Negotiate commercial terms and close partnership deals.
* Manage the complete onboarding process until the property goes live.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth property launch.
* Build long-term relationships with hotel partners to drive profitability.
* Review agreements, service levels, and resolve operational issues with property owners.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Monthly sellable rooms signed.
* Properties launched and made live.
* Gross margin generated from signed properties.
Eligibility
* Graduation is mandatory.
* MBA is preferred.
Experience
* 1–5 years of experience in Business Development, Field Sales, B2B Sales, Hospitality, Real Estate, Channel Sales, or Franchise Development.
Required Skills
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship management.
* Ability to understand commercial and legal agreements.
* Analytical and data-driven approach.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and professional email communication.
* Comfortable using mobile applications and ERP tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively for field visits.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
Stakeholders
Internal: Business Development Head, Hub Head, Operations, Central Team, Legal, Transformation Team
External: Hotel Owners, Property Owners, Real Estate Brokers
Preferred Background
Candidates from Hospitality, Hotels, Travel, Real Estate, Franchise Sales, B2B Sales, Banking, Telecom, FMCG, BFSI, or other field sales backgrounds with strong acquisition and relationship management experience are encouraged to apply.
Role Type: Field Sales | Business Development | Hotel Acquisition | B2B Sales | Expansion Role
AboutCompany:
About OYO

OYO is one of the world’s leading hospitality technology companies, focused on transforming the way people experience accommodation. Founded in 2013, OYO partners with hotels, homes, and other accommodation providers to help them increase occupancy, improve operational efficiency, and deliver a consistent guest experience through technology, branding, and revenue management.

With a presence across multiple countries, OYO empowers property owners by providing access to a large customer base, digital booking platforms, operational support, and data-driven business insights. The company continues to expand its network by building long-term partnerships with hotel owners and delivering quality, affordable stays for travelers.

At OYO, employees work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where innovation, ownership, and customer focus drive growth. The company offers opportunities to make a direct business impact while working with diverse teams and stakeholders across the hospitality ecosystem.

Description:
Role: Service Specialist (Travel Based Job)
Company : OYO
Location: Vadodara
What is this role about?
This role is all about making sure guests have a great stay at OYO hotels.
This is an internship role.
As a Service Specialist, you will regularly visit OYO hotels, work closely with hotel owners and staff, and ensure service quality is maintained. Your work directly impacts guest satisfaction, hotel ratings, and repeat bookings.
This is a field-based role, not a desk job.
Important to know upfront:
You will be required to travel daily and visit around 45 hotels per day within your assigned area.
What will you do in this role?
Guest Experience & Satisfaction:
Check guest feedback, ratings, and reviews regularly
Identify issues faced by guests and take steps to fix them
Work towards improving guest satisfaction and online ratings
Hotel Quality & Operations:
Physically visit hotels to check cleanliness, maintenance, and overall quality
Ensure OYO service and brand standards are followed
Support hotel owners in fixing operational gaps
Staff Training & Support:
Train hotel staff on OYO service standards and guest handling
Help staff understand OYO processes and expectations
Guide them to deliver better service consistently
Coordination & Issue Resolution:
Act as a link between hotel owners and OYO internal teams
Handle guest and hotel escalations calmly and professionally
Ensure faster resolution of issues on the ground
Performance Tracking & Improvement:
Track guest ratings, NPS, and service-related KPIs
Use data and on-ground observations to improve performance
Who can apply?
Graduates (Hospitality background is a plus, not mandatory)
Candidates comfortable with *field work and daily travel*
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Ability to manage multiple hotels and priorities
Comfortable working on weekends or holidays if required
In simple words:
You will go to hotels every daysupport hotel staff, solve problems, improve service quality, and ensure guests leave happy.

Job Title: Intern
Department: Operations
About Business line/Function: The Operations team includes different business units such as Securities Services, Wealth Management, Global Banking Operations, Markets Operations (back office & middle office) and Client engagement & Financial Securities.
These business units provides services to global clients across Asia, Europe & US region offering a wide range of services, which include custody operations, fund accounting, middle-office operations, static data management, trade clearing and settlement operations, securities lending, corporate action, Tax Operations, AML / KYC and other transversal services.
Position Purpose: The purpose of the roles is to provide service to Clients and their Portfolios related activities pertaining to different markets across the globe. 
The incumbent will be managing the daily operations/workflow within the business group and helps the Leads in achieving the process deliverables. 
Responsibilities
Processing of transactions within the agreed timelines
Ensure all the transactions are completed and approved in the system within the TAT /SLA
Ensure all the transactions are processed with at most care without errors/mistakes.
Prioritize the work and conduct investigation with due diligence on all the discrepancies.
Taking corrective measures/action in consultation with the Leads
Escalate unresolved open items to the Leads
Maintain Communication Channels with internal peer groups.
Participate in Cross Training and ensure the Knowledge transfer between the team and processes is happening on periodic basis.
Participate in Brainstorming Sessions and share the best practices and ideas with the peer groups and team members.
Consistently evaluate and update documented procedures to ensure they are complete, accurate and current
The position interfaces with other Process Associates, Mid Office Staff, Relationship Managers and Clients
The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians
Compliance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to compliance and risk management policies and procedures. Identify and report any potential risks or compliance issues.

Description:
About Us:
Founded in 2014, Vedantu emerged as a visionary in the ed-tech space, pioneering the shift towards online education in India. Our name, derived from 'Veda' (knowledge) and 'Tantu' (network), reflects our mission: to create a vast network of knowledge accessible to all. We embarked on a journey to transform the educational landscape, leveraging technology to make quality education available, affordable, and personalized.

Our Leaders:
Vedantu`s founders Vamsi Krishna, Anand Prakash, and Pulkit Jain did their first venture in education, Lakshya, in 2006 which later got acquired by a listed company called MT Educare (Mahesh Tutorials) in 2012. As part of Lakshya, the founders taught and mentored more than 10,000 students and trained more than 200 teachers between them.

Working Days : 6 days a week
Working Hours : 11:00 AM 8:00 PM
Location : Bangalore & Chennai

Summary of the Role:
We are looking for highly motivated, energetic, and result-oriented Direct Sales Associates to join our high-growth EdTech sales team in Bengaluru and Chennai. In this role, you will be the face of the company, directly interacting with parents and students to understand their educational gaps and pitch our premium learning solutions.This is a hardcore direct role requiring a blend of persistent tele-calling, virtual counseling and field consulting to meet monthly revenue milestones.

Responsibilities:
Lead Conversion: Initiate outbound connections with potential leads generated through marketing campaigns via cold calls, emails, and WhatsApp.
Educational Counseling: Act as an academic consultant by identifying the specific learning needs of students, mapping them to our courses, and conducting impactful product demonstrations.
End-to-End Sales Closure: Manage the complete sales pipeline from first contact, overcoming customer objections, to final payment collection and onboarding.
Target Achievement: Consistently achieve individual daily talk-time metrics and monthly gross revenue targets.
Relationship Building: Build a strong rapport with parents and prospective buyers to foster long-term customer trust and generate organic referrals


Required Skills and Qualifications:
Experience: 0 to 2 years of proven experience in hardcore inside sales, direct sales, or business development. Experience in EdTech, BFSI, Telecom, or high-velocity B2C sales is a major advantage.
Education: Any Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Proficiency in local languages (Kannada for Bengaluru / Tamil for Chennai) is highly desirable to build a local connection.
Mindset: High resilience, target-driven attitude, and ability to handle intense market rejection.
Logistics: Willingness to work on a rotational roster, including weekends (Saturdays & Sundays are critical business days in EdTech)


Whats in it for You?
Uncapped Incentives: Direct correlation between your hard work and earning potential with best-in-industry monthly incentive structures. Fast-Track Growth: Performance-linked promotions enabling top performers to step up into Team Lead or Sales Manager roles within 12–18 months.
Comprehensive Training: Robust 1 week sales boot camp covering product knowledge, consumer psychology, and consultative selling frameworks.

Key Responsibilities
Act as the primary bilingual liaison between Japanese client stakeholders (HQ and regional teams) and the Oracle Cloud delivery team across requirement workshops, CRP/UAT cycles, and steering committee updates.
Support supply chain process workstreams planning, order management, procurement, inventory, and manufacturing — and, where relevant experience exists, contribute to configuration, testing, and rollout activities on the Oracle Cloud platform.
Translate and localise functional specifications, process flows, test scripts, and training materials between Japanese and English, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved.
Facilitate real-time interpretation during design workshops, CRP demonstrations, and issue-resolution calls with Japanese business and IT stakeholders.
Support fit-gap analysis and solution design for Japan-specific statutory, tax, and reporting requirements within Oracle Cloud (e.g. consumption tax, Japan GAAP nuances, e-invoicing).
Coordinate with onshore Japan-based teams and offshore delivery teams to manage cultural and time-zone alignment, escalations, and status reporting.
Contribute to test scenario validation, data migration reviews, and cutover planning for multi-country, multi-plant Oracle Cloud implementations in the automotive sector.
Support change management and end-user training delivery for Japanese-speaking plant and business teams.

Required Qualifications
Japanese Language Proficiency (Primary requirement): JLPT N3 minimum; N2 or above strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience using Japanese in a professional/business context (client calls, documentation, workshops).
Industry Background (Primary requirement): Prior experience on automotive OEM or Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier programmes — familiarity with JIT/JIS manufacturing, multi-plant/multi-country rollouts, and automotive-specific supply chain processes.
Oracle Cloud Knowledge (Good to have, not mandatory): Exposure to Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules — Supply Planning, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory Management, Manufacturing, Product Hub/PLM — will be viewed favourably but is not a prerequisite.
Consulting Experience: Prior experience with a Big 4, global systems integrator, or automotive-industry consulting/coordination role; comfortable working in client-facing delivery roles.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related field; any ERP or Oracle Cloud certification is a bonus, not expected.
Willingness to travel to client sites (India and potentially Japan) as required by programme milestones.

Preferred / Good to Have
Prior experience specifically supporting Japanese automotive clients (e.g. DENSO, Toyota Group, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki, or their Tier-1 supplier ecosystem).
Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Cloud Supply Chain modules from prior implementation, support, or super-user experience.
JETRO or other formal bilingual business-communication certification.
Prior experience as a bridge engineer, IT coordinator, or business analyst in a Japanese-client environment — candidates strong on language and automotive-industry fit will be considered even without direct Oracle exposure, with structured platform training provided on the job.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Python Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based test automation and SAP business process automation.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing and maintaining automated test cases using an existing Python automation framework. The role involves automating SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows, developing reusable automation components, and supporting end-to-end automation across various SAP business processes.
The candidate should have hands-on experience in Python programming, SAP S/4HANA automation, SAP GUI and Fiori, along with a strong understanding of automation frameworks and software testing methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and automate new SAP business test cases using the existing Python automation framework.
Enhance and maintain reusable Python components, transaction classes, workflows, subflows and automation utilities.
Automate SAP GUI transactions and SAP Fiori workflows wherever applicable.
Develop end-to-end automation solutions across Procurement, Sales, Inventory, Finance and other SAP business processes.
Maintain and enhance regression, smoke and integration automation test suites.
Identify, debug and resolve automation failures to improve test stability and execution efficiency.
Improve synchronization, logging, reporting and error-handling mechanisms within the automation framework.
Follow coding standards and best practices, conduct code reviews and validate changes to prevent regressions.
Collaborate with SAP functional consultants, QA teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into reliable automation solutions.
Support continuous improvement of automation frameworks, utilities and testing processes.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming and automation development.
Experience in SAP S/4HANA automation and SAP business process testing.
Hands-on experience automating SAP GUI transactions.
Experience with SAP Fiori-based workflow automation.
Good understanding of Python automation frameworks and reusable component development.
Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts and workflows.
Knowledge of regression testing, smoke testing and integration testing.
Ability to debug automation scripts and troubleshoot execution failures.
Understanding of SAP business processes such as Procurement, Sales, Inventory and Finance.
Strong problem-solving, analytical and debugging skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Pytest, Selenium, Robot Framework or similar automation tools.
Knowledge of SAP GUI Scripting API.
Exposure to PyAutoGUI or other desktop automation libraries.
Experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Gateway.
Knowledge of API automation and integration testing.
Experience working with reusable automation frameworks and test utilities.
Exposure to Agile development and testing methodologies.

Interested candidates can share their Cvs to namrata.dutta@mindseek.net.

Thanks & Regards
Namrata Dutta

About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, cloud automation, and CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in building, automating, and managing scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms.
If you are passionate about automation, platform engineering, Kubernetes ecosystems, and modern DevOps practices, we would love to connect with you.

Terraform
Kubernetes
Docker
Ansible

Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployments.

Collaborate with development, testing, and operations teams to improve deployment efficiency.
Ensure platform reliability, availability, security, and performance.
Monitor production environments and resolve deployment-related issues.
Implement DevOps best practices, automation frameworks, and operational standards.

Required Qualifications
BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA
3-5 years of relevant DevOps experience.
Hands-on expertise in Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and Ansible.
Strong understanding of Linux systems and networking concepts.
Experience in cloud-based infrastructure and automation.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.
Ensure adherence to data security, governance, and ethical AI standards.
Required Skills

Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.

Experience - Field Sales Experience is mandatory
About the Company:
NoBroker is the world's largest no-brokerage property platform, offering end-to-end services in real estate. As India's first Prop-Tech unicorn with a billion-dollar valuation, we provide a seamless experience to future homeowners. Engage potential customers via phone, virtual meetings, and on-site visits to explain available properties and convert them into buyers.

Negotiate deals between clients, ensuring a win-win agreement.
Build and maintain client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and generating referral business.
Cross-sell additional NoBroker services to offer a complete home-buying experience.
Nurture leads to build a strong sales pipeline and meet daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
Stay updated on market trends, property prices, inventory, and buyer demand. Requirements:
Bachelors degree or equivalent qualification.
Proven track record in sales, preferably in real estate or a similar domain.
Strong communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
Ability to handle objections and close deals effectively.
Good local market knowledge.
Target-driven mindset with a customer-first approach.
Own a vehicle (two-wheeler/four-wheeler preferred).
Fluency in English, Hindi, and a local language.
Availability to work 6 days a week (including weekends).
Key Competencies:
Real Estate Knowledge
Communication, Questioning, and Listening Skills
Networking & Relationship Building
Problem-Solving & Negotiation
Rapport Building
Persuasion & Convincing Skills
Customer-Centric Approach

Job Title: Compliance Review Controller (Associate)
Department: India Compliance COE
About Business line/Function: CIB
India COE Compliance Hub: The India CoE Compliance Hub serves as a strategic global partner to Compliance functions, helping safeguard the Groups reputation and manage risk across all business lines. Organized around specialized service domains, the Hub provides expertise in Financial Security (KYC, Sanctions, and Quality Assurance), Operational Risk & Controls, Conduct, Data Governance, Market Integrity, Operational Efficiency and AI Enablement, and other transversal Compliance activities.
Working in close partnership with stakeholders across geographies and business lines, the Hub drives operational excellence, enhances risk management capabilities, fosters innovation, and supports the execution of the Groups global Compliance strategy.
Responsibilities
Direct Responsibilities
The person will be a part of the Transversal Risk Management (TRM) team reporting to Team Lead, Non-FS Controls.
Perform testing and controls as defined by testing and control procedures under the supervision of TRM Managers or their delegates in order to assess and review compliance with legal, regulatory and firm’s policy and procedure requirements
Maintain an audit trail for all work carried out during the control testing, reporting and action plan stages
Escalate weaknesses identified to TRM Managers for discussion and further investigation if deemed necessary.
Draft and validate issues and recommendations addressing the root cause of the issues with stakeholders.
Ensure that all findings and recommendations are entered into the appropriate tool for tracking purposes, perform periodic follow-up with stakeholders of open issues and review / validate submitted closure evidence to ensure proper resolution.
Report results in Digitized Control Sheets, SharePoint Workflow, CIB/TRM SharePoint Reporting tool & PowerBI dashboards. Ensure to use various tools as rolled out by CIB / TRM-E team from time to time
Enhance, deliver, and support the annual TRM Plan, ensuring coverage for existing Firm standards, new regulations, changes to existing regulations, and any audit or exam findings.
Achieve objectives within strict time constraints.
Contributing Responsibilities
In the spirit of continuous improvement, assist with the identification of potential enhancements to the TRM process, tools, reporting and analytics and provide suggestions on how to improve, add to, or streamline current practices in the firm.
Assist the team manager with tasks which may include assisting in testing reviews, preparing materials, organizing meetings, and taking minutes.
Respond timely to internal or external requests for information and analysis.
Assist in responding to regulatory and internal audit queries.
Assist with related Compliance monitoring activities as needed.
Promote a compliance culture within the firm which supposes also to update knowledge on a regular basis.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
Excellent IT and excel skills
Excellent communication and project management skills
A good understanding of Financial Markets (participants, basic products and activities) and related Compliance topics including AML, Sanctions, KYC, KYI, KYS, KYX, Market Integrity, Market Abuse Surveillance, Swap Dealer, Banking Structural Reforms, Client interest Protection, Client Fiscal Regulations, Professional Ethics topics
Team player with interpersonal and teamwork skills
Self-confidence, ability to stand their ground when required
Flexibility and adaptability to work on different topics
Specific Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution
Compliance, Audit, Risk Management qualifications.
Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
Minimum 5 years’ experience working for a financial services firm and/or self-regulatory organization in a Compliance Monitoring/Testing, Internal Audit or regulatory related position.
Working knowledge of capital markets and investment banking activities and regulatory requirements governing those activities.
Strong analytical, organizational abilities, project management skills and attention to detail.
Problem solving, critical thinking, investigative and root cause identification skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS Excel (including macros), Word, and PowerPoint; Power BI is a plus.
Excellent execution skills with the ability to work successfully under demanding deadlines.
Team player with ability to work collaboratively across Compliance.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with front and back-office staff and senior management
High ethical standards.
Flexibility to adapt to a new and changing environment.
Technical Skills:
Basic knowledge on AI and python preferred
Behavioral Skills:
Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
Attention to detail / rigor
Decision Making
Communication skills - oral & written
Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent
Location: Mumbai
About BNP Paribas Group:
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

Job Description

Are you passionate about building next-generation AI solutions? Join our team to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Generative AI applications that drive real business impact.

We are looking for experienced GenAI professionals with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Agent Frameworks, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation), and MCP (Model Context Protocol).

If you are an immediate joiner and excited about shaping the future of AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications.
Build Agentic AI solutions using modern agent frameworks.
Develop and optimize RAG-based architectures for intelligent knowledge retrieval.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems using MCP and related protocols.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy AI models for production environments.
Ensure AI solutions are secure, scalable, and performance-optimized.

Required Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Expertise in RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Experience with Agent Frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.).
Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementations.
Experience with MCP, API integrations, and AI orchestration.
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development ecosystem.
Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) is an advantage.
Qualification: BE / BTech / MTech / MCA / BCA

SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer
Job Description and Summary
We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 47 years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 2 years in Generative AI (GenAI).
The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks.
The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases.
Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
4–7 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
Strong hands-on knowledge of RAG architectures and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience building APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native applications.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Experience with tool calling, agent orchestration, graph-based memory, or memory-augmented AI architectures.
Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
Solid understanding of software engineering practices including Git/version control, testing, CI/CD, and code quality.
Ability to work effectively with SAP technical and functional teams and translate SAP requirements into AI engineering solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with one or more SAP technologies such as ABAP, CDS, RAP, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP APIs/OData, or SAP HANA.
Experience building AI solutions or accelerators specifically for SAP use cases.
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA transformation and Clean Core principles.
Experience integrating AI solutions with SAP BTP or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other enterprise LLM platforms.
Experience with tool-using agents, multi-agent systems, memory-augmented architectures, or cognitive architectures.
Experience with LLM evaluation, optimization, observability, and production monitoring.
Prior contributions to open-source GenAI or agent frameworks are advantageous.
Experience deploying and maintaining AI systems at enterprise scale.
Mandatory Skill Sets
Generative AI (GenAI)
Agentic AI
Python
RAG and LLM application development
SAP experience/background

Description:
Regulatory, Risk & Forensic
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.
Qualifications
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels
Education: 
B. Com / BBA or similar 3 year graduate course
M.Com / MBA or similar post grad course (Tier 2/3 colleges)
Location:
Hyderabad , Bangalore, Chennai
The professionals are expected to work from Office all 5 days in a week.
Shift Timings: 
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements. Role & responsibilities

SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer Job Description and Summary We are seeking a passionate and skilled SAP GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer with 9+ years of overall experience, including hands-on experience working with SAP environments and a minimum of 9 years in Generative AI (GenAI). The ideal candidate will combine an understanding of SAP applications, data, integrations, and technical landscapes with strong hands-on expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Python, and modern AI engineering frameworks. The AI Engineer will play a key role in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions and accelerators that address SAP transformation and delivery use cases. Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for SAP and enterprise use cases, with a strong focus on production readiness.
Build and scale RAG-based solutions using SAP and enterprise data, documentation, technical artifacts, and knowledge repositories.
Develop AI-powered accelerators supporting SAP use cases such as:
SAP custom code analysis and modernization
Functional and technical specification analysis
SAP configuration and documentation analysis
Code generation, review, and validation
Test case generation and automation
Data mapping and data validation
SAP API and integration recommendations
Impact analysis and knowledge assistants
Integrate LLM solutions with SAP applications, APIs, services, and enterprise data sources.
Build and integrate graph-based memory, tool-using agents, and context-aware AI solutions.
Implement multi-agent orchestration and reasoning workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, LangChain, or custom agent frameworks.
Develop clean, efficient, reusable, and scalable Python-based AI services and APIs.
Work with cloud-based LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
Collaborate with SAP functional, technical, data, integration, and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, performance, and reliability of AI solutions.
Apply strong software engineering practices covering version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and maintainability.
Support deployment and operation of AI solutions in enterprise production environments.
Required Qualifications
47 years of overall experience in software engineering, SAP technology, AI/ML, or related technology areas.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions.
Prior experience working within SAP environments or on SAP transformation/implementation programs.
Understanding of the SAP ecosystem, SAP business applications, data structures, APIs, integrations, and technical artifacts.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs such as OpenAI GPT models, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
Strong hands-on knowledge of RAG architectures and Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, or equivalent frameworks.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience building APIs, microservices, containers, and cloud-native applications.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Experience with tool calling, agent orchestration, graph-based memory, or memory-augmented AI architectures.
Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
Solid understanding of software engineering practices including Git/version control, testing, CI/CD, and code quality.
Ability to work effectively with SAP technical and functional teams and translate SAP requirements into AI engineering solutions.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with one or more SAP technologies such as ABAP, CDS, RAP, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SAP APIs/OData, or SAP HANA.
Experience building AI solutions or accelerators specifically for SAP use cases.
Understanding of SAP S/4HANA transformation and Clean Core principles.
Experience integrating AI solutions with SAP BTP or SAP S/4HANA.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other enterprise LLM platforms.
Experience with tool-using agents, multi-agent systems, memory-augmented architectures, or cognitive architectures.
Experience with LLM evaluation, optimization, observability, and production monitoring.
Prior contributions to open-source GenAI or agent frameworks are advantageous.
Experience deploying and maintaining AI systems at enterprise scale.
Mandatory Skill Sets
Generative AI (GenAI)
Agentic AI
Python
RAG and LLM application development
SAP experience/background

Purpose of the Role
The role is responsible for driving sales of vehicles through sales volumes and market share and ensuring enhancing customer engagement in the assigned territory. It involves actively managing dealer relationships & driving demand, developing new business and achieving the territory sales targets.
Job Responsibility
1. Sales Planning:
Drives sales in the specified territory for a particular product line ensuring volume sales, market share growth and enhanced customer engagement in assigned territory
Plan and conduct monthly target setting including marketing activations at the dealerships in line with forecast/ estimated TIV and sales volume for the assigned territory
Coordinate with various partners and internal teams to drive customer engagement & sales. Plan and execute monthly activations and provide the necessary support to drive effectiveness while measuring outcomes of activities conducted
Ensure monthly and annual targets to be achieved in terms of retail sales and customer satisfaction levels as per Sales & Marketing plan.
Support state product manager in the conversion of mid-to-big sized deals when needed
Drive the conversion of C4T customers with assigned dealership into Tata Motors fold
Drive sales and share of business with key accounts customers
Drive value added sales in the assigned territory and seek support from sales teams on need basis
2. Review and Execution:
Conduct sales execution meeting on a monthly basis with dealers sales representatives and sales team to monitor performance and to set future action plan
Execute dealer wise and outlet wise performance to monitor sales pipeline and deploy action plan to different territories based on performance and potential
Review and monitor MIS of the following: Volume, Market Share, Activity Report, Retail tracker, C4T list and pipeline DSE
Ensure the execute of distribution of dealership target DSE wise and Micro Market wise
Provide product wise indent to RSMs as per the agreed schedule
Capture and review market intelligence through multiple sources, including voice of customer on product/services and regulatory requirements. Explore potential white spaces due to emerging customer expectations
Review and monitor dealers inventory and ensure that it stays at optimum level through proper forecasting
Provide inputs on existing product improvements/ development of new products and variants to create differentiation in the market
Work closely with state product managers to share market intelligence about the product on regular basis
3. Financial Management:
Monitor liquidation of stock at assigned dealerships to ensure timely payment by financiers and channelling of funds back into the system
4. People Management:
Drive manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships as per TML norms
Execute trainings for dealer sales team on pre-sales & sales processes, new product features / modifications etc.
Stakeholder Profiles & Nature of Interactions
Internal:
State Product Manager (Product Line), State Head
Update and seek support on sales and market share growth
Provide support, if and when necessary, in conversion of mid-to-big sized deals
Regional Sales Managers
Product, targeting setting for self and dealership, ATL activities
Regional Head SNM/ SNM Manager
Drive Manpower, infrastructure and processes at dealerships
Regional Head RCFI/ RCFI Manager
Ensure finance availability to dealers and customers

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.
