Description:
Job Summary:
Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Performs activities under a moderate degree of supervision.
Key Responsibilities:
Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Assists with data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Assists with associate functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Responds to, or redirects, routine inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately. Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees. Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures. Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed. Performs other routine administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.
To drive secondary sales through distributors and DSRs and engage directly with retailers, rebuilders, OEM dealers, independent workshops, institutional customers, and fleet customers. The resource will also focus on educating customers about company policies, schemes, and product benefits, maintaining accurate sales data, and ensuring timely communication of all required information to channel partners.
Competencies:
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

Project Schedule Management - Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc. ) in such a way that the target audience (e. g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc. ) can understand, retain, and use the information

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
- Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
- Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
- Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
- Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Job Title: Showroom Manager
Department: Retail Sales
Company: TBZ LTD.
Type: Permanent
Location: Raipur

Job Description:
Assist in the planning process
Adhere to the budget guidelines for store.
Implement short-term operating plans and adhere to budgets provided.
Ensure control over operating expenses in the store.
Achieve the store sales and operating expenses targets while maintaining focus on quality of customer service in stores.
Coordinate with merchandizing team to ensure the supply of merchandise to store as per the demand.
Deliver store sales and operating expenses targets on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis.
Ensure high level of customer service and customer delight.
Ensure the creation of right shopping ambience in the stores.
Adhere to reverse logistics (for old gold) guidelines as per the defined SOPs.
Support in execution of any activities aimed at increasing sales.
Provide inputs for the merchandize requirements at the store based on store specific sales patterns and consumer preferences and provide proactive feedback on aspects of inventory levels, pricing, promotions, shelf space utilization.
Responsible for conducting daily security checks in the store.
Oversee the forecasting of demand basis the sales each day and transfer the knowledge around the fast moving designs and latest trends.
Implement the loss prevention activities in the store as per the guidelines.
Monitor processes to minimize losses due to shop lifting or pilferage.
Generate all the required reports (Daily sales and collections, monthly and quarterly MIS, market intelligence reports etc.).
Support business process re-engineering team in conducting audits in the store and take corrective actions for the processes which come out as improvement areas in audit results.
Provide inputs for support and execution of facility management activities.
Support Regional Marketing Manager in executing all the marketing related activities.
Execute the advertisement and promotions plans in the store.
Support marketing team for executing visual merchandising activities in the store.
Ensure adherence to the stores standard operating procedures to drive efficiency and utilize communication channels to provide upward feedback from time to time.
Follow all store operations SOPs and work towards continuous improvement of the same.
Conduct self audits in the store on regular basis.
Oversee all point of sales activities in the store which includes - sales transactions, tracking customer orders and payments, registering sale and maintaining inventory updates, providing service, handling old gold and after sales service, gathering consumer data for feedback.
Oversee the inventory management process in the store.
Oversee that the store staff is presentable and well groomed.
Guide the staff to increase sales as well as profitability.
Monitor the overall training and development needs of staff in the store.
Impart training regarding product knowledge, promotion offers and schemes etc.
Support Regional Retail Operations Manager in identifying processes and trainings on aspects which will facilitate maximizing the conversion ratio in the stores.
Nominate staff at regular intervals for the relevant training programs.
Perform the role of a people manager.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, customer focus, entrepreneurship and team work for all the employees in the store.
Manage and support recruitment, set KRA's for direct reports, monitor overall store KRA's, conduct performance appraisal.

We're in your cement. Now we're in your steel.

JOB SUMMARY
Responsible for proactively soliciting and managing large group/catering related opportunities with significant revenue potential. Manages group/catering opportunities not handled by an Event Booking Center (EBC). Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity. Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery. Responsible for driving customer/guest loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer/guest experience. Provides service to customers in order to grow the account on behalf of the company.
  CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Understanding Market Opportunities & Driving Revenue
- Targets group/catering accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
- Partners with group/catering counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
- Responds to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are outside parameters of the .
- Handles all opportunities if property does not participate in an EBC.
- Identifies, qualifies and solicits new group/catering business to achieve personal and each property s revenue goals.
- Focuses efforts on group/catering accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
- Develops effective group/catering sales plans and actions.
- Designs, develops and sells creative catered events.
- Maximizes revenue by upselling packages and creative food and beverage.
- Understands the overall market - competitors strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
- Closes the best opportunities for each property based on market conditions and individual property needs.
- Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.
- Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
- Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
- Supports brand s Service and Relationship Strategy, driving customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
- Provides excellent customer service in order to grow share of the account.
- Executes brand s Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Executes and supports the business Customer Service Standards and property s Brand Standards.
- Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand.
- Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
- Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the property and brand.
- Gains understanding of the property s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.
  Building Successful Relationships
- Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, Strategic Accounts) to ensure sales efforts are coordinated, complementary and not duplicative.
- Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
- Uses sales resources and administrative/support staff.
  Additional Responsibilities
- Utilizes intranet for resources and information.
- Conducts site inspections.
- Creates contracts as required.
- Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description: Maintenance Technician

About the Role:
We are hiring Maintenance Technicians to handle on-ground service and repair of our different types of robots. This is a field-intensive role requiring strong hands-on capability in electronics and mechanical systems, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues independently. The role involves extensive travel within the assigned zone and direct interaction with customers.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Field Service & Repairs
Perform installation, servicing, and repair different kind of robots
Diagnose issues across:
Electrical/electronic components
Mechanical assemblies
Ensure effective and timely resolution during field visits.

2. Fault Diagnosis & Troubleshooting
Identify root causes of failures using structured troubleshooting.
Differentiate between:
Electrical faults
Mechanical wear and tear
Usage-related issues
Minimize repeat visits through accurate diagnosis.

3. Preventive & Routine Maintenance
Conduct periodic maintenance checks to prevent breakdowns.
Ensure appliances operate efficiently post-service.
Follow defined service checklists and SOPs.

4. Customer Interaction
Interact directly with customers at site:
Explain issues and repairs clearly
Provide basic usage guidance to avoid recurring problems
Maintain professional conduct and service quality.

5. Spare Parts & Tools Management
Identify required spare parts for repairs.
Ensure proper usage and handling of tools and equipment.
Coordinate for parts replacement where required.

6. Service Reporting & Documentation
Update service details after each visit:
Issue identified
Action taken
Parts replaced
Maintain accurate service records for tracking and analysis.
Preserve the replaced partes and compile a document and send it to head quarters for further Analysys

7. Travel & Field Coordination
Travel extensively within assigned zone (city clusters).
Coordinate with supervisors for scheduling and escalation.

Zone-wise Deployment
Central India: Bhopal, Indore, Raipur

Required Skills & Qualifications:
2-5 years of experience in servicing FMCG appliances (washing machines, mixers, fans preferred)

Strong understanding of:
Basic electronics (wiring, PCB-level basics, motor circuits)
Mechanical systems (motors, bearings, moving parts)

ITI / Diploma / Certification in Mechatronics preferred

Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues independently

Willingness to travel extensively within assigned region

Preferred Attributes:
Hands-on, problem-solving mindset

Ability to work independently in field conditions

Good communication and customer-handling skills

Quick learner with adaptability to different appliance models

Description:
Role Overview
The Area Sales Manager (ASM) will be responsible for driving B2B sales growth within the assigned territory by managing and mentoring a team of Business Development Executives (BDEs). The role focuses on retailer acquisition, retention, order growth, relationship management, and execution excellence on the Superstore by Nykaa platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Drive territory-wise revenue targets and ensure achievement of monthly/quarterly sales goals.
Increase retailer onboarding and active buyer base on the Superstore platform.
Improve order frequency and average order value (AOV).
Identify high-potential markets and expansion opportunities.
2. Team Management & Development
Manage, train, and mentor the team of Business Development Executives (BDEs) within the assigned territory.
Set clear KPIs and performance expectations for BDEs.
Conduct regular field visits and joint sales calls to guide the team.
Motivate BDEs to meet and exceed targets.
3. Retailer Acquisition & Relationship Management
Travel within the assigned territory to onboard new retailers.
Support BDEs in acquiring and activating new retailers.
Build long-term relationships with key retailers to ensure retention and repeat business.
Address retailer concerns and coordinate with internal teams for resolution.
Collect market intelligence and competitor insights.
4. Sales Execution & Process Implementation
Implement structured sales processes to help BDEs identify and prioritize key accounts and prospects.
Monitor team performance metrics (coverage, productivity, conversion rates).
Ensure proper usage and adoption of the Superstore app among retailers.
Drive promotional campaigns and new product launches in the territory.
5. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
Provide regular sales performance reports to senior management.
Share customer feedback, demand trends, and improvement suggestions.
Maintain accurate sales data and territory records.

Designation: Area Incharge-Mechanical
Job Brief: JSW Steel Limited is seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Pellet Plant department. This role demands a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the maintenance, reliability, and performance of all mechanical equipment and systems in the pellet plant. The ideal candidate will drive operational excellence, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize plant productivity. This position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, mechanical engineering principles, and team leadership within a heavy industrial environment.
Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the mechanical maintenance team to ensure optimal performance and reliability of pellet plant machinery and equipment.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to align mechanical operations with plant production goals and quality standards.
Monitor and analyze mechanical equipment performance data to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols and regulatory compliance within the mechanical department.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and tools.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on mechanical efficiency, cost reduction, and process optimization.
Oversee root cause analysis of mechanical failures and lead troubleshooting efforts to prevent recurrence.
Mentor and develop mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of technical excellence and teamwork.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on equipment upgrades, installations, and modifications.

Root Cause Analysis
Team Leadership and Development
Budgeting and Cost Control
Safety and Regulatory Compliance
Performance Monitoring and Data Analysis
Project Management
Process Optimization
Inventory and Spare Parts Management
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in mechanical maintenance and operations within the steel manufacturing or heavy industrial sector.

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!

The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions.
Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.
Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

7 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement).

Job Description Design engineer

Role Overview
 
The Solar Design Engineer is responsible for designing, analysing, and optimising solar (PV) systems for residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects. This role involves system layout design, electrical engineering, performance modelling, and code compliance while working closely with sales, project management, procurement, and construction teams to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective solar solutions. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end system design, technical analysis, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and project requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
        Design solar PV systems including module layout, inverter selection, string sizing, single-line diagrams, DC/AC cable sizing and MMS.
        Design HT/LT electrical systems and transformer yard for projects ranging from kW to MW scale.
        Ensure compliance with applicable IEC, IS, and utility standards and regulations.
        Strong understanding of DC/AC systems, LT/HT electrical design, and transformer yard/substation fundamentals.
        Knowledge of net metering, open access regulations, and grid interconnection requirements.
        Conduct site assessments using construction drawings, satellite imagery, and shading analysis tools.
        Perform energy yield assessments and system performance simulations using PVsyst.
        Prepare engineering drawings, calculations, BOM, Costing Sheet and technical documentation for permitting, approvals, and construction.
        Support interconnection applications and coordinate with utility authorities as required.
        Review structural and electrical constraints and collaborate with structural engineering teams where necessary.
        Work closely with sales and project teams to optimize system cost, performance, and constructibility.
        Provide technical support during installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting phases.
        Stay updated with emerging solar technologies, industry trends, and best practices.
        Proficient in PVsyst and AutoCAD.

        Education:            BE Electrical Engineering / Renewable Energy or related field.
                              Master’s degree (preferred but not mandatory).
        Experience:
o     8 10 years of experience in solar PV system design
o     Proficiency in solar design and modelling software
        Skills:
        Solar PV system design and optimization
        Electrical engineering and code compliance
        Energy modelling and performance analysis
        Cross-functional collaboration
        Technical documentation and reporting
        Attention to detail and quality assurance

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

Job Description
A Sales Advisor is responsible for delivering the best customer experience that contributes to the store s sales and profit. As a Sales Advisor, you ll always put customers first, offer assistance, and share your product and fashion knowledge. You ll create an environment that is easy for customers to shop through store operations and great garment care. Key Responsibilities
Provide great customer experience.
Fold, hang, display and merchandise garments to maximise selling opportunities.
Actively process, stock and replenish garments on the sales floor and in the stock room.
Open, unpack and label merchandise with security tags.
Support customer purchases and returns in the register. Qualifications
To be successful in the role as Sales Advisor, we believe you are a team player with a proactive and helpful approach, fostering collaboration and collective success. You have a positive mindset, where you are eager, optimistic and motivated when interacting with colleagues and customers. We also believe you are flexible and able to adjust to changing circumstances and customer needs, and that you can take initiatives and independently in a quick and effective way address customers needs. In addition, you are communicative and socially confident, fostering a positive interaction with colleagues and customers.
What you need to succeed:
Previous experience within retail, merchandising and/or customer service.
Effective time management - being stress-resistant and good at prioritisation.
Have a customer service mindset where you always prioritise the customers needs while serving as a brand ambassador.
Being fashion knowledgeable and have a genuine interest in fashion trends.
Have a selling mindset with the ability to approach and fulfil customer needs.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

Job Title Senior Resident

Department Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT)

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Resident Medical Officer (Teaching Hospital)

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Forensic & Clinical Skills
Forensic sample collection & handling
Toxicology sample preservation & dispatch
Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety
Post-mortem assistance & documentation
Medico-legal record keeping

Academic & Technical
UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Professor - Department of Ophthalmology - Job Description

Department: Ophthalmology.

Employment Type: Full-time faculty position.

Role Overview
The Professor of Ophthalmology is a senior faculty position at a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university, uniting patient care, teaching and research. The role combines evidence-based general and subspeciality eye care with delivery of the Competency Based Medical Education (CBME) curriculum prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The Professor mentors junior faculty, residents and interns, guides postgraduate theses, and strengthens the department's research output and academic standing. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Ophthalmology, or to the Dean and Medical Superintendent where the Professor heads the department, as per institutional structure.
Work Mode

Work mode: Work from office, on-campus at the teaching hospital, with working days and on-campus attendance as per teaching hospital and NMC norms, including NMC-mandated faculty attendance recording. No routine travel requirement has been specified; occasional academic, examiner or community outreach duties may be assigned as per institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) Ophthalmology teaching through lectures, small-group sessions, clinical postings and skills-lab training as per the NMC CBME curriculum, including AETCOM components.
Lead postgraduate training of MS Ophthalmology residents through seminars, journal clubs, case presentations, wet-lab sessions and supervised surgical training, where the programme is offered.
Guide and co-guide postgraduate theses, ensuring sound methodology, ethics committee approval and timely submission.
Perform and supervise cataract surgery, including phacoemulsification and manual small incision cataract surgery (MSICS), with documented outcomes and complication audits.
Manage general and subspeciality cases across glaucoma, retina, cornea, oculoplasty, paediatric ophthalmology, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology, co-managing or referring as clinically appropriate.
Conduct outpatient clinics, inpatient rounds and ophthalmic emergency care, including ocular trauma, with accurate and complete clinical documentation.
Supervise and interpret ophthalmic diagnostics such as slit-lamp biomicroscopy, perimetry, optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus imaging, biometry and B-scan ultrasonography.
Initiate, conduct and publish original research in indexed journals, and pursue intramural and extramural research funding.
Design and conduct formative and summative assessments, and serve as internal or external examiner for university examinations as assigned.
Ensure departmental compliance with NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, faculty norms and documentation for NMC and university inspections.
Mentor and appraise junior faculty, senior residents, postgraduate residents and interns to support their academic and professional growth.
Contribute to community eye-care activities aligned with the National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCBVI), including screening camps where organised.
Uphold patient safety, infection control, informed consent and quality standards, and participate in clinical audits, morbidity reviews and accreditation activities.
Participate in institutional committees, continuing medical education (CME) programmes and departmental planning, including equipment and service development.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a recognised institution, with valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and registration with the State Medical Council of the work-location state as required by norms.
MS Ophthalmology, MD Ophthalmology or DNB Ophthalmology recognised by the NMC; DNB holders must meet NMC equivalence conditions for teaching appointments. A Diploma in Ophthalmology (DO) alone does not qualify for this position.
Eligibility for the post of Professor under the prevailing NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) regulations, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology in an NMC-recognised or permitted medical college.
At least four research publications in indexed journals (PubMed/Medline, Scopus, Embase, Science Citation Index or DOAJ) as first, second, third or corresponding author, with at least two published as Associate Professor, as per NMC criteria.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and the Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME), as required by the NMC.

Required Experience
Experience range: 820 years of post-PG teaching experience in Ophthalmology in NMC-recognised or permitted medical colleges. Minimum: 8 years of post-PG teaching experience, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology. Preferred: 12–20 years combining teaching, high-volume surgical practice and postgraduate thesis guidance; experience as Professor or Head of Department is an advantage. Relevant experience includes faculty roles (Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor) in medical colleges and university teaching hospitals; senior consultant service in NBEMS-accredited teaching departments of government institutions counts only where it meets NMC equivalence norms.

Technical and Functional Skills
Cataract surgery: phacoemulsification and MSICS, including complicated cataracts and management of intraoperative complications.
Glaucoma: gonioscopy, perimetry interpretation, trabeculectomy and laser procedures such as YAG peripheral iridotomy.
Retina: diabetic retinopathy and retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) screening, retinal laser photocoagulation and intravitreal injections.
Cornea and oculoplasty: infective keratitis and ocular surface disease, familiarity with keratoplasty, and lid, lacrimal (such as DCR) and ocular trauma procedures.
Diagnostics and other: paediatric, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology evaluation; OCT, fundus photography, automated perimetry, biometry, B-scan ultrasonography and corneal topography.
Medical education: CBME delivery, competency-based assessment, logbook supervision, and skills-lab and wet-lab teaching.
Research: study design, biostatistics, ethics committee processes, Good Clinical Practice and scientific writing.
Regulatory: NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, TEQ regulations, inspection documentation and NPCBVI norms.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Academic leadership and the ability to build a cohesive, high-performing teaching department.
Clear, compassionate communication with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams.
Mentorship and constructive feedback for students, residents and junior faculty.
Ethical judgement, professionalism and sound decision-making in surgical and emergency settings.
Collaboration with other departments, administration and research teams, and effective time management across clinical, teaching and research duties.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Subspeciality fellowship (glaucoma, vitreoretina, cornea, oculoplasty or paediatric ophthalmology) from a reputed eye institute.
Prior experience as Head of Department or as a university-recognised postgraduate guide.
Advanced Course in Medical Education (ACME), Curriculum Implementation Support Program (CISP) training or a recognised medical education fellowship.
Funded research as principal or co-investigator, publications beyond the NMC minimum, and peer-review or editorial roles.
Experience preparing departments for NMC or university inspections, and membership of professional bodies such as the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS).

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate will show a progressive academic career from Senior Resident to Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor (or eligibility for Professor) in Ophthalmology, with stable tenures in NMC-recognised medical colleges, university teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary eye-care institutes. Candidates from government, deemed-university and established private medical colleges with active postgraduate programmes are well suited. A consistent record of surgical volume, documented publications and postgraduate guidance is expected, and career gaps or frequent short tenures should be explained in the application.

Compensation and Benefits
The compensation package is competitive and commensurate with qualifications, academic seniority and experience, in line with norms for senior medical faculty. Benefits are as per institutional policy, within an academic environment that supports teaching, research and professional growth. Compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Send an updated CV mentioning the role "Professor – Ophthalmology" to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. The CV should list qualifications with year and institution, NMC or State Medical Council registration number, designation-wise teaching experience with dates, indexed publications with author position, BCBR and BCME completion, annual surgical volumes, theses guided, current and expected annual CTC in , and notice period in days. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

Description:
GROWTH MANAGER
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Growth Manager plays a pivotal dual role at the intersection of new customer acquisition and long-term partner success. This role is responsible for driving expansion through data-driven sales and marketing strategies, while ensuring the deep engagement, retention, and growth of existing school partners. By combining the outreach excellence of an Area Manager with the relationship depth of a Customer Success Manager, the Growth Manager ensures that LEAD's mission of excellent education for every child is delivered - from the very first demo to sustained, on-ground academic impact.
ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline; deliver compelling demos and close high-value school partnerships.
Align LEAD solutions to school owner needs; negotiate contracts and ensure seamless onboarding.
Collaborate with marketing for lead generation and stay updated on competitor and industry trends.
Manage and nurture existing partner schools to ensure strong, long-term relationships and satisfaction.
Grow base business revenue through targeted upsell and cross-sell initiatives across the school portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve school NPS; drive timely renewals and support admissions growth.
Support the Academic team in implementing academic processes effectively at partner schools.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding dues from partner schools.
Conduct training for teachers and staff; track implementation quality in coordination with Academic and Sales teams.
Maintain accurate CRM records, execute BTL campaigns, and share periodic progress reports.
EXPERIENCE
Educational Background:
Graduate in B.Tech, B.Com, B.Sc, or MBA.
Professional Experience:
46 years of experience in EdTech or other industries, particularly in B2B, institutional, or corporate solution sales.
Demonstrated top quartile performance with formal recognition.
Strong ability in sales pipeline management, lead generation, contract negotiation, and client onboarding.
5+ years in customer-facing roles in EdTech (field sales, account management, or key accounts).
Experience in collections, upselling, and school relationship management.
Fluent in local language and open to travel to partnered schools.
Graduate; MBA/BTech or math background preferred.
COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
Proficient in CRM tools, product pitching, stakeholder management, and academic solution selling.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; strong customer orientation and training ability.
High ownership, solutions-driven, and collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Curious, resilient, and tech-savvy; thrives in fast-paced environments with a proactive approach.
