Description:
Role: Consultant Nephrologist

Organization Overview
This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - General Surgery is an early-career faculty and clinical role combining undergraduate teaching, supervised postgraduate training, patient care, operative practice, academic contribution, and departmental service. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Surgery and supports safe, evidence-informed surgical care across outpatient, inpatient, emergency, and operation-theatre settings. A NABH-accredited tertiary teaching hospital integrating patient care, undergraduate education, postgraduate training, research, and multidisciplinary surgical services. The appointee is expected to model professional conduct, strengthen learner competence, contribute to service continuity, and accept responsibilities assigned within the scope of General Surgery.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver structured undergraduate lectures, tutorials, demonstrations, and case-based sessions aligned with the approved curriculum and departmental teaching plan.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes using bedside, outpatient, ward, skills-laboratory, and discussion-based methods while protecting patient dignity and consent.
Assess learner progress through appropriate formative and summative activities, provide actionable feedback, and maintain accurate academic records as assigned.
Manage scheduled outpatient consultations by obtaining focused histories, examining patients, planning investigations, documenting decisions, and arranging follow-up or admission when indicated.
Evaluate inpatients admitted under the assigned unit, review clinical progress, coordinate treatment plans, and respond promptly to referrals from other departments.
Attend emergency surgical patients during rostered on-call periods, support timely stabilization and escalation, and document assessment, consent, treatment, and handover decisions.
Perform and assist surgical procedures within demonstrated competence, granted privileges, institutional protocols, and the supervision arrangements applicable to the case.
Attend assigned operation-theatre schedules, complete preoperative preparation, participate in operative decision-making, and ensure appropriate postoperative review and continuity of care.
Supervise postgraduate trainees in theatre and clinical areas, matching responsibility to competence while maintaining patient safety and accountable faculty oversight.
Coordinate multidisciplinary care with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology, nursing, rehabilitation, and other specialties when patient needs require collaborative management.
Maintain complete, timely, and confidential clinical documentation and follow applicable requirements for infection prevention, surgical safety, quality assurance, ethics, and incident reporting.
Cover the defined duties of other Assistant Professors during approved leave, subject to departmental rosters, clinical competence, workload, and safe service arrangements.
Develop accurate public-education articles on surgical health topics for approved media channels, using evidence-based language and appropriate institutional review processes.
Undertake other academic, clinical, administrative, research, quality-improvement, and departmental responsibilities assigned by the Head of Surgery within the role's lawful scope.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical institution recognised for registration and practice in India.
MS in General Surgery or DNB in General Surgery from a recognised awarding body, with equivalence documentation where applicable.
Eligibility for appointment as Assistant Professor under the Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 and subsequent applicable NMC directions.
Current, valid registration with the National Medical Commission or the relevant State Medical Council, with no unresolved restriction affecting the proposed duties.
Documentary evidence supporting qualifications, registration, experience, appointments, relieving dates, and the specific NMC eligibility pathway claimed.

Required Experience
Minimum experience: The candidate must meet an applicable NMC Assistant Professor pathway. Under the standard pathway, this includes 1 year as Senior Resident in General Surgery in a recognised medical institution after the relevant postgraduate qualification. Candidates relying on another permitted pathway must provide complete evidence satisfying the conditions attached to that pathway; institutional verification remains mandatory.
Relevant experience must demonstrate active General Surgery work across outpatient assessment, inpatient management, interdepartmental referrals, emergency or on-call coverage, operative participation, postoperative care, clinical documentation, and undergraduate teaching. Experience should be supported by verifiable appointment, tenure, duty, and experience records rather than self-description alone.
Preferred experience: Documented clinical teaching, resident supervision, research, audit, patient-safety work, or quality improvement beyond the regulatory minimum will strengthen suitability but does not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Technical and Functional Skills
General surgical assessment, differential diagnosis, risk stratification, investigation planning, perioperative decision-making, and evidence-informed patient management.
Outpatient, inpatient, referral, emergency, on-call, preoperative, intraoperative, postoperative, and discharge-care workflows relevant to General Surgery.
Operative assisting and operating capability appropriate to training, recent experience, documented competence, supervision level, and institutional clinical privileges.
Safe surgery practices covering consent, identification, checklist compliance, antibiotic stewardship, blood-product awareness, infection prevention, and structured handover.
Undergraduate curriculum delivery, clinical demonstration, bedside teaching, case discussion, learner assessment, feedback, and maintenance of academic documentation.
Postgraduate supervision that calibrates delegation to trainee competence and preserves direct faculty accountability for patient care and escalation.
Interpretation and application of relevant clinical records, laboratory results, imaging reports, pathology findings, and multidisciplinary recommendations.
Use of electronic or computerised medical records, presentation software, online academic resources, and routine departmental communication systems.
Clinical audit, research ethics, literature appraisal, scientific writing, public health communication, and preparation of accurate surgical education material.
Working knowledge of NMC faculty eligibility, medical education expectations, institutional policies, ethical practice, confidentiality, and professional documentation.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear, respectful communication with patients, families, learners, colleagues, and multidisciplinary teams, including difficult conversations and safe handovers.
Professional judgement, integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and willingness to disclose uncertainty or seek senior support when required.
Calm prioritisation during emergencies, changing theatre demands, competing clinical responsibilities, and on-call escalation.
Patient-centred empathy and culturally respectful behaviour without compromising clinical standards, consent, safety, or documentation.
Teaching presence that encourages questions, corrects errors constructively, and differentiates supervision according to learner competence.
Reliability, punctuality, collegiality, adaptability, and readiness to provide approved cross-coverage within safe workload limits.
Commitment to continuous learning, reflective practice, audit, research, quality improvement, and feedback-driven professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Completed recognised training in medical education, biomedical research, research methodology, clinical audit, or evidence-based medicine.
Peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, surgical audits, teaching innovations, or verified contributions to public surgical education.
Experience in a tertiary-care teaching environment managing diverse elective and emergency General Surgery presentations.
Demonstrated participation in surgical safety, morbidity and mortality review, infection prevention, antimicrobial stewardship, or accreditation activities.
Readiness to complete faculty-development or research courses within the timelines required by the applicable NMC pathway or institutional policy.

Professional Tenure and Background
An appropriate background includes a documented progression from MBBS and recognised postgraduate General Surgery training into Senior Residency or another valid NMC pathway, followed by increasingly accountable clinical, teaching, and operative duties. Appointment and experience records should clearly identify institution, department, designation, dates, employment status, bed-strength or recognition evidence when relevant, and responsibilities supporting eligibility.
Experience in recognised medical institutions, teaching hospitals, or appropriately documented government-hospital pathways is valued because it supports verifiable exposure to structured education, governance, multidisciplinary care, and clinical accountability. Selection will be based on regulatory eligibility, evidence of competence, role relevance, and verified accomplishments rather than employer prestige alone.

Compensation and Benefits
The selected candidate will receive competitive, role-aligned remuneration and benefits in accordance with institutional policy, verified credentials, experience, responsibilities, and the final terms of appointment. Exact financial terms will be communicated through the formal selection process.

Application Instructions
Submit an updated resume with the role title, MBBS and postgraduate qualification details, registration status, complete employment chronology, Senior Residency or alternate-pathway evidence, teaching and operative experience, publications or audits, and current contact details. Candidates may apply through email, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp using the contact information stated in the LinkedIn outreach post. Shortlisting and appointment remain subject to document verification, NMC eligibility review, reference checks, and institutional selection requirements.

Role Overview

Position Details: Associate Professor - Paediatrics; 2 positions; Department of Paediatrics; reports to the Professor / Head of Unit; work location: Gangtok, Sikkim.

This mid-senior academic-clinical role combines undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervised clinical service, assessment, research guidance, and assigned unit administration. The incumbent will help MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students build safe, evidence-informed paediatric knowledge and practical competence. The role supports high-quality outpatient, inpatient, emergency, NICU, and PICU care while contributing to patient satisfaction and continuous improvement. The Associate Professor works under the Professor / Head of Unit and may lead unit activities when authorised.

Employer Profile: A confidential tertiary-care academic teaching hospital integrating paediatric care, medical education, clinical training, and research.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver competency-based lectures, tutorials, bedside teaching, demonstrations, and clinical discussions for MBBS students, interns, and postgraduate medical students.
Formulate the rotational undergraduate teaching schedule and coordinate faculty inputs to maintain complete, timely academic coverage.
Plan, conduct, and document internal examinations and periodic assessments using approved standards, blueprints, records, and constructive learner feedback.
Supervise seminars, case presentations, journal clubs, clinical postings, procedural learning, and academic mentoring across paediatric services.
Provide outpatient and inpatient paediatric care with the unit team and support evidence-informed diagnosis, treatment, discharge, and follow-up decisions.
Serve as first on call for paediatric emergencies on assigned duty days and escalate difficult or unstable cases promptly.
Supervise or perform appropriate procedures in the NICU, PICU, outpatient department, wards, and emergency settings within authorised privileges.
Report complex, high-risk, and emergency cases to the Unit In-charge or Head of Department and document decisions accurately.
Cover assigned consultant responsibilities during approved leave or service gaps to maintain continuity of teaching and patient care.
Lead assigned unit administration, including duty rosters, work allocation, coordination, and staff guidance, when delegated.
Support need assessment, specification development, procurement inputs, and responsible utilisation of paediatric medical equipment.
Guide learner and departmental research through question development, protocol review, ethical practice, analysis, writing, and dissemination.
Advance patient satisfaction, safety, quality indicators, infection prevention, audit, and continual clinical-service improvement.

Required Qualifications

The candidate must satisfy the applicable Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, including prescribed research-publication, biomedical-research, and medical-education training requirements, as verified at appointment.

Required Experience

Any alternative statutory pathway must be fully documented and independently verified. Relevant experience must include formal undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, learner assessment, clinical supervision, and paediatric patient care. Demonstrated exposure to NICU, PICU, outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services in a teaching-hospital environment is essential.

Technical and Functional Skills
Paediatric clinical assessment, decision-making, documentation, referral, discharge planning, and escalation across OPD, wards, NICU, PICU, and emergencies.
Competency-based medical education, lesson planning, teaching schedules, internal assessment, question setting, evaluation, feedback, and academic recordkeeping.
Clinical supervision of learners and safe oversight of authorised paediatric and neonatal procedures within institutional protocols.
Research methods, ethics, literature appraisal, protocol development, data interpretation, manuscript guidance, and NMC-compliant publication evidence.
Quality improvement, patient safety, infection prevention, audit, duty-roster planning, equipment inputs, and multidisciplinary coordination.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Clear academic communication, structured feedback, learner mentorship, and respectful collaboration with students, faculty, nurses, and allied teams.
Compassionate family communication, ethical judgement, cultural sensitivity, confidentiality, and calm leadership during paediatric emergencies.
Accountability, dependability, adaptability, prioritisation, conflict resolution, and commitment to continuous professional development.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Preference will be given to candidates with a strong teaching portfolio; completed NMC-recognised faculty-development courses; eligible research publications; demonstrable academic or clinical quality-improvement work; experience guiding postgraduate research; and additional documented competence in neonatology, paediatric intensive care, medical education, or clinical research. These preferences do not replace mandatory NMC eligibility.

Professional Tenure and Background
Expected progression includes recognised postgraduate training, Senior Residency or an accepted equivalent pathway, and an Assistant Professor appointment meeting the applicable 4+ years or 5+ years NMC threshold. Candidates should show sustained paediatric service, measurable teaching contributions, documented research, and ethical conduct in recognised teaching institutions.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Assistant Professor

Department Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy

Reporting To Professor / Head of the Department

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super

Speciality Teaching Hospital,

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Assistant Professor in the Department of Dermatology, Venereology, and Leprosy will serve as a key teaching and clinical faculty member at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The role requires a committed medical professional capable of delivering quality undergraduate medical education while managing a robust clinical workload across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings. The incumbent will also contribute to research and publication activities as mandated by the National Medical Commission (NMC). This is an entry-level faculty appointment with strong scope for academic growth within the institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and clinical classes in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy as per university curriculum.
Conduct bedside clinical demonstrations, practical sessions, and case-based discussions for MBBS students and interns.
Participate in departmental seminars, journal clubs, and academic activities to foster a learning environment.
Assist in evaluation and assessment of undergraduate students including internal and university examinations.
Cover duties of other Assistant Professors when required to ensure continuity of academic programmes.

B. Clinical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots, ensuring evidence-based clinical care.
Provide comprehensive inpatient (IPD) dermatology care manage cases admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments.
Diagnose and manage common skin diseases, sexually transmitted infections, and leprosy cases.
Attend to emergency dermatology patients during assigned on-call duties.
Participate in scheduled Operation Theatre duties perform and oversee procedures and assist postgraduate trainees.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and comply with hospital protocols, NABH standards, and patient safety requirements.

C. Research & Publications
Publish research articles in indexed journals as per current NMC requirements.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media on a regular basis.
Assist senior faculty and postgraduate students in ongoing research projects, data collection, and analysis.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe if not already completed.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in routine departmental administrative tasks and planning.
Participate in hospital quality improvement initiatives and NABH accreditation activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the HOD or institutional authorities.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy from a recognized institution.

Teaching / Clinical Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a) One year as Senior Resident in Dermatology at a recognized medical institution; OR
Note: Tutor experience in a medical institution (with PG degree) is considered equivalent to Senior Resident experience; OR
(b) Armed Forces Specialist Medical Officer with at least 1 year teaching experience OR 2 years clinical experience post-PG qualification in the relevant specialty; OR
(c) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 2 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within 2 years of appointment); OR
(d) Diploma holders appointed as Senior Residents in a recognized medical institution before 08.06.2017, with total 4 years of SR experience; OR
(e) Diploma holders working as Specialist / Medical Officer in a government medical institution (NMC-recognised teaching programme) with cumulative 6 years of experience.

Regulatory Compliance
Valid registration with State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Must complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) if not already completed.
Preference will be given to candidates with prior teaching hospital experience in a recognized university-affiliated institution.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical Expertise
Skin disease OPD & IPD management
STI & Venereology clinical care
Leprosy diagnosis & MDT management
Dermatosurgical procedures
Emergency dermatology on-call
Inpatient referral consultation
Academic & Research
• UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Bedside teaching & case discussion
NMC compliance & regulation
Research publication in indexed journals
Biomedical research basics
Academic examination participation
Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Team collaboration & coordination
Responsible & organized approach
Patient-centric care mindset
Adaptability in teaching hospital

Role Overview
The Assistant Professor - Forensic Medicine & Toxicology is a full-time academic faculty position responsible for teaching, assessment, medico-legal practice, research, and departmental service. The role supports undergraduate MBBS students, postgraduate medical students, and interns through competency-based instruction, supervised practical learning, and reliable academic evaluation. Reporting to the Head of Department, the incumbent will contribute to autopsy services, expert opinions, court duties, curriculum delivery, and institutional responsibilities. The position requires sound professional judgment, ethical conduct, accurate documentation, and the ability to connect forensic principles with clinically and legally relevant practice.

Key Responsibilities
a. Deliver structured lectures, practical demonstrations, tutorials, seminars, and supervised training for MBBS, postgraduate medical students, and interns.
b. Design teaching schedules, lesson plans, learning resources, competency maps, and assessment activities aligned with the approved curriculum and applicable NMC standards.
c. Conduct medico-legal autopsies and related examinations within authorized scope, maintaining accuracy, dignity, biosafety, evidence integrity, and complete contemporaneous records.
d. Prepare clear post-mortem reports, medico-legal opinions, certificates, and advisory inputs for authorized public authorities when formally required.

Description:
Role Overview
The Librarian will be responsible for the overall management, development, digitisation, and effective utilisation of the University Library and its learning resources. The role goes beyond the traditional management of books and circulation. The Librarian is expected to develop the library as a student-centric Learning Resource Centre that actively supports teaching, research, skill development, employability, innovation, and lifelong learning. The Librarian will ensure that physical and digital resources are easily accessible, appropriately organised, effectively utilised, and continuously aligned with the academic programmes and evolving requirements of Medhavi Skills University.
Key Responsibilities
A. Library Administration & Operations
Manage the day-to-day functioning of the University Library and associated learning/resource facilities.
Develop and implement library policies, SOPs, circulation procedures, membership norms, and operating guidelines.
Ensure systematic acquisition, accessioning, classification, cataloguing, shelving, circulation, and preservation of library resources.
Maintain accurate records of books, journals, periodicals, newspapers, reports, reference materials, and other resources.
Ensure efficient issue, return, renewal, reservation, and recovery of library materials.
Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation of library resources.
Maintain appropriate systems for damaged, lost, obsolete, and withdrawn materials.
Ensure appropriate library timings based on student s and academic requirements, including during examinations and other high-demand periods.
B. Digital Library & Technology
Develop and strengthen the University s digital library ecosystem.
Manage e-books, e-journals, research databases, institutional repositories, online learning resources, and other digital subscriptions.
Ensure effective implementation and utilisation of the Library Management System (LMS/ILMS).
Facilitate remote and campus-based access to digital learning resources wherever applicable.
Promote awareness and usage of digital databases and online academic resources among students and faculty.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled search, research and knowledge management tools, to enhance library services.
Maintain accurate digital catalogues and ensure easy discoverability of resources.
C. Academic & Student Support
Work closely with Heads of Schools, Programme In-Charges, faculty members, and academic teams to understand programme-specific resource requirements.
Ensure availability of textbooks, reference books, journals, case studies, reports, and digital resources required for different programmes.
Conduct library orientation programmes for newly admitted students.
Train students in effective use of catalogues, databases, e-resources, research platforms, and credible online information sources.
Support students in literature searches, assignments, projects, presentations, research, and academic referencing.
Develop initiatives to improve reading habits and library utilisation among students.
Organise book displays, reading campaigns, author interactions, knowledge sessions, quizzes, book reviews, and other library engagement activities.
D. Faculty & Research Support
Assist faculty and researchers in identifying relevant books, journals, databases, reports, and research materials.
Support literature review, reference management, citation practices, and information retrieval.
Facilitate awareness of research databases, open-access resources, institutional repositories, and scholarly publications.
Support the development and maintenance of an institutional repository for research papers, publications, reports, projects, dissertations, and other academic outputs, as applicable.
Coordinate with academic teams for continuous improvement of programme-wise library resources.
E. Acquisition & Resource Development
Prepare annual and periodic plans for acquisition of books, journals, databases, and other learning resources.
Collect recommendations from faculty, Schools, and academic departments.
Evaluate resource requirements based on curriculum, student strength, programme requirements, usage patterns, and applicable regulatory norms.
Coordinate with publishers, vendors, distributors, and service providers for procurement and subscriptions.
Support comparative evaluation and cost-effective procurement of library resources in accordance with University policies.
Monitor subscriptions and ensure timely renewal of essential databases, journals, magazines, and digital resources
F. Compliance, Accreditation & Documentation
Maintain all library documentation required for statutory, regulatory, accreditation, audit and quality-assurance purposes.
Support the University in documentation and data requirements relating to UGC,

On job trainee is responsible for ensuring that all necessarycutlery, crockery, and glassware are available to the guests. Qualifications:
Min HSSC pass, diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in food service or hospitality may be preferred.
Strong knowledge of food service operations, including hygiene and sanitation practices.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem solving skill with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Throughout training period, on job trainee will be supervised byexperienced stewards or captains, who will guide in performing dutieseffectively and efficiently. Hence performance will be evaluated regularly, andwill be provided with feedback and support to help to improve skills andknowledge. Overall, the role of an on-the-job trainee steward in the food andbeverage service department is an important one that requires attention todetail, excellent customer service skills, and a strong commitment to teamworkand collaboration.

Job Summary
ATREE is seeking an Analyst to work closely with the Policy Lead to review, analyses, study, conduct consultations, and draft recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States.
You will be a key member of a team led by the Director -The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE to external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
Responsibilities
Support the Policy Lead in delivering the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including timely reporting and tracking of success indicators.
Review rangeland, forest, and agroforestry policies and identify opportunities to strengthen mountain-specific approaches across the three landscapes.
Support development and advocacy of state-level policy action plans on restoration and agroecology (Sikkim), OECM/CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Ladakh).
Support the Policy Lead in mapping key stakeholders in policy-making and comparing existing policies to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific needs across the three landscapes, keeping the analysis current.
Conduct FGDs, expert interviews, and workshops on mountain-specific policies, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and supporting equitable participation of women and marginalized groups.
Identify practices or policies detrimental to climate and ecosystem resilience, and develop case studies of successful mountain-specific models or practices.
Support drafting of policy recommendations and briefing papers, and their presentation to a multi-stakeholder panel for review and feedback, delivered on schedule to support the Policy Lead.
Support the advocacy campaign to raise awareness and capacity strengthening activities, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Be part of the team compiling a comprehensive report and toolkit documenting the process, findings, recommendations, and outcomes for the IHR, and share it with stakeholders.
Support the team in creating the Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECMs/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, under the guidance of the Policy Lead and external legal counsel where required.
Support collaboration with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and contribute to the project s digital knowledge commons, helping capture and curate policy-relevant data, analysis and case studies.
Write reports and support in contributing to the learning and reporting plan, and in coordinating with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
Masters in a related field, i.e., environmental science, social sciences, natural science, ecology, natural resources management, public policy, law, or a related interdisciplinary field.
Experience Required
1 to 2 years of overall experience in policy work, with some experience in the mountains.
Strong networking skills and ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to support equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Skills to organize and communicate across levels of an organization and across geographies.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work closely with team members.
Desirable Skills
Familiarity with data collection, coding, and analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Kobo Toolbox, or similar) for organizing consultation and FGD findings.
Prior exposure to national or regional mountain/biodiversity policy frameworks (e.g., National Mission for Sustaining the Himalayan Ecosystem, State Biodiversity Action Plans) gained through coursework, internships, or prior roles.
Comfort with digital documentation and knowledge-management platforms for curating and organizing policy-relevant data and case studies.

Description:
Job Summary
Lead - Policy
ATREE is seeking an experienced professional to lead reviews, analyses, studies, consultations, and recommendations on mountain-specific policies related to biodiversity conservation, landscape restoration, and bio-resource use in the project landscapes and States. The policy vision will be guided by global, regional, national, and state mountain policies from IHR.
You will be a key member of a versatile team led by the Director - The Himalaya Initiative. You will represent ATREE with external stakeholders, including government departments in the project states, IHR states, and at the national level, and will collaborate closely with regional teams in the IHR and at ATREE headquarters in Bengaluru.
In the Himalaya, ATREE s strategy is to work towards a future where resilient mountain and downstream societies sustainably enjoy the natural endowment of the Indian Himalayan Region (IHR) while protecting and preserving its rich biodiversity. ATREE has developed a 10-year strategy called The Himalaya Initiative (THI), focused on the IHR amid increasing biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and climate change.
Project AMP-Himalaya is funded by the Rural India Supporting Trust (RIST), co-financed by Conservation International and Global Conservation, within the THI strategy, for a 5-year project period. The project aims to conserve biodiversity, restore landscapes, and foster human well-being in the Indian Himalayan Region. Three key areas prioritized to achieve the goal in the IHR are: 1) Assessment, Monitoring, and Conservation of Biodiversity; 2) Restoration of Multi-functional Landscapes; and 3) Nature-based Rural Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience. Integral to these priorities are: creating digital knowledge commons to accelerate participatory management and local stewardship; strengthening human resources through training programs for local youth leaders and expanded environmental education opportunities; and creating conditions to develop and implement multi-level, mountain-specific policies that prioritize biodiversity conservation and natural resource management at scale.
The project is being implemented in 3 distinct landscapes located in 3 states and 1 union territory of IHR, namely: the Khangchendzonga Landscape covering the Darjeeling hills of North Bengal and Sikkim state; the Trans-Himalayan Landscape representing a high dependence on rangelands with agro-pastoral and pastoral systems in Ladakh; and Arunachal Pradesh with the largest, greenest, ethnically diverse and most biodiversity-rich landscapes.
Responsibilities
Develop and lead the roadmap and strategy, in collaboration with the THI Director, for the policy component of the AMP-Himalaya project, including annual workplans, timely donor and project reporting, and tracking policy outcomes and success indicators.
Lead and drive the process of reviewing existing policies related to biodiversity, forests, rangelands, agroforestry, restoration, bioresource use, nature-based livelihoods, and climate resilience, including stakeholder mapping to identify gaps, overlaps, and mountain-specific policy approaches across the three project landscapes.
Develop and advocate state-level policy action plans across all three landscapes, restoration and agro-ecology (Sikkim), OECM and CCA (Arunachal Pradesh), and rangeland and pastoral governance (Trans-Himalaya, Ladakh), ensuring balanced policy engagement across landscapes.
Lead in conducting FGDs, expert interviews, and multi-stakeholder workshops, following FPIC and inclusive community-engagement protocols and ensuring equitable participation of women and marginalized groups; use findings to flag policies/practices harmful to climate and ecosystem resilience and document successful mountain-specific case studies.
Develop and lead a roadmap for presentation of policy recommendations and briefing papers for key stakeholders for validation, and compile a comprehensive IHR policy report and toolkit for dissemination to stakeholders.
Create and lead the development of Legal-Institutional Framework and Modules for OECM/CCA in Arunachal Pradesh, partnering with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE for specialized legal drafting where required.
Develop and lead policy engagement and advocacy campaigns to raise awareness and strengthen capacity, including training government officials, policymakers, community leaders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with ATREE s Academy for Conservation Science and Sustainability Studies and the project s digital knowledge commons to align policy work with ongoing research, fellowships and knowledge generation.
Contribute to the learning and reporting plan; provide technical guidance to Policy Analysts and Consultants; coordinate with landscape, thematic, research, MEL and communications teams.
Represent ATREE in national and international forums and apply a proactive, strategic approach within and outside ATREE to deliver measurable policy impact.
Qualifications
PhD in a related field, i.e., social sciences, environmental/natural sciences/natural resources management, public policy, law, economics, or a related interdisciplinary field.
A background in law, public policy, or economics is preferred in addition to the environmental/natural sciences; where specialized legal drafting is required (e.g., the Legal-Institutional Framework for OECMs/CCA), this will be carried out in partnership with external legal counsel engaged by ATREE.
Experience Required
5-6 years of professional experience in policy development and analysis, with substantial experience in mountain policy frameworks and a strong focus on the Himalaya.
Strong networking skills and demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders.
Strong understanding of policy processes in government systems.
Demonstrated understanding of, and commitment to, Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) and ethical community engagement protocols when working with indigenous and local communities in the IHR.
Sensitivity to gender and social inclusion considerations, with the ability to help ensure equitable participation of women and marginalized groups in FGDs, consultations and workshops.
Excellent written and verbal English skills; knowledge of Hindi and/or a Himalayan regional language is an advantage; where not proficient, willingness to work through local translators/facilitators is required.
Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated ability to coordinate teams, motivate colleagues and engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Proficient in analytical skills, report writing, and documentation.
Willingness to travel extensively across project locations in the Himalaya.
Experience working with nonprofits in the Conservation / Environment / Sustainability / Biodiversity space highly desirable.
Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across teams and geographies to deliver on a set of goals.
Strong organizational, interpersonal and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and lead small teams.
Desirable Skills
Working knowledge of international and regional mountain and biodiversity frameworks, including the CBD Global Biodiversity Framework, ICIMOD/Hindu Kush Himalaya frameworks, and UNFCCC/NDC processes.
Experience in grant management, resource mobilization, proposal writing, and donor engagement.
Experience using digital knowledge and communication tools, including data visualization and dashboards, to translate technical findings into accessible briefs and toolkits.

The Program Associate will provide strategic and operational support to the District Administration, ensuring effective coordination and convergence among relevant departments across the assigned district and blocks.

Strong commitment to child protection and welfare initiatives.
Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving abilities.
Fluency in the local language(s) spoken in the assigned community will be preferred.

Description:
Sikkim Skill University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.

An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing. Key Responsibilities : Property Maintenance : Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks. Ensure the property is clean, well - maintained, and aesthetically pleasing. Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities. Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly. Financial Management : Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance. Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records. Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost - effective services. Security and Safety : Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants. Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary. Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures. Tenant and Guest Relations : Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner. Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively. Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction. Staff Management : Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members. Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees. Administrative Tasks : Maintain accurate records of property - related activities, contracts, and expenses. Prepare regular reports for property owners or management. Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management. Compliance and Regulations : Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes. Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management. Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation. Project Management : Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property. Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable. Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles. Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast - paced environment. Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
Role Overview:
Medhavi Skills University is seeking a dynamic Senior Manager Placements to lead the university s corporate engagement and student placement strategy at the Sikkim campus. This leadership role will be responsible for building strong industry partnerships, managing the placement team, and ensuring high-quality placement opportunities for students through strategic recruiter engagement. He will be responsible for getting all eligible
students placed.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Leadership & Team Management
Lead and manage the Campus Placement & Corporate Relations team to achieve placement goals.
Define KPIs, performance targets and accountability structures for the placement team.
Monitor team performance through regular reviews and ensure timely achievement of placement milestones.
Mentor team members and strengthen internal systems for effective placement management.
2. Industry Partnerships & Corporate Outreach for Placements
Develop and expand long-term partnerships with corporates, recruiters and industry bodies across sectors.
Identify and establish new recruitment partnerships for internships and final placements by frequent visits to Companies, Organizations PAN India.
Actively engage with industry leaders to position the university as a preferred talent sourcing partner.
Maintain strong relationships with existing recruiters to ensure recurring hiring engagements.
3. Placement Strategy & Performance Monitoring
Develop and implement the annual placement strategy for the campus.
Monitor placement progress across programs and ensure achievement of placement targets and quality benchmarks.
Establish systems for data-driven monitoring of placement performance, including placement dashboards and reports.
Provide periodic insights and updates to university leadership on placement outcomes.
4. Stakeholder Management
Work closely with academic leadership and faculty to align student skills with industry requirements.
Coordinate with internal teams to strengthen student employability and career readiness initiatives.
Ensure effective communication between students, recruiters, faculty, and the placement team.
5. Employer Branding & Institutional Representation
Represent the university in corporate meetings, industry forums, and networking platforms.
Promote the university s talent pool to attract high-quality recruiters and hiring partners.
Strengthen the university s reputation as an industry-aligned institution with strong placement outcomes.
Qualifications & Skills Required:
Master s degree in Management, HR or related field.
8-12 years of experience in placements, corporate relations or industry partnerships.
Mandatory: Prior experience managing placements in universities or higher education institutions at least 3-5 years.
Proven experience in building corporate partnerships and managing recruitment engagements.
Candidates should be proficient in: Corporate relationship management
Team leadership and performance monitoring
Strategic planning and execution
Stakeholder management
Strong networking and negotiation skills
Data-driven monitoring and reporting

What We Offer
Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.
Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
A collaborative, mission-driven environment.
The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.
AboutCompany:
Medhavi Skills University (Sikkim) operates in the education and skill development sector, focusing on industry-aligned higher education and vocational training. The university integrates academic learning with practical skill-building to prepare students for employability across diverse sectors. With a mission to bridge the gap between education and workforce needs, Medhavi Skills University emphasizes experiential learning, innovation, and partnerships with industry to deliver future-ready talent.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Design scalable data models that support analytics, BI, ML/AI, and real-time use cases.
Lead migrations from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and on-prem platforms to the Databricks Lakehouse.

AWS: S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, IAM, Redshift, Lake Formation

Drive disaster recovery, business continuity, and multi-region strategies.

Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, ADF).
Ensure pipelines meet SLAs, scalability, reliability, and data quality requirements.
Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, testing standards, modular design, and documentation.
Enable real-time and near-real-time data processing for critical business use cases.

Drive hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.
Compliance Mindset: Understanding of IT software security guidelines, software usage terms, and regional compliance standards.
Must-have criteria
Education: MBA / PGDM graduate, 2026 pass-out
Specialization: Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Strategic Sourcing, or a closely related specialization
Location: Gurgaon, Bangalore, Pune
Experience: Freshers and candidates with relevant internship/project experience can be considered
Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
Stakeholder management: Comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external vendors
Commercial mindset: Interest in negotiation, pricing, cost optimisation and vendor management
Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, comparing options and drawing insights
Technology interest: Willingness to learn about software, SaaS products and technology procurement

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Job Summary
Role Overview: We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager - Apartment Sales to drive end-to-end sales across gated apartment societies. This is a field-intensive role focused on managing the complete sales funnel-from lead generation to closures-while ensuring strong execution, customer experience, and revenue achievement.
Purpose of the Role: To drive closures in gated apartment societies by managing a full-cycle apartment sales funnel. The role involves lead generation, executing activation campaigns, maintaining sales hygiene, and achieving revenue targets aligned with operational excellence.
Location: Bangalore / Chennai / Mumbai / Kolkata / Noida / Gurgaon / India / Hyderabad. Reporting To: City Head. Working Days: 6 Days (Weekends Working). Weekly Off: Fixed Wednesday. Shift Timings: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Travel Requirement: High (Field Role).

Apartment Onboarding: Identify and engage with gated societies for product/service onboarding
Drive end-to-end closures from initial pitch to installation activation
Build strong relationships with RWAs, facility managers, and key decision-makers
Sales Funnel Management: Maintain a strong and active sales pipeline with daily activity tracking
Generate leads through field visits, networking, and activation campaigns
Drive conversions through structured follow-ups and consistent engagement
Meeting CRM Hygiene: Ensure accurate and timely data entry in CRM tools
Maintain daily logs of meetings, follow-ups, and outcomes
Track funnel movement and performance metrics rigorously
Collections Recovery Management: Ensure timely collection of payments from clients
Coordinate with operations team post-installation
Track outstanding payments and proactively escalate delays
Client Experience: Ensure seamless onboarding and service delivery
Minimize escalations during installation and go-live
Act as a single point of contact for client satisfaction
Candidate Profile - Skills & Competencies
Strong field sales experience with proven relationship-building skills
Expertise in consultative and solution-based selling
High discipline in CRM usage and reporting hygiene
Strong stakeholder management (RWAs, societies, internal teams)
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally for closures
Target-driven with high ownership mindset
Mandatory Requirements
B2B Sales Background is mandatory
Must have handled end-to-end sales cycle (lead generation to deal closure)
Experience in full-cycle sales ownership is essential
Candidates from B2C sales backgrounds will not be considered
Preferred Qualifications
3-6 years of experience in B2B field sales / real estate / apartment or gated community sales
Familiarity with residential societies and local networks
Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Excel
Strong communication and negotiation skills
Willingness to travel extensively and meet daily activity benchmarks
Eligibility Criteria
Educational Qualification: Graduate (Mandatory)
Age Limit: Up to 32 years

Job Description


Overview
We are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead and deliver Transmission network planning studies, with a primary focus on UK transmission network development. The successful candidate will work closely with client network planning team.


Your Role
In depth knowledge of UK Transmission network, Future year network scenarios, load and generation integration, interconnector operation and reinforcement assessments.
In depth knowledge and understanding of NESO SQSS standard.
Advanced expertise in Preparation, modification and validation of DIgSILENT PowerFactory study models using project documents and agreed planning assumptions.
Good experience in Steady state Load flow and Continency analysis for future years focused on Thermal and Voltage assessments as per SQSS and performing boundary studies.
Good experience in Short Circuit Studies for future network scenarios using DIgSILENT PowerFactory
Good experience in RMS modelling and studies in DIgSILENT PowerFactory
Good experience in System Design Specification (SDS) from preparation to sign off.
Prepare study reports and other technical documentations
Good Knowledge of DPL, Python Scripting Automation
Coordinate with client network design and modelling teams. Lead and mentor junior engineers.
Strong conceptualization ability, strong interpersonal communication and organizational skills are a must, including the capability to explain complex technical issues to decision-makers and project teams.
Candidate must have good oral and written communication skills, be willing to travel, and work successfully in a customer focused, project-oriented environment.


About You
Master's or bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with 10+ years of relevant experience in transmission system planning studies.
Prior experience in leading a client facing team
Advanced expertise with DIgSILENT PowerFactory, including transmission network modelling, Load flow analysis, Contingency analysis, short circuit/fault level studies and RMS studies.
Experience with UK transmission planning processes and documents, such as ETYS, NOA, Scheme Requirement Forms, System Design Specifications and Project Listing Documents.
Experience in assessing HVDC links, interconnectors, offshore wind connections, Smart Wires, SVCs STATCOMs.
Experience in Python or equivalent automation for model checks, data processing and reporting.


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Sustainability Consultant to join our India team. This role will support the delivery of strategic advisory and technical solutions for buildings, masterplans, mixed-use developments, and large-scale community projects.
The role focuses on delivering sustainability certifications and sustainability framework projects and assist with the development of sustainability consultancy for new build and existing buildings and communities. Work spans concept through stages of preconcept to detailed design and procurement, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and clients.
You will operate within a team of sustainability professionals delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the Sustainability team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. You'll also get the opportunity to work on exciting and significant projects, delivering quality work that has a positive and lasting influence on the community and the environment.
The position is Full-time with the opportunity for hybrid home/office working.
The Role:
The role will include:
Effectively convey the sustainability certification program and client requirements to project teams, ensuring alignment and tracking progress throughout the project lifecycle.
Lead and manage the certification process for LEED, WELL, Estidama, and Al Sa'fat, including preparation and submission of required documentation.
Possess working knowledge of additional green building frameworks such as Mostadam, GSAS, BREEAM, Envision, and CEEQUAL.
Understanding certification requirements, workflows, and submission procedures is highly advantageous.
Deliver whole-building/asset LCAs and embodied carbon studies; model scenarios, benchmark options, and generate client-ready insight and visuals.
Manage LCA-focused sustainability projects, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs.
Collaborate directly with design disciplines to define and embed sustainability interventions to meet certification credits and drive sustainable design.
Apply PAS 2080:2023 / RICS WLCA (2nd ed.) and/or similar principles for whole-life carbon management and reporting.
Excellent skills in narrative writing for supporting highly rated sustainability projects.
Possess the ability to address challenges and devise effective solutions in a timely manner.
Review necessary design drawings, materials requirement, specifications, and contractual sustainability documents of the project.
Prepare the necessary documentation required to maintain project sustainability KPIs.
Prepare sustainability plans, guidelines, procedures, reporting and monitoring trackers, energy simulations relevant reports.
Document clear technical notes, methods, and client presentations.
Demonstrate research experience, as this job will likely demand both directed and individual research into architectural materials and technology, building services systems, green building and urban policy, and social and human comfort issues.
Core Skills:
Holds a Bachelor / Masters level in Engineering, Architecture or Built Environment- related degrees.
LEED Accredited Professional
6-12 years' experience in building certification, LCA/embodied carbon for AEC/infrastructure projects.
Experience in sustainability building and masterplan certifications (knowledge of rating systems such as LEED, Mostadam, WELL, Estidama, CEEUQAL, is preferred).
Experience with developing and implementing sustainability concepts for master planning projects.
Experience in building physics modeling, including energy, daylight, comfort, and parametric analysis, with hands-on experience using IES-VE software are advantageous.
Understand energy modelling and can interpret modelling results
Experience in life cycle assessments is advantageous.
Skilled in liaising with design disciplines and managing relationships across all project phases
Capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously with effective planning to meet deadlines
Experienced in managing diverse sustainability aspects of complex design and construction projects, including initiatives aimed at achieving Net-Zero carbon targets.
Strong oral and written communication skills in English with the ability to communicate results via Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and related software, and craft compelling presentations and reports Flexible and open to work with the wider Environment and Sustainability disciplines. Comfortable working independently Solutions focused.
Be Self-motivated, dedicated, and proactive with a passion for detail.
Good experience with numerous platforms, including Microsoft Office, InDesign, AutoCAD, Rhino and Grasshopper.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Desirable but not essential
Accreditations: Estidama PQP, GSAS CGP, Mostadam AP, SITES AP
Technical Skills: Proficient in architectural modeling software such as Revit, SketchUp, and Rhino
Sustainability Expertise: Experienced in conducting Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) using E-tool or similar platforms
LEED Commissioning: Experience with design stage commissioning preferably with LEED with relevant professional credentials

Varied, interesting, and meaningful work.
A hybrid working environment with flexibility and opportunities for growth.
Access to training, with career progression or lateral moves as the team expands.
The chance to work with a large, global, multidisciplinary consultancy on a mission to transform business practices.
