The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including:
Land-use and development demand; Real estate asset mix and scale; Housing and employment requirements; Social infrastructure needs; Development capacity and absorption; Development and infrastructure phasing; and Investment priorities.
The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors.
The role is based in India and support projects in Dubai and across the UAE, KSA and the wider Middle East.
Your Role
Roles Responsibilities
Urban and Spatial Economics
Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes.
Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels.
Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development.
Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision.
Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications.
Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis.
Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities.
Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand.
Real Estate Economics
Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes.
Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments.
Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses.
Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing.
Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes.
Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans.
Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions.
Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility.
Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions.
Development and Infrastructure Planning
Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions.
Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure.
Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing.
Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment.
Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases.
Project Delivery
Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments.
Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases.
Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources.
Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries.
Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions.
Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders.
Business and Practice Development
Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning.
Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities.
Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates.
Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends.
Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRalis business.
Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts.
Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery.
About You
Qualifications Skills
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline.
Master's degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred.
Professional Experience / Qualifications
Typically +8 years of relevant experience;
Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline.
Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements.
Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments.
Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes.
Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure.
Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability.
Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable.
Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred.
Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous.
Behavioral Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations.
Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions.
Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality.
Commercial awareness and understanding of the factors influencing real estate and development decisions.
Ability to manage defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed programmes and budgets.
Confidence working within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
Ability to operate effectively where information or project requirements may be evolving.
Proactive, collaborative and willing to take responsibility for assigned deliverables.
Ability to prioritise competing tasks and work effectively under pressure.
Fluency in written and spoken English; Arabic language capability is advantageous.
Willingness to travel within the UAE, KSA and wider GCC.
Commitment to delivering sustainable, inclusive and commercially viable development outcomes.

- Consultant

Job

Summary:
Aligned to the strategic priorities of our clients, we are committed to activating human potential to drive enterprise transformation across industries. At Capability Network, we help clients navigate disruption, accelerate growth and create value while staying agile in an ever-changing business environment. As a part of our high-impact team, you will help drive the following:


Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as a

Change Management Consultant in our

T&O practice, a typical day might include:

Discovering stakeholders challenges and expectations and defining a Change Management strategy to support business transformational change programs
Leveraging social and digital technologies in change management and communications
Assisting clients in developing their change capability and becoming more agile businesses
Co-creating solutions and conducting user review sessions, and running stakeholder agreement meetings
Conducting a Change Management Impact Analysis and developing treatment plans
Implementing strategies that prepare an organization to put new business processes into practice
Supporting Change Measurement activities via a Change Readiness tool
Working with the HR Transformation team to implement HR Systems such as Success Factors and Workday
Working across a dynamic, international team where English is the common language
Collaborating with the best and brightest minds in the industry

Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.

Professional & Technical

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture



Are you passionate about leveraging technology for large-scale transformation and innovation for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?



Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.



The Practice- A Brief Sketch:



The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clients- most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.



We provide you with a great learning ground, deep-rooted in agile strategies, where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:



Business problem assessment: Identifying, assessing and solving complex business problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation.





Managing Complex deal structures: Mobilization and governance of major change programs from inception to maintenance and leveraging new technologies to drive business value.



New business process designs:Designing new business processes based on customer requirements and conducting user review sessions.



Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:



Strong desire to work in technology-driven business transformation



Passionate about the technology trends across IT and digital and how they can be applied to companies to address real world problems and opportunities



Strong analytical skills, understands complex issues, quickly absorbs information, excels in conceptual and creative problem solving



First class written and verbal communication skills; the ability to articulate complex problems and solutions in a simple, logical and impactful manner



Exceptional interpersonal and presentation skills - ability to convey technology and business value propositions to senior stakeholders



Team oriented and collaborative working style, both with clients and those within the organization. Effective consulting skills



Capacity to develop high impact thought leadership that articulates a forward-thinking view of the market



Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and client relationships



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and lead and/or mentor global distributed teams.



Comfort conveying both high-level and detailed information, adjusting the way ideas are presented to better address varying social styles and audiences



Quickly understand the key value drivers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement



Natural leadership; the ability to easily establish trust-based relationships and gain valuable insights through collaboration and communication



Flexibility to accommodate client travel requirements





Qualification



Your experience counts!





Bachelor Degree in Engineering









MBA Degree from Tier-1 College (Preferable)



Minimum of 3 years consulting experience in a consulting environment or at high tech companies



Understanding of business parameters and drivers and the ability to articulate technology issues in business terms and vice-versa



Experience in one or more of the following:



Agile - Hands-on experience leading enterprise-wide Agile transformations. experience with one or more Agile development methodologies (i.e., Scrum, XP, Kanban, Lean, etc.), , proficient in defining a DevOps roadmap in conjunction with a continuous improvement framework and expert knowledge of the business implications of an Agile Transformation



Cloud - Experience in Cloud Assessment, Business Case, Cloud Architecture and Cloud Deployment. Experience in one or more cloud platforms - AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform etc.



Data - Experience in Data & Analytics Strategy, Data Management & Governance, Modern Data Architecture, Data on cloud, & Data Culture



AI/RPA - Experience with Automation, Machine learning and NLP applications. Should have worked on assessment, design, architecture, product & tools evaluation for AI /RPA implementation



5G- Experience in 5G Network architecture - build, deployment & operations, development of 5G enabled business models & use-cases



Digital Architecture -Good understanding of digital solution assessment, digital capability, and maturity assessment. Exposure to designing Omni-Channel platforms, designing personalization framework and customer experience solutions, and defining technology roadmap aligned with digital strategy. Experience in Enterprise Architecture Strategy, Assessments (including APO/APR), Governance, operating model design and delivery



Security - Assessment, designing & solutioning Cyber Security solutions. Integration of security solutions to the enterprise systems and with latest technologies like Cloud, IoT etc.



Transformation Management - Experience of Program management & Governance and the implications of latest technologies on program transformations. Exposure of managing the financials of a program and stakeholder management. Scrum and agile transformation experience preferable. PMP and/or PRINCE2 certification will be an added advantage.



Capable of building end to end business solutions



Experience in the one or more of the following industry segments - Banking, Insurance, Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Lifesciences, Telecom & Energy





What-s in it for you?





An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients



Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.



Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.



Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities









Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

A collaborative output driven program that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology Improve the average revenue per use by increasing the cross-sell opportunities A solid 360 feedback from your peer teams on your support of their goals. Description:
Position: Cluster Human Resource

Eligibility Parameters:
3-4 years of experience in Human Resource generalist role.

Education Qualification

Position Reports to : AHR /Zonal HR
Reportees : HR Intern (Wherever applicable)

Required Competencies
Technical Expertise
Communication & Presentation skills
Planning & Organising
Counselling & Coaching
Teamwork & networking
Problem Solving

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities
The most important end-results for which an incumbent would be held responsible at the end of the year.

Manpower Budgeting
Involved in proposing the manpower budgets after taking into account various projections & projected manpower numbers for the coming year.
Allocates the staff in various sub-departments considering various factors like Strengths & weaknesses of each member, GMROL, level of intervention required with the customer (A/B/C), MPA along with DMs & UM
Ensures availability of that manpower as per budgets and checks that budgets are not exceeded beyond permissible limits.
Does availability study periodically, gives feedback to DMs & Supervisors and arrives at solutions for problem areas.

Recruitment, Selection & Induction
Ties up with consultants to meet manpower requirements. Negotiate with them for least possible service fees.
Follows up with consultants for filling up vacancy as soon as possible
Maintains database of applications, rejects
Liases with institutes and colleges for CCA applications
Prepares for and conducts assessment centre for selection
Conducts interviews with UH for selection for all store level positions upto Department Managers.
Evaluates need for placing of advertisements & gets required approvals
Ensures induction schedule is prepared for new joinees, induction goes as per plan, adequate inputs are given and employees are equipped enough before they are on the job.

Training & Development
Prepares training calendar after collating data from PA forms & discussions with concerned Supervisors & DMs.
Does module development on certain training areas
Ensures all infrastructure is in place for internal training programs
Liases with external consultants for specific training needs which cannot be catered to internally & negotiates for best quality at best rate and gets necessary approvals for external trainings.
Ensures smooth execution of trainings.
Ensures training evaluation is done for each program conducted
Liases with Brands/ SO for product/ brand training
Delivers training programs

Payroll Activities
Ensure error-free & timely updation of employee data on system.
Ensures all payroll inputs to be closed as per given timelines with the central payroll team.

Employee Communication & Policy implementation
Communicates employee related policies and ensures adherence to the same
Clarifies queries related to policies and gives feedback on the same to the SO

Welfare Activities
Handles employee grievances at all levels by coaching & counselling
Ensures tie-ups for employees with other institutions like computer institutes, libraries etc.
Ensures execution of employee engagement activities as per annual calaneder.
Activates unit led awards to keep motivation levels high

Statutory Compliances
Liases with consultants to ensure statutory compliances & timely filing of returns.
Ensures statutory compliances are met wrt brand staff, concessionaires etc.

Performance Appraisal
Communicates to the staff the appraisal schedules & process to be followed which are sent be SO
Conducts PA workshops for assessors to throw light on process & common appraisal errors
Ensures regular follow ups to ensure appraisals are done as per time lines
Goes through appraisal forms to oversee the quality of the feedback & comments & evaluate objectivity
Does the normalisation for each supervisor team and communicate ratings as per normal curve back to the supervisors. Make changes, discuss with concerned HODs and arrive at final ratings
Sends collated data to SO
Counsels employees if dissatisfaction arises post increments showing them the organization perspective & the way ahead
AboutCompany:
The foundation of Shoppers' Stop was laid on October 27, 1991 by the K. Raheja Corp. group of companies. Being amongst India's biggest hospitality and real estate players, the Group crossed yet another milestone with its lifestyle venture - Shoppers' Stop.

From its inception, Shoppers' Stop has progressed from being a single brand shop to becoming a Fashion & Lifestyle store for the family. Today, Shoppers' Stop is a household name, known for its superior quality products, services and above all, for providing a complete shopping experience. Job Title: SAP BTP & Cloud Administrator
Location: Hyderabad / Bangalore / Indore
Total Experience: 1012 years
Notice Period: Immediate joiner
Job Summary
We are looking for a senior SAP BTP Administrator to own the administration of SAP Business Technology Platform across our customer landscapes. The primary focus is BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, identity and access, connectivity and cloud-native runtimes. The role also carries SAP Basis and database administration responsibilities for the on-premise and hybrid systems that BTP connects to. The ideal candidate combines deep BTP operations experience with a solid Basis background and can work across cloud and on-premise SAP.
Responsibilities
SAP BTP Administration (primary focus)
Set up and govern the BTP global account structure: directories, subaccounts, and naming and tagging standards across development, test and production.
Manage entitlements, quotas and cost tracking, and raise capacity requests in line with project demand.
Administer Cloud Foundry orgs and spaces and Kyma environments, including deployments, service instances and runtime health.
Manage identity and access: trust configuration with SAP Cloud Identity Services and corporate identity providers, role collections, role templates and least-privilege access reviews.
Configure and maintain connectivity: Destinations, Cloud Connector setup and high availability, and private connectivity to on-premise systems.
Administer SAP HANA Cloud instances, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Build and Work Zone as required by the customer landscape.
Manage BTP transports and content movement through Cloud Transport Management.
Monitor services, audit logs and alerts; set up and maintain BTP audit log retention.
Maintain the BTP CLI and automation scripts for repeatable provisioning and housekeeping.
SAP Basis Administration (secondary)
Perform day-to-day Basis administration across development, test and production systems.
Handle system monitoring, performance tuning and optimization for ABAP and HANA systems.
Manage user administration, security, authorizations and transport management between systems.
Plan and execute OSS note implementation, BDLS, system copies, client copies and refreshes.
Support SAP HANA upgrades and perform post-upgrade checks.
Provide Basis expertise during project cutovers and ensure stability through critical transition periods.
Database Administration (secondary)
Administer database instances supporting SAP systems, including backup and recovery, space management and housekeeping.
Monitor database performance, identify and resolve bottlenecks, and tune configurations.
Plan and execute database patching, version upgrades and migrations with minimal downtime.
Maintain database security, access controls and disaster recovery procedures, and test them periodically.
Communication and Documentation
Maintain clear documentation of configurations, changes, runbooks and procedures.
Communicate with project teams, stakeholders and end users, and provide regular status and health reports.
Work with customers to define BTP governance, onboarding and operating models.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
10–12 years of experience in SAP technical administration, with at least 4 years in SAP BTP administration.
Hands-on experience with BTP global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements, Cloud Foundry and role-based access control.
Experience with Cloud Connector, Destinations and connectivity to on-premise SAP systems (ECC, S/4HANA, BW, CRM, SCM).
Strong working knowledge of SAP NetWeaver and SAP HANA, including HANA Cloud.
Solid SAP Basis experience: monitoring, transports, user administration, OSS notes, BDLS, system copies and HANA upgrades.
Working knowledge of database administration for SAP-supported databases (backup, recovery, performance and patching).
Familiarity with cutover processes and Basis support during critical project phases.
Strong problem-solving skills and clear written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently and lead a team.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP BTP certification (for example, SAP Certified Technology Associate, SAP BTP) or SAP Basis certification.
Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Integration Suite.
Experience with Kyma, Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for BTP.
Scripting skills in Shell, Python or the BTP CLI.
Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks.
Experience with hyperscaler landscapes (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) under BTP.
Working at HGS
At HGS our employees get an open and collaborative environment and gain experience working for customers in various industries while solving complex business problems. They get support to learn new technologies as well as to enhance existing skills to further their career growth.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Position: Azure Lead
Location: Hyderabad, Indore
Duration: Full time


Hinduja Global Solutions Ltd., (HGSL) is an Indian listed company and part of Hinduja Group serving fortune 500 companies for the last 40 years. It is a Digital Technology BPM company specialising into Consumer Engagement Services in the field of Technology, Telecom, banking, retail operations, Data Analytics and Digital Technology services. The Parent Co holds entities in the USA, Philippines, UK, Canada, South Africa, Colombia and Jamaica through subsidiaries and step-subsidiaries. With more than 18,000 employees spread across 9 countries, our mission is to make our clients more competitive by providing exceptional experience. Powered by peoples first philosophy and experience serving over 1100 of the world’s leading brands, HGS is the perfect place to build your future!
Position Summary:
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; an MBA or master’s degree is preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
9-14 years of professional work experience with at least 6 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory & Azure Databricks.
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).
Why choose us?
As an equal opportunity employer, HGS is dedicated to diversity, inclusivity and Equity. HGS does not discriminate on the basis of the race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran disability, or genetic information or any other reason prohibited by law in employment. We believe in the power of diversity to create an environment where every individual excels, and our diverse customer and colleague base is deeply understood.
Plus, working with HGS comes with benefits like:
Competitive renumeration
Excellent Benefits including – Shift allowance, Health, Accidental and Life coverage.
Excellent performance based annual increments.
Fast paced growth opportunities
International work experience
Opportunity to participate in various sports and CSR activities.

This role requires a balance of architectural mastery, commercial awareness, and technical mentorship.

Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Architecture: Design end-to-end data ecosystems using Data Mesh or Medallion patterns.
Technical Authority: Hands on knowledge in BigQuery and Dataflow/Dataproc ETL design and automation using workflows or Airflow, Should be able to efficiently do RCA using logging and monitoring tools.
Performance & Cost Governance: Conduct deep-dive audits of BigQuery usage.
FinOps Strategy: Own the BigQuery Reservation strategy and optimize multi-million dollar cloud budgets.

Platform Security: Establish advanced security perimeters using VPC Service Controls and CMEK.
Team Leadership: Mentor Senior Engineers and define the technical standard for the entire practice. Participate in design discussions, code review, production deployment planning/cutover, data discovery sessions
Modernization Lead: Drive large-scale migrations from legacy on-prem systems to GCP Native solutions. Experience with third party data ingestion to GCP BQ/GCS

Education:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field;

Experience and Requirements:
Experience: 12+ years in Data Engineering, with 5+ years of specialized experience in Google Cloud.
Expertise: Deep, internal-level knowledge of BigQuery, BigLake, Dataflow, Dataproc, GCS, Data transfer services, Pubsub, cloud DLP.
AI/ML: Familiarity with operationalizing ML models via BigQuery ML and Vertex AI Pipelines (optional).
Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and proficiency in Terraform/Cloudbuild/docker, CI/CD pipelines.
Certification: Professional Data Engineer (GCP) is mandatory.

Job Title: Senior Winshuttle Developer
Location: Hyderabad \ Indore
Duration : Full time.

Responsibilities:
5-9Years experience with solution scoping, development and delivery with Precisely (Winshuttle) Foundation, Evolve, Studio, Composer and SAP
Development and enhancement of Evolve forms, workflows and scripts for data creation and data modification as per business needs
Execute Winshuttle scripts ,Data extract, transform and load using Evolve
Automate SAP steps into Evolve workflow and Integrate with SAP and other systems
Data extraction for analytics and reporting purposes
Should have experience in SAP implementation with Winshuttle as data load tool with SAP ECC or S/4HANA
Should have extensively worked on Winshuttle Transaction, Winshuttle Query and Winshuttle Direct.
Responsible for design, development, testing, loading and reconciliation while using Winshuttle.
Experience with SAP Data Migration tools, ETL and other Data migration tools is an advantage.
Should be hands-on with development techniques as well.
Knowledge of master data structures in SAP FI/SD/PP/MM/BP modules and dependencies is a must.
ABAP Programming (Module Pool , BAPI/RFC ,BADI,API,ALE/EDI IDOC , SOAP,BDC) and Functional (SD,PP,MM,QM)
Troubleshooting and Support.
Knowledge of MDM solutions to create and maintain master data
Knowledge on SAP S/4 and other SAP models that would require converted data in a transformation program
Able to assist in cut-over planning.
Experience with leading a team across different process areas, geographies, work forces and technical expertise.
Coordination with Project team stakeholders – Business / Data Owners, SAP Functional teams, SAP ABAP / Basis teams, ETL teams, Legacy data team etc.
Should have rich experience in Data transformation Procedures, Post migration data validation procedures, Data retention, Data security procedures.
Required Skills and Experience:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities
Excellent written and oral communication as well as interpersonal skills
Experience working directly with various levels of client or internal team members including management
Highly motivated and able to perform in a remote work environment, independently as well as in team settings
Self-starter approach to work with an eagerness to consistently meet and exceed objectives

Position: Senior Azure Data Engineer (MS fabric)
Location: Hyderabad/Indore- India
Duration: Full time

Job Description :

Summary
We are looking for dynamic and result oriented cloud data engineers to join our fast-growing Cloud Analytics practice.

Position Summary
Candidate should be self-starters with a passion for business analytics and Data and use their excellent problem solving and analytical skills along with superb written and oral communication skills to develop solutions that delight our customers.
Keep reading if you have a strong desire to excel and are keen to work on end-to-end cloud analytics projects while further developing your career.
Key Responsibilities:
Understand existing landscape and business objectives of the customers.
Translate their explicit and implicit requirements into optimal, scalable, high performance Azure Analytics solution.
Modify existing solutions to enhance, optimize, or to incorporate new functionality.
Ensure high quality of deliverables from self and team.
Provide candid, meaningful feedback and regular progress updates to the team and customer.
Explore how the world of data has evolved and how the advent of cloud technologies is providing new opportunities for businesses to explore.
Learn the various data platform technologies that are available, and how to take advantage of the available technologies for organizational benefit.
Contribute to presales activities including proposals, POC and Demos.
Requirements / Qualifications:
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience & Requirements:
5-8 years of professional work experience with at least 3 years as cloud data engineer preferably in Microsoft Azure.
Well versed with relational databases, nonrelational databases, data streams, and file stores
Should be able to perform data-related tasks in Microsoft Azure cloud analytics platform.
Well versed with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, and Azure Analysis Services (AAS)
Must possess excellent programming skills with SQL, and Python.
Having experience working on spark platform
Should be able to use services and tools to ingest, egress, and transform data from multiple sources, including SAP, within Microsoft Azure.
Ability to collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and meet data requirements.
Ability to Design and implement Azure analytics solutions.
Manage, monitor, and ensure the security and privacy of data to satisfy business needs.
Having Azure data engineer associate certification is preferred.
Good to have experience in reporting tools like PowerBI.
Having experience with Snowflake and Snowpro certification is a bonus.
Excellent communication skills
Demonstrated knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable).

Are you ready to write your next chapter
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We re looking for a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer to join our ever evolving Biller Solution team .

We are seeking an experienced .NET Full Stack and SOAP/REST APIs Developer to join our team. Manage and support Azure App Services, Virtual Machines, and related cloud infrastructure.
Configure, administer, and troubleshoot IIS servers for application hosting and performance optimization.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, design, and implement software features.
Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality standards are met.
Work with stakeholders to gather and refine software requirements.
Create and maintain technical documentation for software applications.
Ensure software applications are delivered on time and within budget.
Where youll own it
You will own it in our Vibrant Office Locations as Bangalore/Pune/Indore hub .
About the team
Public Sector (Biller Solution) is an end-to-end Electronic Presentment and Payment solution which enables billers to generate bills and accept payments for those bills from their customer base. Designed to address mid to large market gaps in product functionality. The engagement is mostly on new development, enhancement, bug fixes.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, or assisting guests with loading/unloading vehicles and transporting luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated bell area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and 100 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries
4. Drive overall engage merchant base
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate.

As on 31st March 2019, the Company had Rs. 62,798 crore of AUM & a share capital including reserves & surplus of Rs. 2,767 crore. The Company has nearly 35 lakh customers serviced by its 12,082 employees & 48,522 agent advisors through 269 offices across the country.

Description:
Functions as the strategic business leader of property operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence.
Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping, Security/Loss Prevention, Engineering/Maintece, Food and Beverage/Culinary and Event Management, where applicable.
Position works with direct reports (Executive Committee members and department heads) to develop and implement the operations strategy and ensuring implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives.
The position ensuring operations meet the brand s target customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes ficial performance.
As a member of the Executive Committee, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand s target customer and property employees and provides a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 8 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 6 years experience in the management operations, sales and marketing, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Profitability and Departmental Budgets
- Keeps operations team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired ficial results.
- Ensures that all operational areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.
- Reviews ficial reports and statements to determine how Operations is performing against budget.
- Ensures capital expenditure funds are being used to address the priorities outlined in the service strategy.
- Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establishing ways to improve the departments ficial performance.
- Strives to maintain profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
- Identifies and analyzes operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.
- Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
- Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holds team accountable for results.
- Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand s business strategy and leads its execution.
- Makes and executes key decisions to keep property moving forward towards achievement of goals.
Managing Property Operations
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding operational goals to produce desired results on a continuous basis.
- Ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
- Ensures core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
- Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
Leading Property Operations Teams
- Establishes a vision for product and service delivery on property.
- Champions the brand s service vision for product and service delivery and ensuring alignment amongst the property leadership team.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
- Observes service behaviors of employees and providing feedback to individuals and/or managers.
- Hires operations management team members who demonstrate strong functional expertise, creativity and entrepreneurial leadership to meet the business needs of the operation.
- Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
- Utilizes an open door policy and reviewing employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Stays knowledgeable of leadership talent in the property.
- Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions,
and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.

Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.

100% compliance in daily deployment reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Qualification:
Degree / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
B.Sc. with a Science background, preferably along with a Degree / Diploma in Marketing.
Experience:
3-8 years of experience in HVAC Sales.
Experience in the HVAC industry will be preferred.
Candidates with experience in the following industries will have an added advantage:
Air Conditioning and HVAC Systems
Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)
Chillers and Cooling Systems
Furnaces and Industrial Ducting
Air Handling Units (AHUs)
Air Filters and Purifiers
Textile Industry

01. Job Locations, Designations & Experience:

Headquarters: Position: Experience:
Baroda – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Chandigarh / Ludhiana – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Srinagar – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Rajasthan (Jaipur) – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
UP (Lucknow) – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Vizag – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Bangalore – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Noida – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Hyderabad – Senior Executive – 3-5 years
Chennai – Sales Manager – 5-8 years

02. Key Responsibilities:

A. Sales & Business Development
Develop business by approaching HVAC consultants, civil architects and other key influencers for product approvals and specifications.
Identify new projects and generate project leads through consultants, architects and HVAC applicators.
Track projects where Supreme's products are specified and convert opportunities into business.
Identify new markets, applications and business opportunities to drive territory growth.
Achieve monthly sales and collection targets.

B. Customer & Channel Management
Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, architects, contractors and HVAC applicators.
Manage existing dealers and distributors while expanding the distribution network.
Identify and recommend new distributors to strengthen market penetration.
Maintain customer databases at product and application levels.
Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations to customers.
Prepare and submit techno-commercial proposals.

C. Sales Planning & Execution
Prepare monthly sales forecasts, sales plans and collection plans.
Coordinate with the sales coordinator to ensure timely product supplies.
Work closely with Business Development Engineers to convert new business opportunities.
Ensure regular follow-ups on enquiries, quotations, orders and project execution.
Participate in exhibitions, promotional activities and industry events.

D. Collections & Commercial Activities
Ensure timely payment collection from customers.
Collect statutory forms and other required commercial documentation.
Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with customers for timely realization.

E. Customer Service & Market Intelligence
Address customer complaints and coordinate with factories for timely resolution.
Gather customer feedback regarding product quality, service and market requirements.
Monitor competitor activities, pricing and market developments.
Share relevant market intelligence and business feedback with management.
Follow the prescribed reporting systems and internal processes.

03. Qualifications & Experience:

Degree / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
B.Sc. with a Science background, preferably along with a Degree / Diploma in Marketing.
Graduates from other disciplines with relevant industry and sales experience may also be considered.
3-8 years of relevant sales experience for Senior Executive positions.
Experience in the HVAC industry will be preferred.
Candidates with experience in the following industries will have an added advantage:
Air Conditioning and HVAC Systems
Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)
Chillers and Cooling Systems
Furnaces and Industrial Ducting
Air Handling Units (AHUs)
Air Filters and Purifiers
Textile Industry

04. Skills & Competencies:

Strong sales orientation with a passion for business development.
Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
Ability to develop and manage dealer and distributor networks.
Strong customer relationship management skills.
Ability to identify new business opportunities and grow assigned territories.
Good commercial understanding and techno-commercial proposal skills.
Self-confidence, initiative and a result-oriented approach.
Professional personality, good grooming and positive body language.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

Description:
Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
Sets a positive example for guest relations.
Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.
Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.
Supporting Human Resource Activities
Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an open door policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.
Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.
Additional Responsibilities
Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.
Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.
Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.

Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.
