Job Title: Executive Assistant (Civil Construction)
Department: Executive Office / Administration
Reports To: Project Director / Managing Director / Senior Executives

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Executive Assistant with specialized experience in civil construction and government building projects. In this role, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to senior leadership. You will act as a key liaison between project managers, department heads, and government authorities, ensuring smooth document management, scheduling, and project reporting.

Key Responsibilities
Project Administration: Manage, format, and organize highly confidential government tenders, project proposals, contracts, and compliance documents.
Calendar & Schedule Management: Coordinate executive calendars, schedule high-level stakeholder meetings, and manage project site visit timelines.
Data Management & Reporting: Create, maintain, and analyze complex project trackers, budget sheets, and material inventories.
Communication & Correspondence: Draft official letters, memos, and emails to government bodies, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Document Processing: Handle heavy data entry, draft meeting minutes (MOM), and transcribe technical project briefs with high accuracy.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Industry Experience: Proven track record as an Executive Assistant or Project Coordinator within the civil construction sector, specifically dealing with government building construction.
Advanced Tech Skills: High proficiency in Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data automation) and the Google Workspace suite (specifically Google Calendar, Docs, and Sheets).
Technical Typing & Tools: Fast and accurate typing speed, with hands-on experience utilizing specialized administrative/coding scripts like abscript for document formatting or automation.
Computer Literacy: Strong overall command of computer systems, cloud storage organization, and digital workflow tools.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for professional corporate and government environments.

Education
Bachelors Degree: A graduation degree.
Graduation/Construction Background (Preferred): Graduation /Construction Management is a massive advantage, as it helps the assistant understand technical government tenders, site blueprints, and construction jargon.(Civil engineers advantage)
Computer Certifications: A certified course in Advanced Excel, Microsoft Office, or G-Suite administration, Abscript(google)
Typing Certification: A formal typing certification (e.g., 30+ words per minute) is highly preferred for handling swift government documentation.

Experience: - 5+ years
Salary- 18000 to 30000

Description:
Zonal Human Resources Lead

Role Overview:

Position Summary:
The Zonal Human Resources Lead is responsible for overseeing and leading end-to-end HR service delivery for both direct and indirect employees across branch operations. This role acts as a strategic and operational HR partner focused on talent retention, performance management, employee grievance redressal, statutory labor compliance, and championing occupational health and safety standards in alignment with company values.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

1. HR Business Partnering & Operations
HR Strategy & Budgeting: Formulate and execute the annual branch HR plan and operating budget in alignment with business priorities and Hub HR objectives.
Workforce Planning & Talent Acquisition: Collaborate with the central recruitment team to ensure timely hiring, seamless onboarding, induction, and deployment of direct and indirect branch staff.
Employee Lifecycle & Records Management: Maintain accurate employee personal files and partner with the HR Shared Services / Transaction Center to ensure real-time ERP data integrity.
Performance & Talent Development: Drive the timely closure of the Performance Development Review (PDR) process for indirect staff; partner with the training function to identify training needs and ensure compliance with mandatory training programs.
HR Analytics: Compile, analyze, and present branch HR metric dashboards and reports to Hub and Corporate HR stakeholders.

2. Employee Relations, Engagement & Grievance Redressal

Grievance Resolution: Promptly address, manage, and resolve employee queries/grievances escalated beyond the central HR Helpdesk/Wish Center purview.
Employee Voice & Engagement: Conduct structured town halls, listening tours, and communication sessions to gather employee sentiment and implement corrective action plans.
Cross-Functional Escalation: Coordinate closely with Centers of Excellence (CoEs), Employee Relations (ER), and Shared Services for smooth conflict resolution.

3. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance

Compliance Management: Partner with the central ER and Compliance teams to guarantee strict adherence to local labor laws, statutory acts, and client-site audit mandates.
Quality Standards: Drive documentation and procedural compliance for the HR chapter of ISO audits and corporate quality accreditations.
Vendor & Agency Oversight: Liaise with regulatory agencies and third-party staffing vendors as needed for audits and labor compliance.

4. Occupational Health & Safety

Workplace Safety: Promote adherence to corporate Health & Safety policies and safe working protocols across all branch facilities and operational deployments.
Incident Management: Drive safety awareness campaigns, conduct safety drills, report on-site incidents, and facilitate swift incident resolution.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Success Metrics
Plan vs. Actual: Adherence to branch HR headcount plan and operational budget.
Operational Execution: % completion of recruitment targets, PDR cycles, and statutory training.
Retention: Branch voluntary attrition rate compared to internal benchmarks.
Service Delivery: Grievance resolution turnaround time (TAT) and employee engagement scores.
Audit & Risk: Zero critical non-compliance observations during statutory or client audits.
Safety: Number of workplace Health & Safety incidents reported/resolved.
Key Relationships & Stakeholders
Internal Stakeholders: Branch Manager & Operations Team, Hub HR Business Partners, Hub ER Team, Corporate/HQ HR, Talent Acquisition Team, Learning & Development Team, HR Shared Services / Wish Center, Payroll & Benefits Team.
External Stakeholders: Statutory & Labor Law Authorities, Government Regulatory Bodies, Third-party Staffing & Logistics Vendors.
Education
Minimum: Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Preferred: Masters Degree or MBA with a specialization in Human Resources / Industrial Relations.

Title Store Manager

Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

plan

Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services

Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Good planning, communication, and team coordination skills.

Manager (Chartered Accountant) - Corporate Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Location: Jajpur, Odisha
Department: Finance & Accounts

Roles & Responsibilities

Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements (CFS) on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.
Perform intercompany reconciliations, eliminations, and consolidation adjustments.
Ensure compliance with applicable Ind AS and financial reporting requirements.
Prepare Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow Statement, and Notes to Accounts as per Schedule III.
Support quarter-end and year-end financial closure activities.
Handle NCI, goodwill accounting, and foreign currency translation adjustments.
Coordinate with statutory auditors and provide audit-related schedules and documentation.

Work on SAP S/4HANA and advanced Excel-based reporting and analysis.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders for accurate and timely financial reporting.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Qualified CA with 0-5 years PQE.
Experience in Financial Reporting, Group Consolidation, or Statutory Audit.
Strong knowledge of Ind AS and Schedule III Reporting.
Hands-on experience in CFS preparation, intercompany reconciliations, and audit support.
Proficient in SAP S/4HANA and Advanced Excel.
Exposure to manufacturing/large corporate environments preferred.
IFRS or Ind AS certification will be an added advantage.

Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYO’s hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:
Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.

Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Completes work with a limited degree of supervision.

Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings. Taking photos of all the Critical components and secure them till Warranty Claim closure.
Need to preserve the Failure related parts till the PQC project closure, if required need to send them to Respective plant for analysis.
Sharing the list of parts required for Partial repair of the engines at HHP RC and track them till receiving from the respective PSBU Quality team/Plant.
As and when required need to send the serviceable parts from HHP RC and Watar warehouse to the required ASM/Customer with proper packing.
Need to support the field team on technical queries.
Need to visit Watar warehouse for Parts removal and dispatch from Float /Failed engines to support the field.
FOR EDO BDO
Need to track EDO BDO s Daily basis and update in Optimus and on mails.
Track the ETA with Buyers and Vendors on regular basis till OA got closed.
Attending the EDO BDO Meetings with IPDC and Other related stakeholders.
Need to visit Plants and IPDC to resolve any kind of issues.
Audit of Depot Return parts at IPDC on monthly basis.

Need to Creating /reduce the P. S. Stock as per the KAM Requirements and tracking of the Parts fulfilment in P. S. Stock.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

OverviewA Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurantslearning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What We're Looking ForExperience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excelyou should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Job Summary:
As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician. Completes all required on the job training hours. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities . Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development. 1. Key Skills Required
DG Set Testing Commissioning - hands-on experience in DG/engine testing.
Electrical Troubleshooting - ability to identify and rectify faults in electrical circuits, panels, wiring and protection systems.
Electrical Electronic Systems - good understanding of AC/DC circuits, sensors, relays, contactors, breakers and control systems.
Engine Electronics - basic understanding of ECU, ECM, sensors, actuators and electronic control systems.
Test Instruments - proficient in using multimeter, clamp meter, megger/insulation tester and other electrical measuring instruments.
Electrical Drawing Reading - ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and circuit diagrams.
Control Panel Knowledge - troubleshooting of DG control panels, protection circuits and monitoring systems.
Test Cell Operations - understanding of engine/DG test procedures, parameters and test-cell equipment.
Problem Solving RCA - ability to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
Safety Knowledge - strong knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, PPE and safe working practices.
Documentation - maintaining test reports, check sheets, troubleshooting records and equipment history.
Computer Skills - basic MS Office/Excel and ability to work with digital testing/monitoring systems.
2. Roles Responsibilities
DG Testing Operations
Perform DG/engine testing as per defined test procedures and specifications.
Carry out pre-test inspection and verify electrical connections before starting the test.
Monitor key electrical and engine parameters during testing.
Ensure timely completion of testing to support engine dispatch requirements.
Identify abnormalities during testing and take appropriate corrective action.
Electrical Electronics Troubleshooting
Troubleshoot electrical and electronic issues during engine/DG testing.
Diagnose issues related to sensors, wiring, ECU/ECM, control panels, relays, contactors, breakers and protection circuits.
Use appropriate diagnostic and electrical test equipment for fault finding.
Coordinate with Maintenance/Engineering teams for complex issues.
Quality Documentation
Ensure testing is performed as per SOP, Control Plan and Quality requirements.
Record test results accurately and maintain all required documentation.
Escalate test failures and abnormal conditions promptly.
Support RCA and corrective/preventive actions for recurring failures.
Safety
Follow all electrical and test-cell safety requirements.
Ensure proper LOTO, grounding, PPE and safe isolation before electrical intervention.
Immediately report unsafe conditions and near misses.
Maintain 5S and housekeeping in the test-cell area.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to reduce testing time, breakdowns and rework.
Support implementation of improvements in test-cell electrical systems.
Participate in problem-solving and improvement projects.
3. Ideal Candidate Profile
Diploma - Electrical / Electrical Electronics Engineering | 2-3 years experience
The candidate should be hands-on, comfortable working in a test-cell environment, strong in electrical troubleshooting, and capable of independently performing DG testing and resolving routine electrical/electronic issues.
Preferred: Experience with Cummins engines/DG sets, engine test cells, ECU/ECM-based systems, generator controls, or industrial electrical systems.
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Description:
Wipro is seeking an AI Engineer to implement and test agent nodes on a production Agentic AI platform for a large-scale healthcare technology engagement. You will work within an established LangGraph architecture, building individual agent nodes, tool integrations, and LLM-powered processing steps under the technical direction of the Senior AI Engineer and AI Architect. This is a hands-on implementation role for an engineer who is proficient in Python and eager to work on production clinical AI at scale.

Responsibilities
Implement individual LangGraph agent nodes per agreed specifications: data retrieval, clinical assessment, evidence gathering, decision evaluation, and recommendation.
Build and maintain tool wrappers in the AI Tool Layer for enterprise clinical service integrations (claims, Rx, clinical documents, clinical model rules).
Write and optimize LLM prompt templates for relevance scoring and document processing tasks.
Implement error handling, retry logic, and circuit breaker patterns within agent nodes.
Instrument nodes with OpenTelemetry spans and structured audit log events.
Write unit and integration tests for all implemented nodes and tool integrations.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards within the team.
Support integration testing, debugging, and defect resolution through the testing phase.

Required Skills & Experience
5+ years software engineering experience; 3+ year working with LLM APIs or AI application development.
Python: async programming, REST API consumption, clean modular code.
LLM integration: experience calling LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or equivalent); function/tool calling, prompt construction, response parsing.
LangGraph or LangChain: working knowledge of agent node patterns, state management, and tool use. Production experience a strong plus.
Azure fundamentals: containerized workloads on AKS, Azure services consumption.
Testing discipline: unit tests, integration tests, and test-driven development practices.
Comfortable working within a defined architecture under senior technical direction.

Preferred Skills
Healthcare or regulated industry exposure: HIPAA awareness, PHI handling, clinical data types.
Familiarity with clinical coding systems: RxNorm, CPT, ICD-10, SNOMED-CT.
OpenTelemetry instrumentation experience.
Experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, or event-driven architectures.

Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
Qualifications
What We're Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Founded in 2014, Swiggy is headquartered in Bangalore and operates in more than 580 Indian cities, as of July 2023.[4] Besides food delivery, the platform also provides quick commerce services under the name Swiggy Instamart, and same-day package deliveries with Swiggy Genie.

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

Description:
Roles & ResponsibilitiesA day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment

You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs

You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.

You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives

You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers.

If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
Technical Requirement
Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP FICO with strong integration skills across MM and SD modules.
Proven expertise in process flows like Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, and Availability to Produce.
Hands-on configuration experience in Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Product Costing, FSCM, and COPA.
Ability to independently write Functional Specifications and work on custom object development and deployment.
Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project.
Exposure to Concur, Travel & Expense (T&E), industry-specific solutions, and customer-facing roles is a strong advantage.
Additional Responsibility
Ability to work with clients to identify business challenges and contribute to client deliverables by refining, analyzing, and structuring relevant data
Awareness of latest technologies and trends
Logical thinking and problem solving skills along with an ability to collaborate
Ability to assess the current processes, identify improvement areas and suggest the technology solutions
One or two industry domain knowledge

We currently have open positions in a number of locations across India - Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Chandigarh, Trivandrum, Indore, Nagpur, Mangalore, Noida, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Coimbatore, Jaipur, Mysore, Hubli, Vizag.

While we work in accordance with business requirements, we shall strive to offer you the location of your choice, where possible.

Preferred SkillsTechnology->SAP Functional->SAP Controlling,Technology->SAP Functional->SAP Finance

Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Role Overview:
The Assignment Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management of physical security operations across high-profile client sites in the South Zone of India. This includes ensuring effective deployment of personnel, compliance with client protocols, documentation accuracy, stakeholder engagement, crisis readiness, and operational audits. The Assignment Manager is expected to maintain high discipline standards, handle large-scale operations seamlessly, and serve as the bridge between the client, site security teams, and the G4S backend.
This role demands strong leadership, a proactive mindset, technical know-how, and non-negotiable communication excellence. Impeccable fluency in spoken English with the right accent, grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation is strictly mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Operations Oversight:
Plan and deploy daily security personnel as per shift schedules and site-specific SOPs.
Conduct briefing sessions across all shifts and ensure grooming, discipline, and attendance compliance.
Prepare and manage MDR, shift schedules, and site logs.
Carry out efficient patrolling of internal and perimeter areas.
Observe and respond to suspicious man/material movements.
Ensure access control compliance and critical access management (labs, restricted zones).
Maintain visitor/vendor records, key logs, badges, and lost & found registers.
Conduct weekly security training and refresher briefings.
Perform surprise night inspections to assess readiness of night staff.
2. Technical Systems & Documentation:
Ensure the uptime and functionality of CCTV, access control systems, and FAPA equipment.
Maintain workstations audit, badge audits, and access key audits.
Coordinate with facility teams for system rectification and AMC partner activities.
Take access approvals via eApproval portals.
3. Reporting & MIS:
Share daily, weekly, and monthly operations reports with G4S and designated site managers.
Maintain event trackers, alarms reports, RPM data, incident logs, and vendor performance records.
Support site managers in Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi, and Gurugram for consolidated reporting.
4. Emergency & Incident Management:
Act as the first escalation point for medical emergencies, duress alerts, or system-triggered alarms.
Liaise with EMEIA SOC for remote access control and video retrieval.
Prepare incident reports, investigate breaches, and implement CAPAs.
Conduct mock drills, shutdown protocols, and risk preparedness activities.
5. Client & Stakeholder Coordination:
Respond to client queries and share required reports (daily/weekly/monthly) within agreed SLAs.
Attend virtual coordination meetings with client-side managers to sync activities Pan India.
Coordinate closely with facilities and places teams for smooth operations, approvals, and events.
Handle onboarding/offboarding of employees with badge issuance and access revocation.
6. G4S Internal Coordination:
Share weekly duty rosters, attendance, and nominal rolls with G4S backend.
Coordinate on salary concerns, health insurance issues, and uniform issuance.
Maintain leave records and escalate absenteeism trends.
Work with Key Account Managers to resolve operations-related escalations.
Candidate Profile:
Minimum Requirements:
Graduate in any discipline (mandatory)
Minimum 5-10 years of experience in security operations management
Experience handling multi-location operations preferred
Prior exposure to multinational corporate environments in IT sector shall be very advantageous for the candidate.
Essential Competencies:
Communication: Fluent spoken and written English (mandatory); clarity, grammar, and pronunciation will be tested.
Operational Skills: Security deployment, documentation, SOPs, reporting tools.
Technical Proficiency: Familiar with access control, surveillance systems, e-portals, and Microsoft Office.
Leadership & Ethics: High integrity, team management skills, crisis-handling experience.
Behavioral Traits: Attention to detail, time-sensitive decision-making, calm under pressure.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
100% compliance in daily deployment & reporting
95% uptime for security equipment and systems
2 critical incidents per year (with timely CAPA)
SLA adherence for report submissions and audits
Staff discipline, grooming, and performance audit scores 90%

Portfolio Management.

Regulatory Compliance.
Reporting and Analysis.

Team Leadership.
Vendor Management.

Description:
Main Purpose of Job:

To manage the Noodle or Chocolate Manufacturing lines of the factory with regard to Electrical & Automation Maintenance and ensuring No unplanned downtime. Supply (may include in-house generation) and distribution of electricity to ensure that it is at all times safe, reliable, secure and sustainable. It covers low, medium and high voltage installations. Provide factory/site engineering with the required competence on Factory Automation System (FAS), Process Control System and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to effectively support manufacturing operational activities and continuously improve manufacturing performance. The role has a shared responsibility of tasks together with production, warehouse, QA and auxiliary services etc to ensure full requirement and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Management responsibilities:
Define, propose and monitor the plans and objectives of the electrical team in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Electricity & Automation Manufacturing Execution System (E&AMES) Activity as outlined in the Nestl Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
Propose and implement work processes, procedures and technical resources relating to the electrical & automation team.
Lead and coordinate the electrical & automation team and maintain competencies, motivation and performance to achieve the teams mission and objectives.
Propose and control the electrical & automation component of the site M&I budget and any capital projects.
Propose and monitor electricity in accordance with the key performance indicators.
Demonstrate and promote the company's values within the electrical & automation team.
Ensure work place safety and effective communication of Safety, Health and Environment to all team members.

2. Functional responsibilities:
Ensuring line availability / healtiness of high-speed manufacturing lines and ensuring highest level of efficiency and performance from the lines. Ensure that all personnel performing electrical & automation related activities are legally trained and certified. Question the impact on product safety/quality, people safety and environmental during execution of any activity.
Ensure at all times the technical integrity/performance of the electrical energy supply and distribution.
Ensure at all times safe installations and operations through proper design, protection systems, procedures and training.
Liase with the site Safety Officer on electrical & automation matters relating to safety, electricity distribution, energy conservation, legal compliance, complaints etc.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Management and Engineering to resolve any electrical & automation issues.
Supervise and coordinate electrical & automation maintenance and project work by electricians, automation technicians and contractors.
Ensure proper management of electrical & automation documents (manuals, diagrams, instrument data sheet, software packages/licenses) through efficient filing and archiving procedures. Manage the capturing of electrical energy related information and the distribution of this information to the required stakeholder.

3. Maintenance and Improvement of electrical & automation assets.
Execute the maintenance of the electrical & automation equipment in accordance with the Nestl Maintenance Strategy using Consequence Driven Maintenance (CDM) as the multi-disciplined approach to proactively maintain/improve the fixed assets and Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM) as the process to manage the asset lifecycle. Adopt the Maintenance Excellence vision by striving for the M&I "Proactive Domain".Monitor plant and equipment to ensure optimal operation and reduction of planned and unplanned downtime. Develop and implement maintenance and inspection plans to ensure reliability, sustainability and security of electrical distribution infrastructure. Ensure technical integrity and performance of automation equipment.

4. Installation of new electrical & automation assets
Ensure that the justification, request for approval and reporting are in line with the Guidelines for Capital Investment. Ensure that new installations are designed with a high degree of flexibility to better enable the operations to adjust to a changing environment keeping in mind safety and the issues relating to the environment. Facilitate the introduction and implementation of new technologies in coordination with local, market, central technical and PTC engineering.

5. Continuous Improvement
Initiate and drive Continuous Improvement (CI) in electricity supply and distribution with the aim of achieving optimised plant performance. Ensure that all members of the team play an active role in assisting the client in improving the energy usage and reducing waste across the site through continual improvement initiatives.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Job Description: Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: AVP Commercial

Department: Stores & Inventory Management

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Assistant General Manager (AGM) Stores to lead inward storekeeping, engineering spares custody, consumable inventory, and yard storage operations at our Paonta Sahib manufacturing facility.

The AGM Stores will hold full operational ownership of inventory custody, storage optimization, material issuance, scrap segregation, and system stock reconciliation. The role requires close coordination with Plant Production, Maintenance, Quality, and Central/Local Procurement to eliminate production downtime caused by material shortages, maintain 100% stock accuracy in the ERP system, and implement robust material handling, preservation, and internal audit controls.


Key Responsibilities
1. Inward Logistics & Material Receipt
Direct gate entry verification, weighbridge reconciliation, unloading, and staging for all incoming consignments:


Raw Materials: Stainless steel melting scrap, ingots, billets, HR/CR master coils, and raw pipe shells.

Consumables & Spares: Refractories, mill rolls, lubricants/cutting oils, electrical/mechanical spares, pickling acids/chemicals, grinding wheels, and packaging materials.

Manage the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) workflow in ERP, ensuring physical inspection, chemical/physical test clearance from Quality Control (QC), and vendor delivery challan reconciliations are completed within defined turnaround times.

Coordinate rejected material handling, debits, vendor return gate passes, and replacement follow-ups in close coordination with Local and Corporate Procurement.

2. Inventory Control & ERP Reconciliation
Maintain real-time stock ledger accuracy across all plant sub-stores (Raw Material Yard, Engineering Spares Store, Consumables Store, Scrap Yard).

Enforce Min-Max levels, Reorder Points (ROP), and Safety Stock levels for critical plant operational spares and consumables to prevent stockouts while optimizing working capital.

Conduct continuous cycle counts, monthly reconciliations, and bi-annual/annual full physical stock verifications alongside Internal and Statutory Audit teams; investigate and resolve book-to-physical variances.

Categorize and review inventory using ABC, VED, and FSN analyses; identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete (SLOB) items with concrete salvage or liquidation plans.

3. Material Storage, Preservation & Issuance
Design and implement scientific warehouse layouts, 5S standards, racking systems, bin allocation, and barcode/QR identification tags across all storage bays.

Ensure proper preservation of critical spares, sensitive instrumentation, and materials against weather, rust, acid fumes, or physical handling damage.

Supervise disciplined material issuance against approved Material Requisitions / Job Orders on a FIFO (First-In, First-Out) basis.

Manage hazardous material storage (pickling acids, industrial gases, furnace oils) ensuring mandatory safety measures, MSDS adherence, and spillage containment protocols.

4. Scrap Yard Management & Returnable Material Tracking
Oversee collection, segregation, and weighment of production process scrap (shearing scrap, end-cuttings, rolling scale, rejected mother pipes) and maintain heat-wise/grade-wise scrap accounting for furnace remelting or disposal.

Track Returnable Gate Passes (RGP) and Non-Returnable Gate Passes (NRGP) for plant equipment, rolls, and spares sent out for machining, calibration, or motor rewinding, ensuring strict adherence to return timelines.

5. Team Leadership & System Audits
Lead and supervise storekeepers, yard supervisors, crane operators, forklift drivers, and material handlers.

Enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all shifts, ensuring zero safety incidents during heavy lifting and yard handling.

Provide routine Management Information System (MIS) reporting on stock valuation, non-moving inventories, pending GRNs, and consumption trends to the GM Commercial and Corporate Management.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Science (B.Sc), Commerce (B.Com), or Engineering (Diploma/B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy).

Post-Graduate Diploma / MBA in Materials Management or Supply Chain Management is preferred.

Experience:


1216 years of hands-on stores and warehouse management experience in heavy manufacturing, with at least 35 years at a Senior Manager / Manager level.

Essential industry background: Steel Melting Shops (SMS), Stainless Steel Rolling Mills, Tube/Pipe Mills, or Heavy Engineering Fabrication.

Technical & System Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP MM module, Oracle SCM, or TallyPrime).

In-depth knowledge of inventory management methodologies (ABC/VED/FSN, FIFO, 5S, Kaizen).

Solid understanding of weighbridge operations, metallurgical grade differentiation, and traceability marking systems.

Key Competencies:


High personal integrity and strict adherence to internal audit controls.

Strong team supervision and contractor-labor management skills.

Detail-oriented tracking of incoming consignments and rigorous stock reconciliation discipline.

Job Description: AVP Commercial
Company Name: Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited

Plant Location: Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh

Corporate Head Office: New Delhi

Industry: Steel & Heavy Manufacturing (Stainless Steel Flats, Coils & Pipes)

Reporting To: Director Plant

Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site


Position Overview
Bharat Green Recycling & Renewables Limited is seeking an experienced, proactive, and commercially astute AVP Commercial to head commercial operations at our manufacturing facility in Paonta Sahib, Himachal Pradesh.

The GM Commercial will oversee plant accounting and financial controls, inventory and store operations, local procurement, logistics, and commercial statutory compliance. The role acts as the primary operational bridge between the manufacturing plant and the Corporate Head Office in New Delhi, ensuring cost efficiency, seamless supply chain execution, rigorous internal controls, and statutory compliance.


Key Responsibilities
1. Plant Accounts & Financial Controls
Direct and monitor day-to-day plant accounts, cost accounting, billing, invoicing, and petty cash management.

Oversee stainless steel manufacturing cost accounting (yield, conversion costs, scrap reconciliation, and power/fuel consumption).

Ensure strict internal financial controls, conduct regular internal audits, and coordinate with statutory auditors.

Manage plant-level GST, TDS, e-Way bills, TCS, and ensure timely filing in close coordination with the Corporate Finance team in New Delhi.

Monitor plant operational expenditures (OPEX) and capital expenditures (CAPEX), preparing monthly variance analyses against approved budgets.

2. Stores & Inventory Management
Oversee comprehensive store operations across raw materials (SS scrap, ingots, billets, flats, coils), consumables, spare parts, rolls, refractories, and finished goods (pipes, coils, flats).

Implement rigorous systems for material receipt (Gate Pass, Weighbridge, Inspection/GRN), issue, and bin card tracking.

Conduct periodic physical inventory audits, reconciliation against ERP/books, and minimize inventory shrinkage or carrying costs.

Identify and manage non-moving, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; establish scrap handling and disposal protocols.

3. Local Procurement & Vendor Management
Formulate and execute local procurement strategies for mechanical and electrical spares, refractories, consumables, oils/lubricants, packaging materials, and general site services.

Evaluate local vendor proposals, negotiate commercial terms, pricing, payment schedules, and delivery timelines to optimize working capital.

Implement vendor evaluation metrics, fostering reliable local supplier networks while enforcing vendor compliance.

Coordinate with Central Corporate Procurement (New Delhi) for high-value raw material intake, ensuring smooth site delivery schedules.

4. Logistics, Dispatch & Weighbridge Commercial Operations
Supervise inbound raw material arrivals and outbound dispatches of finished flats, coils, and pipes.

Exercise commercial control over weighbridge operations, tare/gross weight verifications, and freight audits.

Manage transporter contracts, freight negotiation for local movements, vehicle turnaround times, and transit compliance.

5. Head Office Coordination & Reporting
Act as the nodal contact at the Paonta Sahib unit for all commercial matters directed from the Corporate Office in New Delhi.

Prepare and submit regular Management Information System (MIS) reports, including daily fund requirements, monthly commercial MIS, inventory valuations, and cost-variance reports.

Align plant commercial targets and working capital requirements with corporate business goals.

6. Commercial Statutory Compliance
Ensure adherence to state and central commercial regulations, including GST compliance, e-Way billing rules, and tax documentation.

Monitor commercial documentation related to interstate dispatches, raw material transit permits, and statutory commercial records.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education:


Bachelors Degree in Commerce (B.Com) / Inter CA / Inter ICWA / MBA in Finance or Operations / B.Tech with an MBA. Full CA / ICWA (CMA) qualification is an added advantage.

Experience:


1520+ years of proven commercial management experience in a manufacturing environment, with at least 57 years in a senior leadership role (DGM/GM).

Direct experience in Steel Manufacturing, Stainless Steel, Rolling Mills, Tube Mills, or Heavy Industrial Fabrication is highly preferred.

Technical Skills:


Hands-on proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Oracle, or TallyPrime).

Strong mastery of GST, indirect taxation, inventory accounting, and Excel-based financial reporting.

Competencies:


Strong commercial negotiation and contract management skills.

Strong leadership with the ability to manage commercial, accounts, and stores teams.

Clear, structured communication skills for multi-location reporting and commercial coordination.

To carry out improvements in system for better efficient operations.
Responsible for accurate parts inventory and equipment specific usage control.
Implementation of cost improvement maintenance.
To perform any other work as and when assigned by Head of department

Job description

Job Specification:-
Position:-Sales Officer
Location :-Una/Hamirpur-Himachal
Experience :- 1 years +
Industry:- Nutraceutical
Channel:- General Trade/Modern Trade

Job Description:- General Trade.
1. Sales Target Achievement: Daily market visit and cover 20-25 retailers daily basis as per monthly travel plan. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets in General Trade by expanding the distributor and retailer base.
2. Distributor Management: Build strong relationships with distributors, ensuring product availability and maintaining optimum stock levels.
3. Retailer Engagement: Conduct regular market visits to assess retailer performance, manage relationships, and ensure visibility of the brand in outlets.
4. Route Planning: Plan and execute the sales route for daily market visits to maximize coverage and improve product penetration.
5. Market Feedback: Gather feedback from retailers and distributors on pricing, promotions, competitor activity, and product acceptance.

Modern Trade (MT):
Store Management: Work closely with key accounts, supermarkets, and hypermarkets to drive sales and ensure product visibility.
Planogram Compliance: Ensure the brands products are displayed according to planogram guidelines and that promotional displays are set up correctly.
Stock Management: Monitor stock levels in stores, coordinating with supply chain and merchandising teams to avoid out-of-stock situations.
Relationship Building: Build and maintain strong relationships with store managers, buyers, and category managers to ensure smooth operations.
Promotions & Activations: Implement promotional campaigns, in-store activations, and other initiatives to boost sales and brand awareness.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Growth in the number of active retailers and stores.
Improvement in product visibility and brand presence in both GT and MT.
Effective distributor and store relationship management.
Read in out-of-stock issues and improvement in stock rotation.

Interested candidate share CV/Resume @ Akshat.Chauhan@brightlifecare.com or 9650023605

Description:
Job Summary
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Battery Component Design
Product Development - RD
Function: Research Development / Product Development
Experience: Minimum 8 years
Reporting To: Mandeep (AGM - NPD)
Location: Gagret
Company: Luminous


Key Responsibilities
Prepare battery layouts, assembly drawings, component drawings and detailed manufacturing drawings.
Support Design and develop flooded tubular lead-acid batteries for inverter, solar, industrial and other deep-cycle applications.
Design and optimize components such as containers, lids, terminal arrangements, handles, vent plugs, gauntlets, grids, spines, straps and associated parts.
Develop accurate 2D drawings and 3D models using AutoCAD and Creo.
Define critical dimensions, tolerances, materials and technical specifications.
Maintain drawing accuracy, revision control and standardization across product families.
Convert product requirement specifications into design concepts and engineering specifications.
Conduct design calculations covering battery capacity, plate configuration, acid volume, component fitment, terminal arrangement, weight and dimensional compliance.
Support prototype development, pilot builds and production trials.
Coordinate with testing teams to prepare DVPR and validation plans.
Support design verification, validation and release through the company stage-gate NPD process.
Ensure completion of design reviews, technical risk assessments and product-release documentation.
Perform tolerance stack-up, fitment and interface analysis for battery components.
Identify opportunities for weight reduction, material optimization, improved performance and cost reduction.
Conduct Design FMEA and participate in Process FMEA reviews.
Evaluate product failures and implement corrective design actions.
Apply design-for-manufacturing, design-for-assembly and mistake-proofing principles.
Support value-engineering and product-standardization initiatives.
Prepare technical inputs for moulds, dies, fixtures and inspection gauges.
Participate in mould trials, component trials and sample approval.
Work with suppliers to resolve dimensional, material, fitment and manufacturing concerns.
Support component qualification, pilot-lot evaluation and production approval.
Coordinate with Manufacturing, Quality, Testing, Purchase, Marketing, Service and Supplier Development teams.
Provide technical support during product industrialization and production ramp-up.
Support investigation of field complaints and warranty failures related to product or component design.
Provide technical inputs for product specifications, catalogues, manuals and regulatory submissions.
Prepare and maintain drawings, specifications, bills of materials, engineering change notes and technical reports.
Ensure proper document control and traceability of design changes.
Support internal, customer and certification audits relating to product design and development.
Follow applicable safety, quality and environmental management systems.


Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
A diploma or advanced qualification in Tool and Die Making, CAD/CAM or Product Design will be an advantage.


Required Experience
Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product or component design.
Practical experience in the design and development of flooded tubular lead-acid batteries is strongly preferred.
Experience in plastic components, lead-alloy components, tooling, mould development and manufacturing drawings will be valuable.
Exposure to battery manufacturing processes and new-product industrialization is required.


Technical Skills
Creo
AutoCAD
DFMEA
DVPR
design-for-manufacturing
design-for-assembly
Microsoft Excel
PowerPoint
Word


Behavioural Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Attention to detail and commitment to drawing accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple development projects simultaneously.
Effective cross-functional and supplier coordination.
Good written and verbal communication skills.

Description:
Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
You will be responsible for coordinating and enabling the Site Asset & Technology Leader in driving asset reliability, maintenance, infrastructure and facilities performance to support the delivery of site SQCDSM targets.

The role will focus on ensuring reliable plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure and facilities, while driving effective MRO management, maintenance planning, budget utilization, inventory management and productivity initiatives. You will also ensure uninterrupted site operations through compliance with local legal regulations, Quality, Health, Safety & Environment standards and Mondel z manufacturing requirements.

How You Will Contribute
You will:
Asset, Maintenance & Infrastructure Management
Coordinate the execution of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities for plant equipment, process technology, infrastructure, buildings and facilities.
Drive maintenance of site infrastructure and facilities, ensuring timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM) and corrective actions.
Support asset reliability and loss prevention initiatives to minimize breakdowns, downtime and equipment-related losses.
Implement and sustain IL6S/TPM ways of working, including Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, Condition-Based Monitoring (CBM), lubrication management, calibration, visual controls and loss elimination.
Partner with the PM and operations teams to identify maintenance requirements, validate priorities and ensure timely closure of actions.
MRO & Inventory Management
Manage and track MRO requirements, consumption, availability and inventory, ensuring the right materials are available to support maintenance activities.
Review and validate MRO requirements raised by maintenance/PM teams based on business need, equipment criticality and inventory availability.
Participate in DMS (Daily Management System) routines and translate identified maintenance requirements into appropriate procurement actions.
Coordinate the PR/PO process for MRO requirements, including requirement validation, purchase order creation and follow-up with relevant stakeholders.
Monitor MRO spend, consumption and inventory levels to improve cost effectiveness and avoid excess/obsolete inventory.
Coordinate with suppliers/OEMs and service providers to ensure timely delivery of materials and services in line with agreed SLAs.
Budget & Cost Management
Support annual maintenance, MRO, infrastructure and facilities budget planning, including allocation and tracking of spend across various requirements.
Monitor OPEX/M&R and maintenance-related expenditure against budget and identify potential deviations and corrective actions.
Support prioritization of maintenance and infrastructure requirements based on business impact, asset criticality and available budget.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement through effective MRO management, maintenance practices and supplier management.
Productivity & Continuous Improvement
Drive and support MRO productivity projects and cost-saving initiatives focused on reducing maintenance losses, improving asset reliability and optimizing MRO spend.
Identify opportunities for loss elimination and improve maintenance effectiveness through data-driven analysis and structured problem solving.
Apply PDCA, TPM/IL6S and other continuous improvement methodologies to address recurring equipment and maintenance issues.
Capability Building & Stakeholder Management
Coach and support operating and maintenance teams on routine maintenance, equipment care, breakdown prevention and CIL (Cleaning, Inspection & Lubrication) practices.
Support development of technical capability within operating teams and work process owners.
Interface with internal stakeholders including Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, Quality, HSE and Supply Chain, as well as external service providers and OEMs.
Ensure adherence to manufacturing standards, governance, compliance requirements and applicable legal regulations.
What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career, along with the following experience and knowledge:
Experience in plant maintenance, asset management, engineering, facilities, infrastructure or MRO management, preferably within a manufacturing/FMCG environment.
Good understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, asset reliability and maintenance planning.
Knowledge of MRO management, inventory management, procurement processes and supplier/OEM coordination.
Experience in budget planning, cost tracking and OPEX/M&R management.
Understanding of TPM/IL6S, Progressive Maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance, CBM, loss elimination and PDCA-based problem solving.
Ability to evaluate and validate maintenance/MRO requirements and coordinate the DMS requirement validation PR/PO execution cycle.
Experience in driving or supporting productivity, cost-saving or continuous improvement projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and track performance.
Computer proficiency, including MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience in ERP systems such as SAP or similar platforms.
Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across maintenance, MRO, infrastructure, facilities, inventory and budget management.
Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
Business Unit Summary
Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands-and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 - the fourth time we ve received this award.

Description:
Job Description
AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant Pharmaceutical Client
Job Title

AVEVA PI Engineer / Consultant
Industry Domain

Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences (GxP-regulated Manufacturing)
Experience Required

5-10 years
Employment Type

Full-time
Location

Chennai/Bangalore/Kochi/Coimbatore - Hybrid
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced AVEVA PI (OSIsoft PI) Engineer with expertise in the Life Sciences/Pharmaceutical industry to design, implement, and support enterprise historian solutions. The candidate will be responsible for integrating manufacturing, laboratory, utility, and automation systems with the AVEVA PI System to enable real-time monitoring, data integrity, regulatory compliance, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, GMP regulations, data integrity requirements, and industrial automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain PI Data Archive, PI AF (Asset Framework), PI Vision, and PI Interfaces/Connectors to collect, contextualize, and deliver real-time process data.
Build and manage AF templates, element hierarchies, event frames, and analyses to model plant assets and business logic.
Configure and troubleshoot PI interfaces (OPC DA/UA, Modbus, custom interfaces) for data acquisition from PLCs, DCS, SCADA, and historians.
Develop PI Vision displays, dashboards, and PI DataLink/Excel reports for operations, engineering, and management stakeholders.
Write and maintain scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, PI SDK/AF SDK, PI Web API) to automate data workflows, integrations, and system health checks.
Integrate PI System data with other platforms (MES, ERP, SQL/historian databases, cloud data lakes, Aveva Data Hub/Connect).
Monitor system performance, data quality, and tag counts; perform capacity planning and license management.
Support PI System upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery, and high-availability (PI Collective) configurations.
Enforce cybersecurity best practices for OT/IT systems, including PI System security (mappings, identities, firewalls).
Document architecture, standards, naming conventions, and data governance processes.
Collaborate with process/controls engineers to identify new tagging, KPI, and analytics requirements.
provide Tier 2/3 support and root-cause analysis for PI System issues.Required Technical Skillset
Strong hands-on experience with AVEVA System Platform (Application Server / Galaxy, Historian, InTouch, Web Client / Operations Control).
Working knowledge of AVEVA MES / AVEVA Batch Management, or exposure to integrating third-party MES/LIMS/ERP with SCADA layer.
Proficiency in OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and native communication drivers for PLC/DCS integration
Experience with scripting (QuickScript/VBScript) and object-oriented Galaxy template design.
Understanding of network/OT architecture, redundancy, cybersecurity hardening (ISA/IEC 62443 awareness a plus), and virtualization (VMware) for industrial systems.
Familiarity with SQL Server/reporting tools for Historian data extraction and dashboarding (AVEVA Insight / Reports is a plus).
Pharmaceutical / Regulatory Domain Expertise (Preferred)
Sound knowledge of GAMP 5 computerized system validation (CSV/CSA) lifecycle and documentation practices.
Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity (ALCOA+) requirements.
Certifications (Preferred)
AVEVA PI certification
GAMP 5 / CSV training certification.
Soft Skills & Other Requirements
Strong client-facing communication skills; ability to work directly with pharma quality, validation, and automation stakeholders.
Ability to prepare and present technical estimations, proposals, and solution walkthroughs to client/hiring stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline suited to regulated/validated environments.
Good analytical and troubleshooting skills for live plant support scenarios.
