About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Firmware Development: Design, write, and test low-level firmware in Embedded C for bare-metal architectures and Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS).
Peripheral Drivers: Develop and maintain low-level drivers and Board Support Packages (BSP) for timers, ADC/DAC, DMA, GPIO, and external Flash/EEPROM.
Wired Protocols: Implement, configure, and troubleshoot wired serial and fieldbus interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN / RS-485.
Hardware Bring-Up: Lab Debugging: Bring up prototype boards and troubleshoot firmware-hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and JTAG/SWD debuggers.
Hardware Collaboration: Review hardware schematics, pinout mappings, and semiconductor datasheets in close collaboration with hardware design engineers.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE):
Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on professional experience in embedded firmware development.
Core Programming: Proficient in software development skills (C/C++/Python/...)
Target Microcontrollers: Demonstrated hands-on experience with at least one major MCU family: STMicroelectronics (STM32), NXP (LPC, Kinetis, S32K), or Renesas (RA, RX, RL78).
Communication Interfaces: Direct experience configuring and debugging wired buses: UART/USART, SPI, I2C, and CAN.
OS &Execution Models: Practical understanding of RTOS concepts (FreeRTOS tasks, queues, semaphores, mutexes) and bare-metal superloops.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience using in-circuit debuggers (J-Link, ST-Link, E2) and diagnostic
tools (logic analyzers, digital oscilloscopes).

Bachelor degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE),

Computer Engineering, or related technical field.

Description:
What you ll do:
Manage the research, design, and development of critical components for Medium Voltage (MV) Switchgear. Drive innovation, compliance, and industrialization to strengthen the competitiveness of MV Switchgear portfolio.
"-Supervise VCB, RMU, AIS and GIS design activities for MV Switchgear
-Define and approve type and prototype test plans covering MV Switchgear components
-Coordinate type testing with accredited labs (KEMA, CESI, GCC Lab) and oversee in-house prototype validation.
-Lead root cause analysis of failures and ensure effective corrective measures across both product families.
-Guarantee compliance with IEC / 100 / 102 / 103 / 200 standards as well as customer-specific and utility requirements.
-Maintain technical documentation supporting certifications, approvals, and type testing for both MV Switchgear projects.
-Utilize DFMEA and reliability engineering methods to strengthen robustness and long-term quality of Switchgear components.
-Coordinate with manufacturing, supply chain, electrical, and quality teams to ensure industrialization of components for both MV Switchgear.
-Collaborate with suppliers and RD institutions to localize and qualify components, reducing costs and lead times across both product lines.
-Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them
-Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.
-Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.
-Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations."

Description
We are looking for high-performing Sales Executives to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets by keeping our company competitive and innovative. The candidate should be able to drive independently and work in a team to meet the company expectations.
Responsibilities
Design and implement a strategic business plan that expands company s customer base and ensure it s strong presence
Build and promote strong, long-lasting customer relationships by partnering with them and understanding their needs
Identify emerging markets and market shifts while being fully aware of products and competition status
Requirements
Should have good knowledge about Channel Sales
Good in Teamwork and in distribution Sales
Should meet the target of the branch
To ensure proper ordering of stock so as to minimize dead stock; to keep a tab on the stock movement
Bringing in more customers thereby establish contacts
Must keep the outstanding in control
Any other duties assigned by Head
Preferred candidates with Building Materials Background
3 to 8 yrs experience in Sales.
Degree - Any Degree, Engineers would have an advantage.
Remuneration
Open for Discussion and not a constraint for the right candidate.

Maintaining relationship with assigned dealer
Deal Processing

Internal Stakeholder Management

Units Disbursed
st EMI Resolution
RC Collection

years work experience only in Vehicle Sales
Skills Competencies
Functional Competencies
Communication Skill
Negotiation Skill
Market/Industry Knowledge
Analytical Skill
Product Knowledge
Behavioural Competencies
Execution Excellence
Customer Centricity
Hiring Parameters:
Should be comfortable to move in the market
Should have learning attitude
Should have bike and license
Should have good knowledge of RTO
Should have product knowledge

Description:
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager who can take full ownership of the warehouse: racking and storage, stock accuracy, dispatch, and the supervisors and workforce. The person who joins must be able to run the operation independently and report to the owner with clear, accurate information.

Key Responsibilities

Racking & Storage
Manage a G+5 pallet racking system with defined bin locations (row, column, level)
Ensure every pallet is put away in the correct bin and the location is recorded accurately
Plan space usage, put-away, and picking to keep the warehouse organized and avoid congestion
Enforce FIFO by batch, production date, and MRP
Ensure safe forklift / reach truck movement and racking load safety

Inventory & Stock Control
Maintain 100% stock accuracy between physical stock and records
Conduct regular cycle counts and month-end physical stock audits
Track good vs. damaged stock and handle damage segregation and reporting
Reconcile stock with client records and resolve differences quickly

Inward & Dispatch
Plan and supervise daily receipts from the factory and dispatches to depots
Coordinate vehicle placement, loading, and documentation without delays
Ensure dispatch accuracy (right SKU, batch, quantity)

People Management
Lead supervisors, forklift operators, and loading/unloading labour
Allocate shifts and daily work, and hold supervisors accountable for targets
Maintain discipline, attendance, and productivity on the floor
Resolve worker issues firmly and fairly, without escalating everything to the owner
Train new staff on racking, stock procedures, and safety

Compliance, Safety & Reporting
Prepare daily/weekly MIS on stock, inward, dispatch, damages, and manpower
Ensure housekeeping, fire safety, and PPE compliance
Be ready for client audits and inspections at any time

Requirements
5+ years of warehouse experience, with at least 2 years as Warehouse Manager / In-charge
Mandatory: hands-on experience managing a pallet racking warehouse with bin locations
Experience in FMCG, 3PL, or manufacturing warehouses preferred
Proven experience leading a team of 20+ workers and supervisors
Strong knowledge of FIFO, batch tracking, stock audits, and damage handling
Working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets (WMS or SAP exposure is a plus)
Good communication in Tamil; English and Hindi preferred
Graduate in any discipline; diploma/degree in logistics or supply chain is a plus

To create network of high performing Partner and promulgate initiatives within each Partner to achieve sales productivity targets through sustainable partnership. Recruit, Coach, Mentor, Support and Retain Partner and Drive them to achieve New business productivity Renewal Targets
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Identify and Recruit the prospective Partner.
Selection to on boarding of the Partner and responsible for Partner income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner and other day to day interactions
with support functions whenever required.
Engage initiatives to ensure Managing Partner - PO productivity
To achieve the assigned recruitment target of partner office; assigned through various
Recruitment activities
Actively involve the PPs in activities pertaining to Recruitment and New Agent Activation
Responsible for Advisor Activation, Creation and Retention
Ensure compliance to all internal processes and other compliance standards as set by the
Company or the Regulator.
Plan goals performance needs for Partner in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for Partner Office
Identify development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical,
product and skills training and coaching. Develop Partner in line with career development
training requirements of the Company.
Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with
Partner.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performances and arranging appropriate
team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills
of Partners.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company
information, address common problems and concerns and rally the Partner to achieve
goals.
Make necessary decisions based on Partner performance.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Min 2 years of sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of Insurance industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing customers to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support
Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Review and monitor production schedule adherence.
Review and monitor ILR status.
Monitor plant efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Periodically review and update Control Plans, SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and related documents.
Coordinate with supporting departments for facility-related requirements.
Coordinate and support IATF, TPS, PMI, OSHAS, VDA, and other system-related activities.
Carry out SAP BOM corrections and ensure accuracy of material-related data.
Carry out SAP Norms corrections and maintain accurate system data.
Ensure timely closure of Stop Advice Notes.
Monitor and ensure shift-wise NC closure.
Coordinate new product introduction / new product activities with the CFT.
Key Technical Responsibilities
The role also requires strong capability in PCBA manufacturing and final assembly, including single-piece flow and batch production, SOP/CP/PFMEA, quality problem-solving tools, line efficiency improvement, assembly rejection/rework control, defect analysis, FPY improvement, 5S/Kaizen, PCB Gerber data, through-hole and selective soldering, and electronic product manufacturing processes.

Description:
Job Purpose:

To independently manage day-to-day HR operations, employee relations, statutory compliance and branch administration at the Pondicherry location.

Key Responsibilities:
HR Operations: Manage onboarding, employee documentation, employee records and exit formalities.
Attendance & Leave: Monitor daily attendance, absenteeism, leave applications and biometric records.
Payroll Coordination: Validate monthly attendance, overtime, leave and payroll inputs.
Statutory Compliance: Maintain statutory registers, notices and support PF, ESI, PT and other applicable compliance requirements.
Employee Engagement: Conduct employee interactions, address grievances and coordinate engagement activities.
Recruitment: Coordinate hiring, candidate screening, interviews and joining formalities.
Performance Management: Coordinate appraisal activities, goal reviews and training programme.
Branch Administration: Monitor housekeeping, dress code, pantry supplies, petty cash, office maintenance and workplace discipline.
HRMS Management: Ensure employees use the HRMS for attendance, leave applications and other HR activities.
HR Reporting: Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment and compliance status.

Required Skills:
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of HR operations and Indian labour laws.
Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS.
Strong coordination and employee-handling skills.
Ability to independently manage branch-level HR activities.

Description:
Operate inspection and rewinding machines as per production plan and job specifications.
Understand job cards, inspection standards, customer specifications and approved quality samples.
Inspect printed films and laminated materials for visual and functional defects.
Set inspection machine parameters such as speed, tension, winding pressure and web alignment.
Identify and segregate defective material during inspection.
Check for printing defects such as:
Colour variation
Misregistration
Missing print
Ink smudging
Streaks and spots
Pinholes and scratches
7. Check lamination defects such as:
Bubbles
Wrinkles
Delamination
Tunnelling
Adhesive marks
Foreign particles
8. Check film and laminate defects such as:
Gauge variation
Holes
Contamination
Edge damage
Surface scratches
9. Ensure accurate defect marking, defect removal and rejection segregation as per approved procedures.
10. Maintain proper roll length, winding tightness and roll appearance.
11. Ensure correct splicing and joint identification.
12. Verify finished roll width, length, direction of winding and roll identification.
13. Maintain inspection reports, rejection records and production documentation.
14. Minimise inspection wastage and maintain productivity.
15. Coordinate with Quality and Production teams regarding major quality abnormalities.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Receptionist / Front Desk Executive
Company: Boondh Healing Caf & Wellness Centre
Location: Cool Road, Jalandhar
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
About the Role
We are looking for a warm, organised and professional Receptionist to be the first point of contact for guests at Boondh. The role involves welcoming visitors, managing appointments, handling enquiries and coordinating with our caf and wellness teams to create a smooth, comfortable guest experience.
Roles and Responsibilities
Welcome guests courteously and guide them to the appropriate service or team member.
Handle phone calls, WhatsApp messages and walk-in enquiries promptly.
Schedule, confirm and reschedule appointments for therapies, meditation sessions, yoga classes and consultations.
Explain available services, packages, memberships and ongoing offers accurately.
Maintain appointment calendars and coordinate with therapists, instructors and management.
Assist guests with registrations, booking systems and feedback.
Manage billing, receive payments, issue receipts and maintain accurate daily records.
Maintain guest records carefully and protect personal information.
Handle guest concerns calmly and escalate issues when required.
Keep the reception area tidy, welcoming and organised.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Previous experience in reception, front office, hospitality, a salon, spa or wellness centre is preferred. Freshers with strong communication skills may also apply.
Good communication skills in Hindi and English; Punjabi is an advantage.
Comfortable using computers, WhatsApp, email, basic Excel and booking or billing software.
Polite telephone etiquette, professional presentation and a guest-focused attitude.
Punctual, dependable and able to manage multiple appointments and enquiries.
Comfortable working scheduled shifts, including weekends as required.
Salary and Benefits
Salary based on relevant experience and skills.
Opportunity to learn front-office operations in a caf and wellness environment.
Further employment terms and applicable benefits will be discussed during the interview.

Boondh is a healing caf and wellness centre on Cool Road, Jalandhar, founded by author and Emotional Intelligence trainer Neha Arora.
Bringing together a caf, yoga, guided meditation, sound healing, relaxation therapies and personalised consultations, Boondh offers a welcoming space for people to pause, reconnect with themselves and nurture their well-being.
Our philosophy is simple: “Every drop heals.” We believe thoughtful experiences, compassionate service and small moments of care can make a meaningful difference.
We are building a team that values warmth, professionalism, respect and genuine care for every guest.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates with strong hands-on experience in milk procurement and direct farmer management, particularly from the dairy / Agri / Food industry.

Preference: Candidates who have handled large-scale milk procurement operations and farmer networks at a zonal/regional level, with strong field exposure and team-management experience.

Role & responsibilities
Lead milk procurement operations across the assigned zone.
Strengthen relationships with farmers, Milk Collection Centres (MCCs), and procurement teams.
Drive milk volume, quality and procurement efficiency across the zone.
Develop and implement strategies for farmer engagement, retention and milk productivity.
Monitor milk procurement, quality parameters, pricing, cost and daily procurement performance.
Ensure effective functioning of MCCs, BMCs and milk collection infrastructure.
Coordinate with Veterinary, Dairy Development, QA, Operations, Logistics and Sales teams as required.
Identify opportunities to improve farmer base, procurement coverage and milk availability.
Lead and develop the Zone 4 procurement team and ensure accountability for targets.
Monitor market conditions impacting milk procurement.
Drive initiatives for farmer loyalty, productivity enhancement and sustainable milk sourcing.

Experience in milk procurement / farmer relationship management.
Strong exposure to village-level milk collection and farmer networks.
Experience managing milk procurement teams and operations at a regional/zonal level.
Good understanding of milk quality, procurement processes and farmer engagement.
Fluency in Punjabi/Hindi is mandatory, with the ability to communicate effectively with local farmers and stakeholders.
Strong field orientation and willingness to extensively engage with the farmer community.

Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.




Requirements
Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self-motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
Benefits:
Net Take Home: 18k to 23k (Negotiable)
MWA: 5,000/-
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5000 per month, depending on profile

About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

T Support & Troubleshooting

Manage and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, VPN, and network infrastructure.

Support security audits, antivirus monitoring, and data protection activities.
IT Service Management & Administration
Handle daily ITSM activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
Manage and resolve end-user support tickets using Service Now or other ticketing tools.
Maintain IT asset inventory, software licenses, and hardware records.
Perform daily backups, data restoration, and disaster recovery support.
Coordinate with vendors for IT repairs, AMC, and technical support.
Maintain technical documentation and knowledge base records.

Required Skills
Windows 10/11, Hardware & Software Troubleshooting
Networking, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN & Wi-Fi
Routing & Switching, OSPF, BGP, VLAN, VPN
Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Outlook & Azure
Linux, Cisco Networking & Network Security
SOC Operations, Cybersecurity & Threat Monitoring
Vulnerability Management & Security Auditing
Service Now, ITIL & Incident Management
AWS, Azure & Virtualization
Python (Basic Knowledge)
Backup & Disaster Recovery
Desired Candidate Profile
B.Tech /B.E graduates with relevant technical knowledge.
0–3 years of experience in IT Support, Networking, or SOC Operations.
Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work in a team environment.

We are hiring for Sales Officer \ Senior Sales Officer.


We seek a dynamic and result-driven Sales Officer to join our team. to help us meet our customer acquisition and revenue growth targets. As a Sales Officer, you will represent the organization in the assigned market as its Brand Ambassador and shall be the custodian of its Brand Equity.

Role & Responsibilities:

Setting up a network of Channel Partners (Distributors, Dealers, and Subdealers as required) for optimum reach and penetration of NCL Tile Adhesives & allied products in the assigned market. Ensure an optimum stock level of all product items with our channel partners.

Devise and Execute a Demand Generation Campaign to create awareness, and interest among buyers and influencers (Applicators / Masons, Contractors, End Customers, Builders / Developers, Architects & Designer) through multiple activities (product presentations & demonstrations, content creation & distribution, masons meet at Retail Outlet, Nakka Meet, Contractors Meet, Architect Meet, etc.)

Maintain sales volume, product mix, selling price, and credit periods if any by keeping current with supply and demand, changing trends, economic indicators and competitors.

Conduct market research at regular intervals to gain market intelligence, gauge selling possibilities, and evaluate customer needs with a good geographical understanding.

Implement a strategic business plan that helps expand the company's customer base and ensures its strong presence with regular updates on competitors' activities.

Complete compliance with the company's reporting requirements in both online and offline formats.

Requirements and skills:

Candidate with prior experience in the Building Material Industry at the same level and geography shall be preferred.

Minimum graduate, post-graduation in business administration will be preferred.

Must possess good communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with an ability to work independently and as a part of a team.

Ability to launch a similar product in the market, having good relationships with Dealers, Contractors, and applicators, and experience in conducting Mason/In-Shop, Naaka Meet, and Contractor meet and generating consistent sales of tile adhesive products shall be given utmost preference.

Demonstrated ability to communicate, negotiate, present, and influence credibly and effectively at all levels of the organization.

Proven ability to drive sales.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel within assigned territories.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilites

1. Equipment Operation & Maintenance
Perform operation, inspection, and maintenance of:
Mixers, crushers, and size reduction equipment
Screw conveyors and chain conveyors
Coal handling systems including feeders, conveyors, and transfer points
Silos and bulk material storage systems
Storage tanks (water, fuel, chemicals)
Ensure proper alignment, balancing, lubrication, and calibration of rotating equipment.
Monitor equipment performance parameters and take corrective actions.
2. Boiler & Utility Systems
Operate and maintain boilers and associated auxiliaries (pumps, valves, pipelines).
Monitor steam generation, pressure, and temperature parameters.
Maintain water treatment systems including R.O (Reverse Osmosis) plants.
Ensure efficient operation of compressors (air systems) and hydraulic pumps.
3. Hydraulic & Pneumatic Systems
Maintain and troubleshoot hydraulic pumps, actuators, and control systems.
Diagnose issues in pneumatic systems connected to compressors and valves.
Ensure leak-free operation and proper pressure settings.
4. Material Handling & Lifting Equipment
Inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot cranes and overhead (EOT) cranes.
Ensure safe handling of heavy materials and compliance with lifting standards.
Coordinate with operations team for material movement efficiency.
5. Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all plant equipment.
Implement predictive maintenance techniques such as vibration analysis and thermography.
Maintain maintenance logs, history records, and equipment documentation.
Analyze recurring failures and implement root cause analysis (RCA).
6. Breakdown Management
Respond to equipment breakdowns promptly to minimize downtime.
Identify root causes and implement permanent corrective actions.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for quick resolution.

7. Safety, Quality & Compliance
Ensure strict adherence to safety standards and statutory regulations.
Conduct risk assessments, safety audits, and toolbox talks.
Follow SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and quality guidelines.
Ensure safe handling of hazardous materials and high-pressure systems.
8. Team Coordination & Reporting
Supervise technicians and maintenance staff.
Coordinate with electrical, instrumentation, and operations teams.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance reports.
Train junior staff on equipment handling and safety procedures.
Qualifications
Bachelors Degree / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering

Experience
8–10+ years in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferably from AAC Blocks Manufacturing

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)

Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Improve shelf display and brand visibility in shops.
Execute trade schemes, promotions, and in-store activities.

3. Distributor & Channel Management
Manage distributors and support them in daily operations.
Plan orders and ensure timely delivery to retailers.
Monitor distributor stock levels and secondary sales.
Resolve distributor and retailer issues quickly.
4. Customer Relationship Management

Job description
Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive Operations
Location: Multiple Locations Andhra Pradesh & Telangana
Department: Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurate gold appraisal, processing gold loan applications, maintaining branch records, and delivering excellent customer service while ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Evaluate and appraise gold ornaments using standard valuation methods and approved equipment.

2. Verify the purity, weight, and quality of pledged gold.

3. Process gold loan applications and complete all operational formalities.

4. Verify customer KYC and loan documentation.

5. Maintain loan files, operational registers, and branch records accurately.

6. Handle documentation, books of accounts, and operational records.

7. Ensure safe custody of pledged gold and related documents.

8. Follow up with customers for loan renewals, repayments, and closures.

9. Provide prompt and professional customer service.

10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:
1. Any Graduate
2. Knowledge of gold appraisal or willingness to learn.
3. Good communication and customer handling skills.
4. Basic computer knowledge.
5. Attention to detail and strong ethical standards.

Preferred Skills:
1. Gold valuation and appraisal.
2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

Salary: Best in the Industry + Performance Incentives.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Gold Appraiser / Gold Valuation Executive and Manager to join our Operations team. 10. Ensure compliance with company policies, audit standards, and regulatory guidelines.

11. Support daily branch operations and maintain operational efficiency.

Eligibility:

Preferred Skills:

2. Gold loan operations.
3. Documentation and record management.
4. Customer relationship management.
5. KYC verification.
6. Operational compliance.
7. Communication and interpersonal skills.
8. MS Office and basic computer operations.

With an impressive installed capacity of 4300 MW, JPL has been instrumental in meeting the nation's growing power demands. Pioneering the establishment of an Independent Power Plant (IPP) in 2007 with its 4x250 MW thermal power unit in Chhattisgarh's Raigarh district, JPL has continued its expansion in Tamnar with a 2400 MW (4X600 MW) thermal power plant.
Description:
Key Focus areas
Functions - Weightage
Numerical relays testing, Control Schemes study, retrofitting of relays and configuration. - 50%
Equipment testing - 25%
SCADA system, Data communication system and Energy management system - 25%

Role & responsibilities
Hands-on experience in electrical testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of thermal power plant electrical systems.
Experience in testing of power transformers, HT/LT switchgear, motors, generators,400KV Switchyard Equipment
Hands-on experience in generator and auxiliary system overhauling, excitation system testing/maintenance, and operation & maintenance (O&M).
Practical experience in transformer diagnostic testing, including DGA, BDV
Good knowledge of numerical protection relays, relay testing and protection scheme commissioning.
Working knowledge of protection systems for Transmission line, Power transformer, generator, HT& LT Motors& Switchgear
Ability to read and interpret SLDs, protection schematics, control wiring diagrams and interlocking logic.
Experience in preparation and review of testing/commissioning reports and test documentation.
Carry out troubleshooting of transformers, generators, switchgear, motors, and protection systems.
Analyze relay trip records and disturbance records.

Functional Competencies
Protection Relays: Programming, testing, and parameterization of numerical relays using automated kits (Omicron/Megger).
HV Diagnostics: Primary/secondary testing, breaker timing, tan delta, IR/PI, and DGA for generators, transformers, and 220kV switchyards.
Fault Analysis & SAS: Evaluating Disturbance Recorder logs/oscillograms for trip root causes; configuring IEC 61850 protocol and GOOSE messaging.
System Design: Relay coordination, setting calculations, CT/VT sizing, and interlock/breaker failure scheme verification.

Behavioral & Management Competencies:
Decision Making: Analyzes trip logs (DR/SER) without rushing unsafe re-energization.
Safety Rigor & Courage: Enforces strict LOTO/PTW protocols; asserts technical holds when equipment fails insulation tests.
Analytical Precision: Meticulous with relay setting calculations and CT/VT ratios.
Outage Execution: Manages tight testing schedules during overhauls.
Incident Investigation: Leads Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for unit trips.

Preferred candidate profile
B.E. / B.Tech Electrical or similar qualified with 5-10 Yrs of experience in Thermal Power Plant with 150MW capacity.
AboutCompany:
Jindal Power Limited (JPL) is a leading Indian power company with a diverse energy portfolio encompassing thermal and renewable sources. JPL energy portfolio includes 3400 MW at Tamnar, Chhattisgarh and 600 MW at Simhapuri Andhra Pradesh & 300 MW at Shirpur, Maharashtra. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies and best practices, JPL has set new standards in India's power sector.

The company envisions establishing benchmarks in renewable energy, carbon emissions, and environmental protection. Furthermore, JPL is a trailblazer in community development and welfare initiatives.

JOB DESCRIPTION

HR Manager

Position Overview
The role is responsible for managing end-to-end payroll activities, statutory compliance, payroll reporting, employee loan administration, and day-to-day HR operations. The position requires strong attention to detail, accurate employee data management, timely statutory filings, and effective coordination with HR, Finance, employees, and reporting managers.
1. Payroll Management
Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing across applicable business units and locations.
Collect and validate employee attendance and overtime (OT) details from site coordinators and employees.
Verify attendance records in the HRMS and coordinate with reporting managers to resolve discrepancies.
Prepare final attendance and overtime calculation sheets for payroll processing.
Prepare salary working sheets covering salary advances, leave encashment, reimbursements, and other payroll adjustments.
Upload and maintain employee loan details in the HRMS.
Verify employee bank account, PF, and other payroll-related details and update missing or incorrect information.
Review and incorporate payroll inputs and remarks received from the HR team before processing.
Complete payroll validations and coordinate the monthly salary processing cycle.
Prepare and maintain the monthly payroll budget sheet.
Conduct final payroll verification with the relevant stakeholders before salary processing.
Coordinate payroll processing for other applicable business units and work closely with the Finance Team.
Release employee payslips after salary credit.
2. Monthly Payroll Reports & Documentation
Prepare and submit monthly actual salary reports to the designated management stakeholders.
Maintain monthly payroll records, including location-wise employee sheets and individual salary records.
Maintain and update the employee loan recovery tracker.
Coordinate and communicate monthly loan recovery details to employees.
Compile and submit required income tax and payroll-related data to the designated stakeholders.
3. Statutory Compliance PF, ESI & Professional Tax
Prepare PF and ESI contribution data for statutory challan generation.
Prepare EPF contribution and return-related sheets for applicable business units.
Prepare ESI return statements, including zero-return statements wherever applicable.
Prepare EPF zero-return statements wherever applicable.
Share validated statutory data with the designated compliance partner for challan generation.
Prepare Professional Tax (PT) sheets for applicable locations and coordinate with the designated stakeholders for challan processing.
Verify statutory challans received from the compliance partner and forward them to the Finance Team for payment processing.
4. Compliance Management
Prepare and submit statutory compliance reports after completion of PF, ESI, and PT payment activities.
Prepare and submit location/business-unit specific compliance reports within the required timelines.
Maintain supporting documentation for statutory compliance activities and audit requirements.
5. Employee Loan Administration
Share loan application documents and relevant information with eligible employees.
Collect and verify completed employee loan applications.
Coordinate with the Finance Team for employee loan disbursement.
Maintain and update the employee loan register and recovery records.
6. HR Operations & Employee Support
Resolve employee queries related to payroll, payslips, PF, ESI, leave balances, and other payroll matters.
Provide support for day-to-day HR operations and payroll-related activities.
Coordinate with HR, Finance, reporting managers, and employees to resolve payroll and statutory discrepancies.
Provide operational support as required by the HR leadership team.
7. Payroll, Compliance & Data Management
Maintain and update employee statutory records accurately and systematically.
Prepare and maintain PF, ESI, PT, and other applicable statutory compliance reports.
Generate, review, and verify monthly salary reports.
Prepare payroll reports and ensure payroll data accuracy and completeness.

Designation: Associate

The Role:
You dial. You pitch. You close. Repeat

Description:
Location: North Goa

Job Description: The Customer Service Associate at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers and rider partners, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries.
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions)
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options.
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements.
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels.
Handling customer and rider partner escalations-preparing RCA and providing the solution.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts.
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements and providing best solutions to the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Required Skills:
Excellent communication skills: You should possess strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively interact with customers and rider partners and convey information clearly and concisely.
Customer-centric approach: A deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to keep focus on their issue is a fast paced and complex environment - this is applicable for our rider partners as well
Problem-solving skills: You must be adept at analyzing customer and rider partner issues, identifying root causes, and providing appropriate solutions or escalating matters as needed.
Time management: The ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple inquiries simultaneously, and meet deadlines is essential for efficient customer service delivery.
Familiarity with customer-relationship management (CRM) software programs
Problem-solving and critical thinking: You will encounter complex customer and rider related issues that require effective problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically. You should be able to analyze situations, evaluate available options, and propose viable solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
Flexible with the working schedule; may be expected to work weekends, holidays and events where there is increased service demand.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Job Description
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG food/beverage, or hotel industry)
